chapters.title: Chapter 301 - Cooperation
paragraphs: Tang Chu and the other Federation players looked at Fang Heng with eager eyes.
From the beginning until now, they had participated in the desert shelter step by step. They had witnessed the entire process of the construction of the shelter. No one wanted it to be destroyed.
The players were excited and curious. They were anxiously looking forward to finding out what method Fang Heng would use to turn things around.
“Dong! Dong! Dong! Dong!!!”
Following that, Tang Chu heard heavy footsteps.
Following the sound, three tall figures gradually appeared on the road in the distance.
“Tyrant!”
A Federation player shouted.
It was the Tyrant!
The Federation players were once again in an uproar.
Chen Yu suddenly turned around and looked at Fang Heng.
His eyes were filled with shock and confusion.
“Tyrant?”
“Yes.”
“They were brought out from Pine City?”
“Yes.”
“So you can completely control the Tyrant then, right?”
“Yes.”
“So you can control the Tyrant, and this group of Lickers is also controlled by you, right?”
“Yes... Yes? No.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he turned his head and gave Lucia a look.
Lucia immediately understood Fang Heng’s meaning, but she was still at a loss.
“Huh? No, it’s not like that. We’re not controlling them, we’re...”
Lucia couldn’t finish her sentence. She looked at Fang Heng for help.
Fang Heng explained to everyone.
“We are guiding them. Guiding the zombie team consumes a lot of energy. This is a huge burden for Lucia. It can’t be used as a conventional tactic. It’s like a one-time consumable.”
“Ahem, I understand, I understand. It’s an ability that can only be used once, right?”
Chen Yu coughed lightly. He knew that Fang Heng was lying to the outside world again.
It was one thing to lie to the other players, but he had known Fang Heng for so long. He definitely wouldn’t believe it.
Guiding the Licker was fine, but to guide the Tyrant?
Whoever believed Fang Heng’s words would suffer.
“Yes, yes, Chen Yu, I knew you would understand.”
Fang Heng patted Chen Yu’s shoulder and gave him a look that he understood.
As he said this, he turned around and controlled one of the Tyrants to stride forward. It raised its fist and ruthlessly smashed it towards the crystallized worm.
“Bang!!!”
This fist that used all its strength seemed to be hitting a hard iron block!
Tyrant’s body swayed backwards.
So hard?
Fang Heng’s heart moved and he once again controlled Tyrant to walk forward.
Tyrant once again took a big step forward and stretched out its hand to lift the crystallized worm from the ground.
The crystallized worm immediately counterattacked, opening its huge mouth, revealing circles of sharp white teeth in its mouthpart.
It bit on the Tyrant’s shoulder.
A huge piece of flesh was bitten off the Tyrant’s shoulder.
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted.
The crystallized form’s damage output was so strong?
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Tyrant form has suffered serious damage.]
There was a huge hole on Tyrant’s shoulder!
However, in an instant, fine vines quickly grew out from under the bitten flesh, stopping the bleeding.
The Tyrant held on tightly to the worm’s body and did not let go. It lifted it high up in the air and threw it behind.
“Bang!”
The crystallized form was thrown nearly a hundred meters away before it stopped.
A hundred meters might not be far.
But for a crystallized form that could only move slowly, it needed to crawl for more than ten minutes!
This attack bought more than ten minutes of time for the shelter!
The players of the Federation burst into cheers again!
The Tyrant form was half-kneeling on the ground due to the heavy injury on its shoulder.
Flesh and blood grew rapidly under the torn skin.
The remaining two Tyrant forms also took turns to join the battlefield.
Fang Heng already had a countermeasure.
For a crystallized form with super-strong defense, the Tyrant’s normal attacks were not effective.
Fang Heng would not choose to use force. He only controlled the Tyrant to pull up the crystallized forms and throw them further away from the Federation’s shelter.
The crystallized worms were not weak either. They left huge bloody holes on Tyrant’s body.
The battle looked extremely tense, but Fang Heng had already relaxed.
“The situation is set...”
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker deals damage to the crystallized form.]
[Hint: Your Tyrant’s HP +283.]
[Hint: Your Tyrant’s HP +283...]
After Tyrant exited the battle state, its HP recovered rapidly.
As long as the Tyrant didn’t die! Tyrant’s HP, which had fused with the vine zombie gene, would recover to full HP very quickly!
Fang Heng was truly not afraid of such a long battle of attrition!
He muttered to himself in a low voice.
He looked at the seemingly anxious battlefield ahead, before turning his head to look at Mo Jiawei, who had just returned in his truck and was currently looking around in the crowd.
Mo Jiawei had just returned. He was thinking of looking for Fang Heng but was stopped outside by the Federation soldiers.
Fang Heng waved at Mo Jiawei and the two soldiers.
“He is my friend! Let him come in!”
Mo Jiawei hurried over and whispered in Fang Heng’s ear.
“Everything is going well. The previous batch of goods has just been sent back to the Dark Knights’ contact point.”
“Just as we thought, the ores can be directly sent back to the shelter. I have already handed over the ores to Victor in advance.”
“But the crystal coffins are a bit troublesome. They can’t pass through the space fissure, so we have to think of a way to slowly transport them back.”
“Yes, the crystal coffins can wait.” Fang Heng nodded. “There’s another important thing I need you to do. How many Dark Knights’ honor points do you have left?”
“I didn’t use them much. So it’s close to 10,000.”
“Help me go to the Dark Knights to do one more thing...”
“Oh my god! It’s Tyrant!”
“Too strong!”
“There’s a chance! We can protect the shelter!”
Inside the shelter’s command room, Federation players who chose to live and die with the shelter watched the battle outside through the surveillance screen and discussed it in low voices.
Under the close cooperation of Fang Heng and the Federation elite team, the Tier 4 crystallized worms fell one by one.
Yu Jie took a deep breath.
Fortunately, with the help of Fang Heng, the shelter survived.
However...
The cooperation between the prison and the Dark Knights had reached such a level?
They could control a large number of Lickers and the Tyrant form?
And it was three Tyrant forms!
No one could control a creature as strong as the Tyrant even in the old server!
“Yu Jie, Fang Heng is a threat.”
Yu Jie frowned and turned to look at the person.
He was quite disdainful.
“Zhang Zhe? Didn’t you evacuate with your people?”
Zhang Zhe had already evacuated. He had just left halfway when he heard that things had turned for the better, so he immediately rushed back from far away.

“I have reported the incident to my superiors. Fang Heng is a dangerous person. I think the Lickers’ attack on our shelter was most likely related to him, and he is also closely related to this crystallized form incident.”

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - All of It
paragraphs: “Is that so? Then why is he still helping us protect the shelter?”
Yu Jie asked.
He laughed coldly and ignored Yu Jie.
“Stop making excuses for your incompetence. Think about yourself.”
“After this matter is over, I will present a report to my superiors. Think about how to explain the failure of this mission to my superiors.”
Yu Jie knew very well that after this incident was over, the Federation would soon convene an emergency meeting to discuss the incident that had happened today.
Yu Jie could already guess the outcome.
He definitely wouldn’t be able to escape punishment.
As for Fang Heng...
As long as he could prove that Fang Heng had nothing to do with Night Owl or the other anti-federal organization.
To maintain the stability of the server, the Federation would make a huge concession and think of a way to obtain the method to control the Tyrant and Licker from Fang Heng.
As long as Fang Heng’s request was not too excessive, the Federation would not hesitate to agree to share Server 8 with Fang Heng.

Even if Fang Heng was not willing to share, the Federation would not be willing to make an enemy out of Fang Heng. On the contrary, they hoped that Fang Heng could stabilize the situation of Server 8.
Personally, Yu Jie was also very willing to cooperate with Fang Heng.
With powerful combat units such as the Tyrant form and Lickers, the safety of the desert shelter and the lives of innocent people could be guaranteed.
The Federation could also devote more energy to other high-level game worlds.
Such a win-win situation was something that both Yu Jie and the Federation were extremely happy to see.
[Hint: You have killed a crystallized form (Tier 4 larva stage). You have obtained 228 survival points. You have obtained Tier 2 evolution crystal*1.]
Seven consecutive hours of battle.
As the players could not fight in the wild at night for long periods, the elite team that assisted Fang Heng in the battle changed batch after batch.
There was only one crystallized worm left!
It was already at the end of its tether.
Corrosive howitzers bombarded the crystallized form one after another. The corrosive solution dissolved a large piece of the crystallized armour, revealing red flesh and blood.
The group of Lickers slashed huge wounds on the corroded flesh and blood.
The blood continued to flow.
Not far behind the battlefield, at a temporary command post, Fang Heng asked Chen Yu beside him, “How many corrosive rocket launchers are left?”
Chen Yu’s eyes were bloodshot, but he could not hide his excitement.
“There are still 12 rounds left.”
“Enough, enough for me to be greedy for another round.”
Fang Heng replied softly, his gaze focused on the Tier 4 crystallized worm that was struggling on its last breath.
“What? Fang Heng, what did you say?”
Chen Yu thought he didn’t hear him clearly, so he turned around and looked at Fang Heng in confusion.
“What do you mean by ‘greedy for another round’?”
He faintly felt a pain in his balls and he had a bad premonition in his heart.
No way? At such a crucial time...
Could it be that Fang Heng was going to start his work again?
Fang Heng was very calm. He took out a small walkie-talkie from his pocket.
“Mo Jiawei, how’s the situation?”
“God, almost there, almost there!”
Chen Yu looked around blankly. He realized that Mo Jiawei, who was around earlier on, had disappeared again.
“I see you. Go, I’ll control the Tyrant to coordinate with you. Be careful.”
“Roger! God, see what I can do!”
Fang Heng put down the walkie-talkie and looked up into the sky.
Chen Yu was dumbfounded. He also looked up into the sky.
In the distance, a helicopter with the logo of the Dark Knights was slowly approaching.
Mo Jiawei poked his head out of the helicopter and looked out.
The helicopter gradually flew low.
Two huge boxes were hanging below it, one blue and one grey.
Chen Yu was puzzled, “Hey, Fang Heng? What are you trying to do? What’s in that box?”
“You’ll know in a moment. For safety’s sake, let the team retreat first.”
Chen Yu had no choice but to turn on the team’s communicator.
“This is Chen Yu, everyone! There’s been a change of plan, everyone retreat! Immediately! Now!”
“Roger! Sir!”
The Federation’s elite teams were extremely efficient. After Tang Chu heard the order, he immediately led the three combat teams to retreat to the temporary command centre.
At this time, the Tier 4 crystallized worm was already in a state of near-death.
It seemed to have felt something as well and struggled to wiggle its body.
A Tyrant took large strides towards the worm from the front.
“Hiss!”
The worm opened its huge mouth again, trying to swallow the Tyrant in one bite.
It was coming!
At this moment, a rope on the helicopter was cut off, and the grey metal box hanging in the air suddenly fell.
The Tyrant form that was charging forward caught the falling metal box and smashed it towards the worm’s huge mouth.
“Chi!”
The worm bit the metal box into pieces!
Tyrant rolled to the ground and smashed the body of the crystallized worm.
“Bang!”
The metal box’s shrapnel scattered in all directions.
Rocks?
The metal box was filled with rocks?
Chen Yu was stunned for a moment, his face full of confusion.
“Fang Heng, it’s filled with rocks?”
Fang Heng stared at the Tier 4 worm on the ground.
“Yes, they’re rocks, but they’re not ordinary rocks. They’re raw blue crystal ores.”
“What!?”
Chen Yu was shocked.
On the way here, he had updated himself with some information about the crystallized forms.
Since the information was publicly available, Chen Yu only had a rough idea of the effects of raw blue crystal ores.
He knew that it was a very rare energy source material, and most of the time, it would only be used in the later stages of the game.
“Don’t be nervous, it’s filled with the lowest-level blue crystal ores, the most worthless batch.”
Chen Yu thought to himself, that’s not the main point!
What was the point of using that thing to smash the crystallized worm?
Fang Heng shrugged and explained, “The crystallized worm can only level up by swallowing the blue crystals. Do you understand what I am saying?”
Chen Yu froze on the spot.
He thought to himself, “Understand? Understand my ass! You knew that it would level up after devouring a crystal, yet you still fed the worm with crystals?”
After evolving, wouldn’t a Tier 5 crystallized form be even more difficult to deal with?!
Fang Heng glanced at him and enunciated each word clearly.
“Fatten it up and then kill it.”
As he spoke, Fang Heng shifted his gaze away and looked expectantly at the crystallized worm that had devoured a large amount of blue crystal raw ores.
Killing a Tier 4 mutated creature would at most give him a Tier 2 evolution crystal.
Of course, it was not enough!
Upgrading the Tier 3 space tearing device required high-energy evolution crystals!
A total of three crystals!
That thing could only be dropped by a Tier 5 lifeform!
Apart from that, in theory, killing a Tier 5 creature for the second time in the entire server would also reward him in the form of a skill book!
The enticement was too big, Fang Heng could not help but want to give it a try.
This was currently the best time he could find to kill a Tier 5 mutated creature!
The worm was already on the verge of death. Even if it evolved into a Tier 5 mutant, its condition would not recover significantly in a short period of time.
If he succeeded...
He would gain rewards such as the skill book and the high-energy evolution crystal!
Fang Heng wanted them all!

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - Fatten up and Kill
paragraphs: Chen Yu understood.
He finally understood why he had felt such a pain in the ass for no reason.
Fatten up and kill again?
Was this something humans did?
He felt that Fang Heng was too crazy.
To be able to deal with so many Tier 4 lifeforms was already a miracle in his eyes.
Now, Fang Heng wanted to directly kill Tier 5 lifeforms?
What if the situation got out of hand?
Chen Yu wanted to say something else, but the ground beneath his feet started to tremble again.
Not far away, the body of the crystallized form expanded rapidly in a short period of time.
The body that was originally more than two meters expanded to seven meters!

After the evolution was completed, other than the body expanding further, two additional tentacles grew on the forehead of the Tier 5 crystallized form, and the layer of crystal scales covering its body turned dark red.
Even though the evolution was completed, the corroded wounds on the crystallized form had not fully healed.
Chen Yu’s heart was in his throat.
“Fang Heng, hurry up and kill it.”
Fattening up was fattening up, but now that it was fattened up, wouldn’t it be a joke if he couldn’t kill it now?
Fang Heng’s expression was solemn as he said in a deep voice, “Yes, I know.”
The three Tyrant forms charged at the evolved crystallized form at the same time, trapping the Tier 5 crystallized form in the middle.
“Chi!”
The crystallized worm bit the right arm of a Tyrant into pieces!
Fang Heng quickly took out his walkie-talkie, “Mo Jiawei, quick!”
“Roger!”
The next second, Mo Jiawei pressed the button on the helicopter.
The second plastic box hanging below the helicopter opened in the air.
Chen Yu also looked up, eyes on the box high up in the air.
“Hua!”
What the hell?
Water?
No!
“It’s sulfuric acid!”
A Federation player immediately shouted out in excitement.
The corrosive sulfuric acid solution was sprinkled down from the helicopter.
“Chi Chi Chi!!!”
The special sulfuric acid solution landed on the Tier 5 crystallized worm, immediately evaporating into a thick white mist!
It was another big expense!
They were bought using honor points!
Fang Heng endured the ‘pain’ and stared at the Tier 5 crystallized worm.
This was the sulfuric acid solution that the Dark Knights had spent five to six hours to collect from all the contact points.
It had cost him more than 10,000 honor points!
As long as he could kill the Tier 5 crystallized worm, everything would be worth it!

The crystallized form’s crystallized armour gradually fell off under the corrosive effects of the highly concentrated sulfuric acid. The worm was in severe pain and rolled on the spot, trying to escape.
The three Tyrants would not let it go at all. They worked together to pin the crystallized worm to the ground!
The crystallized worm struggled even more crazily, tearing holes in the Tyrant form!
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Tyrant has received corrosion damage.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Tyrant has received damage from the Tier 5 crystallized worm...]
[Hint: Your zombie clone (proliferator) has died.]

The sulfuric acid solution was extremely corrosive. Coupled with the continuous bites of the Tier 5 crystallized worm, even the three Tyrant forms could not withstand it. Their HP plummeted and they fell one by one.
It was time!
When the crystallized scales on the worm’s body were almost completely corroded, Fang Heng controlled the remaining hundred or so Lickers to surround and attack the crystallized worm!
The Lickers charged forward without any regard for their own lives. In the blink of an eye, they all pounced on the huge body of the crystallized form and attacked with their sharp claws.
The Tier 5 crystallized form was already close to the end of its life. With the addition of the sulfuric acid bath, its HP was once again reduced.
Facing the Lickers, it struggled frantically, trying to throw the Lickers off its body. It kept opening its huge mouth to devour the Lickers.
However, the effect was not good!

Once the Lickers were thrown away, they would rush over again at an extremely fast speed, biting the body of the crystallized form and not letting go! They kept waving their sharp claws to cause superimposed bleeding damage!
In the blink of an eye, red blood flowed out of the body of the Tier 5 crystallized form. The scene was extremely terrifying.
Fang Heng realized that the attack made by the crystallized worm was gradually losing power.
It couldn’t hold on much longer!
“Boom!!!”
The Tier 5 crystallized form exploded on the spot!
The explosion was larger than the previous one.
There was no sign of it.
The explosion enveloped a group of Lickers around the crystallized worm.
A huge blast of air spread out in all directions with dust in it.
In the distance, the Federation players were still watching the intense battle a second ago. The next second, they saw a blast of air that was covered in yellow dust rushing toward them!
“Get down! Now!”
Seeing this, Fang Heng immediately crouched down, hiding behind the bunker that he had just built.
In his retina, rows and rows of game hints flash by.
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker dies from explosion damage.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker dies from explosion damage.]
[Hint: Your Zombie clone trigger skill-Lucky player triggered. Licker is immune to this blast attack.]
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker dies from explosion damage...]
[Hint: You have killed a Tier 5 crystallized form. You have obtained 883 survival points. You have obtained high energy evolution crystal (purple)*1.]
[Hint: Your team has killed a Tier 5 mutated creature for the second time. Due to your performance in the team, you have obtained the highest level additional reward: Random B+ level skill book.]
[Hint: Random draw...]
[Hint: You have received skill book-Guillotine.]
Good!
High energy crystal!
Obtained!
As the dust dispersed, Fang Heng became excited and waved his fist forcefully.
His judgment was correct!
This wave of greed was worth it!
Fang Heng stood up again and looked into the distance.

At the last moment, the Tier 5 crystallized form’s instant self-destruct strength and speed were beyond imagination. It did not give the Lickers any time to escape. Almost all of the Lickers within range were instantly killed.
Only a dozen or so Lickers were lucky enough to activate the passive skill, ‘Lucky player’, to survive the fatal damage.
“It’s settled...”
Finally...
The players who got up from the ground looked into the distance, trying to confirm the condition of the crystallized form.
“We won!!”
“We saved the shelter!”
“F*ck Night Owl! We won!!!”
After receiving the game hint of killing a Tier 5 crystallized form accurately, the Federation players began to cheer.
“Eh? Skill book? I got a reward?”
“What’s going on? Is that a Tier 5 creature?”
After successfully ending the battle, Tang Chu’s tensed mind finally relaxed.
The final explosion was too terrifying. Fortunately, it did not get close.
Tang Chu was rejoicing when he heard the Federation players whispering amongst themselves.
Hmm? Reward?
Tier 5 creature?
Tang Chu was stunned for a moment before quickly opening his game backpack to take a look.
A C+ level skill book lay quietly in his backpack.
Additional reward?!
Tang Chu opened his mouth and was ecstatic.
“Fine, Fang Heng, I admit defeat. But next time, before you do any fancy jobs, can you let me know first?”
Chen Yu touched his chest and let out a huge sigh of relief.
“My heart isn’t too good. I can’t take such a huge shock.”
At this moment, Chen Yu looked at the excited elite players of the Federation and felt a little envious in his heart.
If he had personally gone up to help, he would most likely have obtained a D-level skill book.

chapters.title: Chapter 304 - Guillotine
paragraphs: “Alright, next time, next time.”
Fang Heng replied casually and put the high energy evolution crystal into his backpack in satisfaction. He took out the skill book and looked at it.
[Skill book: Guillotine.]
Type: Skill book (Soul binding, can not be traded).
Description: After learning, master the skill-Guillotine.

Skill description 1: After mastering the skill, passive basic perception +2. When dealing damage to the head of a living being, an additional 30% critical strike success rate bonus will be obtained. If the critical strike is successful, receive an additional (basic perception +20*3)% critical hit damage.
Skill description 2: Every time the skill is upgraded, an additional increase of 2% critical hit success rate (this skill can be upgraded to Level 20 at most).
Not a bad skill!
The skill was related to the basic perception attribute, which meant that there would be room for growth in the later stages of the skill.
What a win!
Fang Heng thought as he slapped the skill book on his head.
[Hint: You have learned the passive skill-Guillotine.]

Seeing that the crystallized form was destroyed, the Federation players packed up their emotions and began to clean up the battlefield under Chen Yu’s command, collecting the remains of the explosion.
With the reward in hand, Fang Heng thought it was time to leave.
Sending the crystal coffin back to the shelter required full protection at all times.
He had to be careful of dangerous things like crystallized forms...
A rope was lowered from the helicopter hovering in the sky.
Fang Heng grabbed the rope and waved goodbye to Chen Yu. “I still have things to do. I’ll go back first. We’ll talk next time we meet.”
“You’re leaving so soon? Aren’t you going to meet the higher-ups of the Federation in the shelter? They must be very grateful for your help.”
“Maybe next time. There are still a lot of things to deal with in the shelter, and the next Blood Moon is coming. The shelter’s defense needs to be strengthened. I’m in a hurry.”
“No. Then how should I write my report after you leave?”
“Just make it up. I believe you.”
Chen Yu smiled bitterly. “Okay then. We’ll contact you if there are any problems later.”
Fang Heng grabbed one end of the rope and climbed up with Lucia.
Halfway up, Fang Heng thought of something and waved at Chen Yu.
“Also, the special ore you promised me has to be done quickly. I’m in a hurry to get it.”
“No problem. I’ll send someone to keep an eye on it.”
After climbing into the back seat of the helicopter, Fang Heng was still unusually excited.
After the battle just now, he had already confirmed that the crystallized worm could be upgraded to Tier 5!
With that, he had a way to get Tier 5 crystallized forms!
All this time, Fang Heng had been troubled by the acquisition of high energy evolution crystals.
To solve this problem, Fang Heng initially thought of looking for high level mutants from the depths of the quarantine zone.
However, the deeper he went into the quarantine zone, the greater the negative high-density virus would affect the zombies.
Even the Tyrant couldn’t go deep into the quarantine zone.
Later on, Fang Heng even had designs on the Blood Moon.
Fang Heng wanted to get more players to increase the difficulty of the Blood Moon.
By then, the Blood Moon would spawn Tier 5 zombies!
But...
Tier 5 was Tier 5.
If he accidentally spawned five or six Tier 5 Berserk Corpse Kings, even with the zombie team and the light cannon turrets, his shelter wouldn’t be able to hold on...
But now, it was different!
Fang Heng’s heart raced.
With the crystallized form, he could think of a way to create a Tier 5 creature and kill it himself!
In a short while, Fang Heng had already come up with a new plan.
If everything went smoothly...
Upgrading to Tier 3 space tearing device might be faster than he thought!
“Ahem, Fang Heng, where should we go next?”
Fang Heng couldn’t wait any longer.
“Let’s go to the Dark Knights’ contact point and send the crystallized form back to Qiu Yaokang for him to study.”
A scarlet red covered the sky.
Outside the moat built by the prison, a large group of zombies swarmed toward the prison.
Gunshots were heard from the sentry towers.
The Lickers broke into the zombie team and charged at the zombies, using their numerical advantage to kill the Tier 1 to 2 mutated zombies.
“Roar!!”
The Tyrant form roared and rushed forward, grabbing the Little Corpse King’s head with both hands.
“Swoosh -! Boom!”
The blue light cannon pierced through the Little Corpse King’s head and caused another explosion.
[Hint: You have killed a Tier 4 Little Corpse King. You have obtained 182 survival points, Tier 2 evolution crystal*1.]
Fang Heng stood on the sentry tower and observed the entire battlefield.
[Hint: The current round of the Blood Moon has ended. The third round of the Blood Moon will begin in 15 days. Please prepare carefully.]
“That’s it?”
Fang Heng sounded a little confused.
Mo Jiawei used his binoculars to scan the surroundings of the prison once again.
“There are still some low-level zombies left. We’ll be able to get rid of them soon. We can announce that the Blood Moon has passed smoothly this time.”
“Alright, let Liao Bufan prepare to evacuate the players in the safe house below.”
Hearing what Mo Jiawei said, Fang Heng regretted it.
It was low!
This time, the Blood Moon difficulty could be increased by a few levels, and he could also take a few more Tier 2 evolution crystals.
To prevent accidents from happening, he also prepared a large number of explosives between the inner and outer walls of the prison.
The ordinary vine zombies did not participate in the battle. They all gathered in the inner circle of the shelter to prepare for defense.
The automatic turrets that Victor spent a lot of effort building were also set to standby mode and did not join the battle.

Originally, Fang Heng wanted the elite Dark Knights to hold off the zombie horde for a while. He wanted them to use their guns to shoot at the zombie horde and gain more experience points. Who knows, they might even be able to level up or something.
But in the end...
He did not use any of the subsequent preparations!
Fang Heng pursed his lips and said helplessly, “It’s so weak. Even the periphery of the prison hasn’t been broken through. It’s impossible to show the full strength of our shelter...”
It’s not even strong enough?
He had already killed eight Tier 4 Little Corpse Kings!
Besides the two of them, Chen Yu was deeply shocked.
That was a light cannon turret!
It was something that only existed in the later stages of the game!
Fang Heng had four shelters!
How did he get them?
Chen Yu turned his head and looked at Fang Heng silently, sighing deeply in his heart.
Every time he met Fang Heng, he would always come up with something strange. It was shocking.
“Sigh! I am suffering from lack of experience...”
Fang Heng sighed softly, patted Chen Yu’s shoulder and handed him a bottle of happy water.
“How is it? Is my shelter okay?”
“Ahem, yes, it is.”
Chen Yu adjusted his expression and unscrewed the cap.
He felt that he was representing the Federation, so he couldn’t be as shocked as before.
It was too embarrassing.
“So what about the follow-up plan I mentioned to you before? For the next Blood Moon, send more people over and raise the Blood Moon’s level a little. These monsters ain’t enough for me to fight.”
“Yeah, it can indeed be raised a little. It should be enough to raise it by another 3 levels.”
“Only 3 levels? I think it should be raised to Level 60.”
“Pfft!!”
The happy water that Chen Yu had just drunk immediately sprayed out of his mouth.
“What did you say?”
“Level 60?”
Seeing that Fang Heng did not have any intention of joking, Chen Yu’s familiar pain in the balls came back.

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - Research Progress
paragraphs: Chen Yu wiped his mouth and said, “Fang Heng, when Blood Moon reaches Level 50, there will be a Tier 5 Berserk Corpse King. Berserk Corpse King is no joke.”
“Don’t worry. My shelter has light cannon turrets and the Tyrant form. The crystallized worm last time was also a Tier 5 creature. I’m not afraid.”

“Berserk Corpse King is different. With Blood Moon, the Berserk Corpse King’s overall strength is the strongest among the Tier 5 creatures. If it’s Level 60, there must be more than one Berserk Corpse King.”
“I’ve done my homework, and I have a secret weapon.”
Fang Heng laughed.
“This...” Seeing Fang Heng’s confidence, Chen Yu hesitated. “Fang Heng, seriously, are you sure?”
“Of course, you know me.”
Chen Yu frowned and thought for a moment. He sighed in his heart and nodded silently.
“Okay, I will submit the report.”
Chen Yu knew very well that even if he rejected Fang Heng, with Fang Heng’s personality, he would try to increase the difficulty of the Blood Moon.
Rather than that, it was better to agree with him and try to ensure the safety and control of the entire Blood Moon.
“I knew it. You’re the most reliable person in the Federation.”
“Fang Heng, don’t say that out loud...” Chen Yu smiled bitterly. “I’ll contact you again next time. I have to go offline to check on the situation in the other shelters.”
With that, Chen Yu threw down a simple bed and went offline.
“Goodbye.”
Fang Heng rubbed his hands excitedly.
The success rate of the plan had increased by a notch when the Federation was recruited.
Next, it was time to count the harvest.
Fang Heng was looking forward to it again.
Looking down, outside the outermost wall of the prison, there was already a layer of evolution crystals and materials dropped by zombies on the ground.
A great harvest!
Fang Heng jumped down from a high place and waved at the layer of crystals on the ground.
A huge amount of evolution crystals were sucked into Fang Heng’s body.
[Hint: You have obtained evolution crystal fragments*51,672, complete evolution crystal*3872, Tier 1 evolution cystal*688, Tier 2 evolution cystal*7.]
Large and small evolution crystals floated around Fang Heng.
It was a huge harvest!
“Bang!”
Fang Heng’s opened right hand clenched into a fist.
In an instant, all the Tier 1 evolution crystals hovering around Fang Heng exploded.
A thick blood color that was almost solid enveloped Fang Heng’s entire body.
The mark on the back of Fang Heng’s hand appeared clearly again.
With the mark as the centre, a red vortex was formed and greedily devoured the surrounding blood color.
In the blink of an eye, the blood color was completely absorbed in one breath.
[Hint: Player’s level has risen to Level 18. Due to your talent skill, you have gained 41 zombie clones. Your current zombie clone count is 243.]
The soil under Fang Heng’s feet gradually rolled.
The 41 zombie clones crawled out of the soil one by one.
It wasn’t easy! He had finally levelled up again!
Fang Heng took a deep breath and glanced at the zombie clones behind him.
To most other players, every round of the Blood Moon was torture.
Fang Heng didn’t think so.
He thought that the setting of the Blood Moon in the game was great!
Points, equipment and materials.
Well, it was best to do it once a day!
That way, he could upgrade to Level 19 earlier.
As he was thinking, Fang Heng took another look at his character panel.
The number of experience points needed to reach Level 19 was massive, ten times more than when he reached Level 17 or 18.
He would have to wait 15 days for the next Blood Moon.
If nothing unexpected happened in the short term, it would be very difficult to reach Level 19.
Fang Heng closed his character panel.
The most important thing now was to think of a way to level up the space tearing device to Tier 3.
First, he had to think of a way to complete the world’s main storyline mission.
When he obtained ownership of the world, he would slowly develop and level up.
Fang Heng was originally planning to go to the mechanical laboratory to look for Victor.
He did not find him.
In the end, on the way back, he was intercepted by Qiu Yaokang and was directly dragged to the underground research laboratory.
“The crystallized form is an extremely special life form. It is different from any other life form known on Earth. Its evolution method is very strange.”
Qiu Yaokang had just received the analysis report of the crystallized form that he had worked overtime last night.
This was also the first time he had seen such a special life form.
Although his eyes were bloodshot, Qiu Yaokang was extremely excited.

“At the beginning, their evolution method was to devour the special energy in the blue crystal ores. From the middle stage of evolution, the evolution pattern began to change. It needs to devour flesh and blood to further evolve.”
Through the glass, Fang Heng observed the white worm that was placed in the container.
It looked harmless.
“Can it evolve indefinitely?”
“In theory, but only in theory. The later the evolution, the more energy the crystallized form needs to absorb.”
Qiu Yaokang led Fang Heng through the three glass containers.
The three glass containers contained the crystallized worms of Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3.
“Compared with zombies of the same tier, the crystallized worms are not strong in actual combat. Their biggest weakness is their slow movement speed.”

“After evolving into a Tier 1-3 mutated variant, the main change of the crystallized worms is the expansion of their body size, the formation of the crystallized armour under their skin and their sharp mouthparts. There are no other changes.”
“Its mouthpart is extremely sharp. A Tier 3 crystallized worm can already cause damage to ultra-strong tempered glass.”
“For safety reasons, our experiments are limited to this.”
“Also, if they stop absorbing energy for a long period, they will degenerate.”
In the next second, a row of game hints flashed in front of the retina.
[Hint: You have placed a special creature-crystallized creature in the research room.]
[Hint: Your shelter level has met the minimum requirements for safe placement of crystallized creatures.]
[Hint: You have triggered a special research item-crystallized creature.]
[Hint: Research on the crystallized creature requires the shelter to be at Level 300 and the laboratory to be at Level 300. The player’s shelter does not meet the requirements for research.]
“So high? Shelter Level 300?”
Fang Heng was shocked.
Even the Federation of Server 7 couldn’t do that, let alone him!
Qiu Yaokang walked to Fang Heng and asked, “Fang Heng, what do you suggest?”
“Forget it, Qiu Yaokang. I suggest that we suspend the research on the crystallized creature and think of a solution when the time is right.”
“I’m a little surprised that you gave up so quickly.” Qiu Yaokang looked at Fang Heng and said, “I thought you would ask me if I could find a way to fuse the crystallized creature with your zombie.”
That’s right! There’s still this method!
Fang Heng was excited.
“Can you?”
“No.”
Fang Heng thought to himself, “You must be kidding me.”
Qiu Yaokang turned around and looked at the crystallized form inside the glass cover.

“With our current technology, it’s difficult to study this creature. Keeping it for now is the best choice. There’s not much connection between it and the T-virus, so there’s no need to study it urgently.”
“Alright, forget it then.”

Berserk Corpse King is no joke.”
“Don’t worry.
My shelter has light cannon turrets and the Tyrant form.

I’m not afraid.”

“Of course, you know me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 306 - Weakness
paragraphs: Fang Heng touched his chin.
He looked at the white worms in the petri dish through the glass container.
“What about their weakness? Did you find their weakness?”
“There’s no special weakness. They can withstand the extra high temperature. By the way, they are a little resistant to water, but the water can’t cause any damage to them.”
“A special solution with high corrosive properties can destroy their outer crystallized armour, which should be used against them...”
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up, and he could not help but interrupt, “You mean the sulfuric acid howitzer?”

“The sulfuric acid howitzer is a recommended targeted weapon, but its corrosive properties are not enough. It needs to be improved more before it can completely dissolve the outer crystallized armour.”
“Then do you have a way to make it? It’s urgent.”
Fang Heng felt that bringing Qiu Yaokang into his shelter was one of his wisest investments!
The sulfuric acid howitzer had been proven to be effective against crystallized worms. He did not expect Qiu Yaokang to think of a way to continue improving the corrosiveness of the howitzer.
This way, the plan to upgrade the crystallized form to Tier 5 before killing it would be more stable!
“Sure, but I need a lot of raw materials, the most important of which is a large amount of sulfuric acid and an active enzyme intermediate substance... you can write it down...”
As he spoke, Qiu Yaokang reported a series of expensive chemical agents’ names.
Fang Heng suddenly felt a little headache.
“D*mn it, how much will this cost?”
Previously, to deal with the Tier 5 crystallized form, he had almost purchased the entire Dark Knights’ storage of sulfuric acid and spent more than 10,000 honor points.
The initial investment for the Tier 3 space tearing device project was too large. He had heard that the money earned by Blood Moon this time had been almost spent...
“Can we save some money?”
“Of course.”
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched. “Really?”
“Of course it’s true, but the effect will be greatly reduced.”
Fang Heng: “...”
After arguing with Qiu Yaokang for a while and finalizing the required materials, Fang Heng finally found Victor and Mo Jiawei in the underground hall of the space tearing device.
Victor was checking the tools.
Seeing that Fang Heng had come, he put down the work in his hands.
“Fang Heng, you came at the right time.”
“I just went to check on the light cannon. It’s not bad. For safety reasons, a few parts still need to be dismantled and maintained. It’s no problem to deal with the next wave of the Blood Moon.”

“In addition, the analysis of the blue crystal ore that we obtained two days ago has also been completed. The information you provided before includes the production of blue energy crystals, so this aspect is relatively easy.”
Fang Heng was pleasantly surprised. “So blue energy crystals can be produced?”
“Almost, there is a very big problem that needs to be solved.”
“Refining blue energy crystals requires a type of ore called pyroxene. I have checked and our shelter does not have the corresponding reserves, so we need to purchase it from others.”
“In the morning, I already sent out a request, but the results are not very good.”
Mo Jiawei spread his hands as he spoke.
“I thought it was strange, so I sent someone to ask around.”

“I just received a report that a gaming company called Crimson Technology Company had announced two days ago that they were collecting and buying pyroxenes. The players’ pyroxenes were almost all taken by this company.”
“Later, I contacted Crimson Technology Company and offered to buy some from them, but they said that rare ores aren’t for sale.”
Fang Heng was puzzled. “Not selling them? The price is too low?”
“Ten times the market price, not too low. I don’t think they have any intention of selling them, and I don’t want to be a sucker.”
Mo Jiawei was used to throwing money at others and was able to offer ten times the market price.
But he was still rejected.
Mo Jiawei felt that it was a little strange.
“Pyroxene isn’t very useful to begin with, and it’s usually only used in the later stages. Why would they buy so many pyroxenes? Could it be that they also found a blue crystal mine?”
Fang Heng lowered his head and pondered.
Was it for sale? Or was there another use for it?
“Also, Fang Heng, the rare metal materials that the Federation promised us have been gradually delivered. I’ve already gotten the specific list.”
“I’ve just discussed it with Victor. Other than the remaining five special rare ore resources and a gap in the resources, we’ve already met the construction conditions.”
Speaking of the Tier 3 space tearing device, Victor’s spirits were lifted.
A parallel time tunnel!
This was an epoch-making product!
Personally creating this miracle was enough to make him so excited that he could not sleep for several nights.

“Yes, I’ve already begun to modify the space tearing device. Currently, two-thirds of the upgrade has been completed. Once the remaining materials are in place, the upgrade can be completed immediately. It won’t take more than a day.”
Fang Heng calculated in his heart.

“In other words, currently, there are still two high energy evolution crystals, five types of special rare ore resources and a large number of pyroxenes to complete the Tier 3 space tearing device, right?”
Victor and Mo Jiawei looked at each other and nodded in unison.
Fang Heng scratched his head.
There was no rush for the special ore resources and pyroxene. He could only slowly purchase them from the outside world.
Then let’s start with the high energy evolution crystals!
Crimson Technology Building.
On the 19th floor.
A long-distance projection conference was in progress.
All those who were invited to participate in the conference were famous big guilds in Server 8.
He Liang, in a suit and leather shoes, stood in the centre of each projection area.
Facing the projection of the elite executives of various gaming companies and guilds, He Liang spoke with confidence.
“Thank you all for taking the time to come. The relevant information has already been shared with you in advance, so I’ll be brief.”
“Ever since North River Heavy Industry and Fang Heng reached an agreement half a month ago, their influence has rapidly expanded in Server 8.”
“Just three days ago, I received news from the Federation that Fang Heng can already control the Licker and even the Tyrant to fight. The threat factor is as high as S.”
Phoenix Sound Gaming Company’s Li Ru added, “Our Phoenix Sound can verify the reliability of the news.”

“At this rate of development, I’m afraid it won’t be more than a month. Including our Crimson Technology, all the gaming company’s unions will be eliminated early and will withdraw from the fight for District 8’s overlord.”
He Liang swept his gaze across the crowd.
“If you don’t want to be eliminated, we’ll temporarily join forces. Attacking the prison side together is the only option.”
Amidst the silence, a white-haired old man in a long robe opened his mouth to ask.
“Cut the crap. We all know the threat from the prison side. Taking the initiative to attack is no different from hitting a rock with an egg. What suggestion do you have for us to come here?”
“Mr Zhou has sharp eyes.”
He Liang had already planned everything out. He smiled and slowly explained, “Currently, the prison is extremely powerful. Just as Mr Zhou said, it is not advisable to take action personally.”
“But we can get someone else to do it for us.”
“Who?”
“The three major Federations.”
“In 24 hours, the special event of Server 8 will open. The special area will also open. Including us, the player guilds of the four major Federations will participate in this battle.”
“During the special event, NPCs cannot join. Without the assistance of the Dark Knights, Fang Heng will not be able to control the Lickers to fight. His strength will be greatly reduced.”

chapters.title: Chapter 307 - Special Event
paragraphs: “Therefore, my plan is for all of us to withdraw from this special event this time, leaving only the prison side to participate in the fight against the players from the other three major federal regions.”

“Our team has done a data model analysis. According to our preconceived assumptions, as long as all of our major guild companies do not participate in this special event, Fang Heng’s death rate in the game will be as high as 99% .”
Everyone fell silent again after hearing this.
In the game, players would not immediately revive after they died. Instead, they would be punished and would not be able to enter the game for some time.
This period was enough for them to join forces to deal with the prison.
“It seems to be feasible.” Li Ru asked, “But how can you be sure that he will participate in this special event? Fang Heng is not easy to deal with.”
“He will go. I have received news that Fang Heng is in desperate need of pyroxene ore.”
“We just need to spread the news that there will be rewards for pyroxene ore in this special event competition. Fang Heng will participate.”
“After he goes there, he will realize that our Eastern Region only has a few scattered regions. That scene will be very interesting.”
“Even if he luckily passes the first stage, the other three Federations’ game guilds will swallow him up!”
He Liang smiled.
“Admittedly, giving up on participating in this special event is a loss for us. Choosing the lesser of two evils should be something that everyone should understand.”
“If there are no objections, let’s vote. This news must not be leaked in advance.”
[Hint: Your book-Occult Guide (current reading progress: 10.01%).]
In the study, Fang Heng put down the occult book and rubbed his temples.
Since the last Blood Moon ended, these two days had been quite fulfilling.
During the day, he read and slept. At night, he took Sandy everywhere to accept missions and bring strong men back to the shelter.
Fang Heng casually turned on his phone and looked at the latest news.
Huh?
In the forum of Server 8, a red headline at the top attracted Fang Heng’s attention.
“The first battle of Server 8! Special event will begin in 24 hours. Federation’s major forces in the Eastern Region take stock!”
Fang Heng was curious and clicked on it.
He opened the post and quickly skimmed through the content. Fang Heng suddenly understood.
Special event!
He almost forgot.

In today’s world, the world was divided into four major Federations. The four Federations were independent and were collectively known as the Global Federation. They were controlled by the Central Assembly.
The game world seemed to follow this rule.
According to the initial location of the player who entered the game, most of the players from the four federal regions would appear randomly in the four pre-distributed regions in the game.
The territory of the apocalypse game was very large. Fang Heng had never been to other areas of the world except for the last time he searched for the furnace.
It seemed that to provoke disputes between players, in the elementary game, a special event would occur once every six months or so.
This was a special event that targeted players since the game was opened. The special event encouraged players to fight against one another.
In the beginning, the Federation appealed to the player guilds to be rational and allocate resources together. They did not want to make unnecessary sacrifices.
Unfortunately, the effect was very limited.
Resources that could be obtained during special events were too abundant and very attractive!

Not only did the gaming union factions that belonged to different federal regions fight for resources, but sometimes when they were anxious, even their own people from the same federal region would also fight for resources.
In the end, the Federation simply did not stop them. They even sent people to participate.
Of course, the Federation would never take the initiative to attack the players.
When he saw the description of the reward for this special event in the post, Fang Heng’s eyes immediately lit up!
What kind of treasures were these!
A large number of special ores! A large number of guns and weapons! A large number of food and materials! A large number of high-level tools!
The ores included pyroxene!
Fang Heng’s heart was thumping wildly.
He couldn’t miss it! He definitely had to participate in this special event!
If he could use this opportunity to obtain pyroxene and remaining special rare ores, the progress of the Tier 3 space tearing device would be accelerated!

However, this special event seemed to be quite troublesome. Apart from facing a high-intensity zombie horde, he would also have to face a large number of players from the other three federal regions. Even the Federation would also participate in this event.
Fang Heng was thinking about it when his phone rang.
It was Chen Yu.
Chen Yu’s tone was sour. “Congratulations, Fang Heng. You’ve made a big profit again.”
“Huh? What big profit?”
“The shelter has re-examined the iron mine. They found that the signal of the blue crystal ore has become unusually weak. They concluded that this mine has been mined.”
Chen Yu sighed silently.

“Fang Heng, don’t tell me you don’t know about this. Night Owl’s people have never had time to mine the blue crystal ores, and the Federation has never done so. In Server 8, the only person who has the ability to mine this area is you.”
D*mn, the elimination method!
Fang Heng felt that he could not defend himself.
“Oh, well, it’s a small profit. Why? Your Federation can’t be so stingy as to ask me to return the ores right?”
“Stop joking, the name of our Federation isn’t written on the ores. You obtained it through normal means and the superiors have no reason to ask you for it.”
Chen Yu’s internal monologue, “Don’t I understand you? Even if I ask you to return the ores, you won’t give them back.”

The Federation had already discussed it internally. Currently, everything was based on the premise of stabilizing Server 8. There was no need for them to get into an argument with Fang Heng over this small amount of ores.
Moreover, it was much better for the ores to land in Fang Heng’s hands than it was in the hands of Night Owl’s group.

“Because of the Night Owl incident, Zhang Zhe has already been arranged for an internal investigation. I reckon that this period of time will not be easy. After the investigation is over, there will still be many troublesome matters waiting for him. By the way, my outstanding performance has also been acknowledged by my superiors. I’ve been promoted.”
“Haha, congratulations, congratulations. Let’s go out for a drink when there’s time. It’s on you.”
“Definitely, definitely. It’s all thanks to your help.”

Chen Yu’s mood was still very good. “The superiors really want to know how you managed to control the Tyrant. The Federation really wants to obtain technology related to this. You can casually mention the terms of the exchange.”
“There’s no need to think about it. This thing is not for sale. This time, working with your Federation has also caused me to lose a large number of Lickers and Tyrant forms.”
Fang Heng started to whine and sighed, “Sigh! The losses were huge.”
Chen Yu listened to Fang Heng’s words and was almost fooled at first. He wanted to comfort him.
As the words were on the tip of his tongue, he suddenly felt that something was not right.
Chen Yu scratched his head.
“But Fang Heng, when I visited your shelter last time, the Tyrants and Lickers were also there, right?”
“And it seems that you were the one who chose to let Tier 4 crystallized form evolve, right? This loss is within your expectations, right?”
Fang Heng felt that Chen Yu seemed to have learned a lot during this period of time, and it was getting harder and harder to trick him.
“Alright, if you change your mind, feel free to contact me. Our Federation is very sincere.”
“I understand. If I have any intentions, I will contact you.”
Chen Yu cleared his throat and continued, “There’s another very important matter. Have you heard that a special event is about to start?”

sentences.text: “Therefore, my plan is for all of us to withdraw from this special event this time, leaving only the prison side to participate in the fight against the players from the other three major federal regions.”
“Our team has done a data model analysis.
According to our preconceived assumptions, as long as all of our major guild companies do not participate in this special event, Fang Heng’s death rate in the game will be as high as 99% .”
Everyone fell silent again after hearing this.
In the game, players would not immediately revive after they died.
Instead, they would be punished and would not be able to enter the game for some time.
This period was enough for them to join forces to deal with the prison.
“It seems to be feasible.” Li Ru asked, “But how can you be sure that he will participate in this special event?
Fang Heng is not easy to deal with.”
“He will go.
I have received news that Fang Heng is in desperate need of pyroxene ore.”
“We just need to spread the news that there will be rewards for pyroxene ore in this special event competition.
Fang Heng will participate.”
“After he goes there, he will realize that our Eastern Region only has a few scattered regions.
That scene will be very interesting.”
“Even if he luckily passes the first stage, the other three Federations’ game guilds will swallow him up!”
He Liang smiled.
“Admittedly, giving up on participating in this special event is a loss for us.
Choosing the lesser of two evils should be something that everyone should understand.”
“If there are no objections, let’s vote.
This news must not be leaked in advance.”

chapters.title: Chapter 308 - Entry
paragraphs: “Yes, I just heard.”
“So you will participate?”
“Of course, there are things I need from this special event. What about you?”
“Yes, as usual, our Federation will participate this time. The person in charge of this operation is Yu Jie, the supervisor of the desert shelter.”
“The four major Federations have always been fighting openly. My superiors hope that we can get a good result, so if we meet in the game, let’s take care of each other.”
“Of course, no problem.”
Fang Heng nodded in agreement.
After chatting with Chen Yu about cooperating after entering the special event, Fang Heng meditated for a moment and logged into the game again.
As soon as he logged in, the game hint rang.
[Hint: The special event will begin in 12 hours.]

[Player detected to have a shelter higher than Level 5. The player will participate as a team captain in the game. According to the player’s current shelter level, the player can bring up to 19 players to participate in this special event.]
[Hint: NPC survivors cannot join the special event.]
[Hint: The location of this special event — Haramori City.]
[Hint: In this special event, the player will be subjected to special conditions. The player will also be punished upon death. The player cannot exit after joining the mission.]
[Hint: Haramori City will be opened to the public in 16 hours.]
[Hint: Player is invited to enter Haramori City through special teleportation at any apocalypse merchant camp within 16 hours.]
[Hint: Player who fails to accept the mission will be punished by additional negative effects when entering Haramori City.]
[Hint: After entering the special teleportation passage, other than the evolution crystals, all unrelated items in the player’s backpack will be temporarily emptied.]
“16 hours...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself and immediately controlled the zombie team to commit suicide in batches.
Three hours later, Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei arrived at the apocalypse merchant camp together.
Fang Heng originally wanted to bring Lucia along to participate in the mission.
Unfortunately, the NPCs could not participate, so he could only bring Mo Jiawei to form a team.
They could not bring materials to the special event. It would be troublesome if there were too many people.
Mo Jiawei’s combat ability was very weak, but his support talent skill was still very effective.
He also had a hidden skill-‘Luck’.
The apocalypse merchant camp was very lively. When Fang Heng went there, he found that the original cabin had been transformed into a small bar.
Many NPCs were sitting in the bar drinking.
The apocalypse merchant, Vettel, was at the bar counter, waving to Fang Heng.
“Fang Heng, you’re also here for that special event, right?”
Fang Heng walked forward with a smile and replied, “Of course, how can such a lively event not include me?”
“Hey, take it. Be careful not to let others see it.”
Taking advantage of the fact that no one was paying attention, Vettel quietly stuffed a piece of paper into Fang Heng’s hand.
He leaned over and whispered in Fang Heng’s ear.
“My friends and I have set up a bet. All the money I’ve earned in the past half a month has been placed on you. Do your best, don’t let me down.”
[Hint: You have obtained Vettel’s information*1.]
[Hint: This item cannot be activated on its own accord. After entering the special event, the player will passively trigger the intelligence message.]
Fang Heng remained calm and collected as he quickly put away the piece of paper.
He also quietly whispered into Vettel’s ear, “Vettel, to be honest, can you still add people to your bet? We can earn money together.”
Vettel winked at Fang Heng, “That won’t do. We only accept insider participation.”
“Then you wait for a while. I’ll go and contact Lucia.”
[Hint: Player takes on the role of captain and enters a special event. Player: Mo Jiawei, share the team’s safe time.]
[Hint: Player’s backpack will be temporarily emptied of the unrelated items (other than evolution crystals).]
[Hint: In a special event state, your satiety will be increased by 5 times.]
[Hint: The current game event may be affected by external factors, please be careful.]
[Hint: The current game event has player hostile missions, please be careful.]
[Hint: Player will also be punished after death in the current game. Gun-type damage between players will be reduced by 50%. Please be careful.]
[Hint: Player team initially has 6 hours of safe time. The player can look for ways to increase the safe time in the game. When the safe time is zero, all players in the team will be eliminated.]
[Hint: During the special game event, the player will be eliminated after leaving Haramori City for 3 minutes.]
[Hint: No matter how the player is eliminated, the player will die by default.]
[Hint: Player is currently deployed to the Eastern faction.]
[Hint: The player triggered mission-Faction.]
Mission name: Faction.
Mission difficulty: S.

Mission requirements: Obtain higher points and prevent other factions from obtaining points (after the special event, 1,000,000 points will be distributed to each faction as a percentage, and the faction leader will obtain points).
Mission reward: Points (After the end of the special event, the player can use the points to exchange for various materials).
[Hint: The player triggered mission-Assemble.]
Mission name: Assemble.
Mission difficulty: B.
Mission requirements: Please assemble at the city’s East Square within 180 minutes.
Mission reward: None.
Punishment for failure: Elimination.
Fang Heng opened his eyes and found himself and Mo Jiawei in an old storage room.
He quickly looked around, but there was no danger. He immediately opened his backpack.
Other than the evolution crystal and a note from Vettel, there was nothing else in his backpack.
Fang Heng carefully read the game log again.
Before joining the mission, Fang Heng had gathered some information through Chen Yu and Mo Jiawei.
Special events were different from normal games.
It encouraged players from different regions to kill each other.
Fang Heng opened the game’s built-in map again.
The two of them were in the storage room behind a convenience store near the eastern edge of Haramori City.
The gathering point indicated by the mission was about two kilometres away from here.
Fang Heng brought Mo Jiawei into the game. The two of them formed a team by default, and the time passed by minute by minute.
“Are you ready?”
“Yes, it’s a bit difficult.”
Mo Jiawei looked around, trying to find a suitable weapon.
Fang Heng walked to the wall and forcefully broke off a section of the iron pipe on the wall. He held it in his hand and tried to wave it a few times.
“Here, use this.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he threw the iron pipe to Mo Jiawei and broke off another section.
“Hurry up, let’s go.”
Fang Heng walked forward and kicked the door.
“Bang!”
With a loud sound, the wooden door was kicked open by Fang Heng.
Looking around, the convenience store had been looted. The shelves were all lying on the ground in a mess.
The five or six zombies standing in the hall turned their heads at the same time and staggered toward Fang Heng and the others.
With a lack of medicine to treat infection, they would be eliminated if they were accidentally infected with the zombie virus
“Be careful.”
Fang Heng reminded them. He raised the iron pipe in his hand and approached the nearest zombie carefully.

chapters.title: Chapter 309 - Vettel’s Spoiler
paragraphs: “Swish!”
The iron pipe flew through the air, creating a loud sound as it smashed down on the zombie’s head.
“Bang!!!”
Under the bonus of high strength and agility attributes, Fang Heng used the iron pipe and smashed the zombie’s head into pieces!
The zombie fell to the ground.
[Hint: You deal critical damage to the zombie, the zombie dies. Your skill-guillotine experience point +1. You gain an additional 12 seconds of team survival time. Special event points: 1.]
Fang Heng quickly glanced at the game log.
Killing zombies could earn safe time and points!
Moreover, after the game ended, points could be exchanged for various materials and rewards!
Among them were the ore resources like pyroxene that the shelter was lacking.
Not bad.
It seemed to be quite easy.
Fang Heng licked his lips.
If everything went smoothly, in another hour, when the zombie clones resurrected, the Lickers could be used to hunt ordinary zombies to earn points.
Fang Heng was full of fighting spirit. He raised the iron pipe and quickly disposed of the few remaining zombies in the convenience store.
Mo Jiawei took advantage of this time to roughly search the shelves of the convenience store.
He was a little disappointed.
“God, I’ve searched the entire convenience store. It’s very clean. Except for this, there’s nothing left.”
While speaking, Mo Jiawei waved the map of the city in his hand.
“Let’s go out and take a look.”
While speaking, Fang Heng took the lead and walked out of the convenience store.
The zombie horde on the street smelled the scent of a living person. They slowly turned their heads and looked at Fang Heng.
Fang Heng stood at the entrance and scanned the surrounding area.
The scattered area was full of ordinary zombies. The density was not high, and they were relatively easy to deal with.
In most cases, it wasn’t difficult to get rid of them.
The most troublesome thing was the decreasing satiety.
Mo Jiawei looked at the map of the city that he had just found and pointed to one side. “God, the East Square is in that direction.”
Fang Heng calculated the time. Three hours was more than enough to cover the 2000-meter distance.
The difficult part was the sudden zombie attack.

In addition, according to the experience from previous special events, after players entered a special event, most of the Tier 1 missions were to assemble. After assembling, the Tier 2 mission would be to resist the zombie wave.
If possible, they needed to prepare in advance for the next phase of resisting the zombie wave.
For example, they needed to collect some survival materials along the way, such as better weapons, food that could restore satiety, materials that could be used to make traps, and so on.
“We’ll head towards the East Square first. Let’s see if we can find some food along the way.”
Just as Fang Heng was about to head towards the East Square, another game hint flashed on his retina.
[Hint: Your special item-Vettel’s intelligence, currently available.]
“Eh?”
Fang Heng let out a soft exclamation of surprise. He stopped and opened the note in his backpack.
He read it out in a low voice.
“City Street — No. 3822, Wendy.”
[Hint: You have triggered a special mission-Vettel’s spoiler.]
Mission description: Vettel’s spoiler.
Mission difficulty: S.
Mission requirements: Please go to City Street No. 3822 to look for Wendy. Wendy will give you a hint for the next mission.

[Hint: This mission is not the only mission. At least 12 players have accepted the mission. All players have a competitive relationship. If any other player finishes Wendy’s special mission first, the mission will fail by default.]
Mo Jiawei saw that Fang Heng did not move and asked in confusion, “God, what’s wrong?”
“A strange mission has been triggered.”
Since the mission couldn’t be shared, Fang Heng could only try to give a rough description of the mission objective.
Upon hearing this, Mo Jiawei immediately pondered in his heart.
According to Fang Heng’s usual policy thinking, it was better to be greedy..
This mission seemed to be very powerful.
Fang Heng would most likely not miss it.

The assemble mission lasted three hours, which was more than enough.
After one hour, his first batch of zombie clones would be resurrected.
Theoretically, he could finish the special mission first!
Greed was secondary...
The main reason was that he couldn’t let down the trust of the apocalypse merchant, Vettel!
Therefore, he had to be greedy this time!
Fang Heng’s eyes lit up, and he raised his head and said, “You’re right. Let’s go and complete the special mission first.”
“But, Fang Heng...”
Mo Jiawei opened the map and calculated, “City Street No. 3822 is in the centre of the city.”
“Even if the journey ahead is safe and stable, it will take us about an hour and a half to walk there. If we encounter zombies on the way, we won’t have enough time.”
Fang Heng nodded, and then continued in response to Mo Jiawei, “So, we need to find a scooter.”
Find a scooter?
Mo Jiawei was stunned for a moment.
“God, are you sure you can find something that affects the balance of the game?”
“It’s difficult, but finding a less damaged vehicle and repairing it will be enough. After all, I act as a support, and repairing a vehicle is a necessary skill for a qualified support.”
“Hey, God, you’re on the roll again, aren’t you?”
Mo Jiawei smiled bitterly, thinking that getting a vehicle was not as simple as Fang Heng said!
“Hahaha, I’m just joking to ease the tension.”
Fang Heng leaned his head closer to the map and patted Mo Jiawei’s shoulder warmly.
“Come, Old Mo, which of these three repair shops do you think is the most pleasing to the eye?”
“God, don’t believe in metaphysics. It’s not reliable.”
Mo Jiawei had a bitter expression on his face as he casually pointed, “I think... How about this one?”

After taking their positions, Yu Jie immediately split the federal team into a few small groups to search for materials around the meeting point. He also temporarily set up a few roadblocks and traps to prepare for the upcoming wave of zombies.
However, nearly an hour had passed, and only about 30 players had gathered at the East Square.
Yu Jie had experienced a few special incidents on other servers in the past.
In the past, there were at least thousands of players gathered at this time.
Was it because of the new server that there were so few players?
But it was too few!
There were not even 100 players?
Yu Jie realized that this special event was not normal.

“Captain, Lynch has triggered a special mission. The mission requirement is to go to City Street No. 3822 to find NPC Wendy. The mission may be completed by others first. Do we need to send someone to check this mission?”
“Don’t waste time.”
Yu Jie waved his hand.
He had experienced several special incidents and was very experienced.
“This mission cannot be completed by one person. It requires the cooperation of a large team. Three hours is not enough. We will consider it after we get through Tier 2.”
“Yes!”
Yu Jie knew very well that the mission process at the beginning of every special incident was similar.

chapters.title: Chapter 310 - Auto Repair Shop
paragraphs: The first mission was for the players from all four regions to assemble.
The player would encounter all kinds of dangers in the middle of the assembly, most of which were zombie attacks.
This was the first round of the King of Gods’ selection.
After assembling, the player would be asked to build a line of defense in place, collect materials and resources, and resist the zombie wave.
This was the second round of selection.
After the zombie wave ended, the King of Gods would distribute the materials and rewards based on the performance of the players from the four sub-regions in the second round.

The first-ranked player would receive rewards that were rich in materials. The second-ranked player would receive part of the materials, while the third-ranked player could not obtain any materials at all. On the other hand, the fourth-ranked player would not receive any materials and his safe time would be reduced as well.
To acquire safe time, an inefficient method was to kill monsters and complete missions.
Whereas the more efficient way was to kill the player.
The fourth-ranked player had no choice. If he did not want to be eliminated, he could only try his best to attack.
Or he could try his best to complete high-level missions and kill zombies.
The chances of survival were almost zero. After all, the time taken to kill zombies was too little. The player simply could not take into account the acquisition of safe time and the search for food.
Either that, or they had to think of a way to kill the player from the opposing camp and snatch the materials from them! Seize the time!
The King of Gods was forcing the players to kill each other in the game.
As for the third round...
Yu Jie took a deep breath, and his eyes became resolute once again.
“Quick! Are the materials ready?”
In front of Ah Peng’s auto repair shop.
“Bang!!”
Fang Heng raised the iron pipe and aimed it at the zombie’s head.
[Hint: You deal critical damage to the zombie and the zombie dies. Your skill-guillotine experience point +1. You gain an additional 12 seconds of team survival time and special event point: 1.]
After one hit, Fang Heng quickly stepped back.
More than ten zombies came out from the back of the auto repair shop.
“More and more zombies...”
Fang Heng moved his arms.
He felt a little sore.
They were only about three thousand meters away, but it took them more than half an hour to get there.
The zombies along the way were too difficult to deal with.
Moreover, they were using such an unhandy weapon.
Finally, they arrived at the auto repair shop and the zombie horde started to surround them one after another.
Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei had been fighting with the zombie horde for more than twenty minutes.

They led a group of zombies to circle around the open space outside the auto repair shop. From time to time, they would rush up and swing the iron pipe then retreat, trying to reduce the number of zombies.
Fortunately, Fang Heng’s current basic attribute was enough to crush ordinary zombies, and each attack could take the life of a zombie.
Just as Fang Heng’s satiety dropped to 43% , several red alchemy magic arrays appeared under his feet.
Fang Heng felt relieved.
He finally made it!
The alchemy magic arrays spun rapidly!
A red figure dashed out of the magic array at an extremely fast speed!
“Chi Chi Chi!”
The Licker pounced on the zombie horde, waving its sharp claws and slaughtering them.
Ordinary zombies were no match for the Licker!
“Phew! It’s safe now...”
Seeing the appearance of the Lickers, Mo Jiawei let out a sigh of relief and sat down on the ground.
His back was soaked in sweat.
It was a dual pressure of mental and physical strength!
Mo Jiawei felt that the most difficult part of this special event was that he couldn’t bring any materials or resources into his initial backpack.
There were no weapons, no medical supplies, and even no food or water!
After a long and intense battle, Mo Jiawei was thirsty and his stomach was growling.
The strange thing was, Fang Heng didn’t seem to be very tired?
Mo Jiawei turned his head and looked at the excited Fang Heng.
[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker has killed a normal zombie. You have gained an additional 9 seconds of team survival time and special event point: 1.]

[Hint: Your zombie clone-Licker has killed a normal zombie. You have gained an additional 12 seconds of team survival time. Your skill-strength training experience point +1. You have gained a special event point: 1...]
Fang Heng was ecstatic when he saw the row of game hints on the game log.
Great!
Just as he had guessed.
A zombie clone could also gain event points by killing monsters!
Wouldn’t that earn him a fortune?
Fang Heng suddenly didn’t feel hungry, and all the tiredness along the way was swept away!
“Bang!!”
The ground trembled slightly.
Mo Jiawei, who was sitting on the ground, was shocked and turned around to look.
A deep crack appeared on the cement ground.
“Bang!! Bang!!”
With a few loud bangs, the cracked shrapnel flew out, and a huge fist protruded out of the cement ground.
Then, large chunks of shrapnel were pushed away and the Tyrant form slowly crawled out of the ground.
Tyrant patted the soil on its body and slowly walked to Fang Heng’s side.
“Phew, you scared me.”
Mo Jiawei patted his heart, thinking that Tyrant’s way of showing up was really unique.
The remaining vine zombie clones also crawled out from the muddy ground not far away and walked toward Fang Heng.
Fang Heng frowned slightly when he saw the zombie clones.
It was different from the outside world.
In the outside world, after a normal vine zombie was resurrected, the tools and equipment that it was equipped with when it died would be retained.
However, it was different this time. The newly-born zombie team didn’t carry any equipment or clothing.
Without the iron hammer, it was a bit difficult to break in.
“Although I’ve already predicted it, it’s still a bit troublesome... Tyrant, you should do it.”
Fang Heng muttered in a low voice and pointed at the iron gate of the auto repair shop not far away.
Tyrant strode forward and raised its huge fist.
“Bang!!”
“Bang Bang! Bang Bang!!”
After five punches, the iron gate was smashed into pieces by Tyrant.
The group of Lickers gathered at the entrance immediately broke into the auto repair shop and began to hunt.
Following that, the vine zombies also staggered in and began to search the entire auto repair shop.

[Hint: Your zombie team has completed the cleaning of the auto repair shop. You have killed a total of 256 ordinary zombies, Tier 1 mutated zombie*2. You have gained an additional 2,455 seconds of team survival time. You have gained special event points: 264 points.]

[Hint: Your zombie team has completed the search. You have obtained spare tire*12, jack*5, gasoline*64, diet meal (chocolate flavour)*1, milk*1, wrench*12, auto repair parts*34, low-level parts*41...]
Twenty minutes later, Mo Jiawei was holding a can of coffee. His face was full of happiness as he exclaimed, “I’m finally alive...”
Fang Heng took a sip of the chocolate-flavoured diet meal and walked to a black Porsche that looked pretty good.
[Hint: Due to your special skill-mechanical maintenance, the vehicle has been determined to be serviceable. Current vehicle damage: 45%. Damage reduced to less than 10%.]
“I’ll make do with it...”
Fang Heng muttered in a low voice.

He waved his hand and controlled 20 idle Lickers to go out and freely kill to earn points. The other 30 Lickers exited combat mode on the spot and prepared to cultivate the proliferators after six hours.
