chapters.title: Chapter 311 - Competitive Mission
paragraphs: During this period, Mo Jiawei also learned a lot of mechanical skills from Victor. After eating and drinking his fill, he also came up to check the Porsche.
He frowned and said, “Fang Heng, if we want to fix it, I’m afraid we don’t have enough spare parts, right?”
“You don’t know, right? Have you heard of ‘robbing Peter to pay Paul’?”
As he said that, Fang Heng gave a dozen wrenches he had just collected to the vine zombies behind him.
The zombies received the wrenches and stood there in a daze for a while. Then, they turned around one by one and ran to find a car to start dismantling.
[Hint: Your vine zombie clone has dismantled the damaged Chevrolet. You have obtained ordinary parts*2, damaged advanced car parts*1...]
Looking at the zombies working hard beside the car, Mo Jiawei opened his mouth.
He understood.
D*mn it! No wonder Fang Heng had made it clear from the start that he was here to look for an auto repair shop!
He was here to look for tools and dismantle things!
At least in terms of dismantling, Mo Jiawei felt that he still had a lot to learn from Fang Heng.
Half an hour later, Fang Heng and Victor were driving on the street in a Porsche 356A.
Behind the car, 20 Lickers followed them as they ran wildly.
While driving, Fang Heng originally wanted to make a simple bed and personally go offline to call Chen Yu and ask him about the Federation’s progress in this special event.
Unfortunately, the game prompted that they have not yet completed Tier 2 of the mission, so the player could not go offline.
Fang Heng had no choice but to give up.
Soon, Fang Heng arrived at City Street No. 3822.
Eh? It was a villa?
A villa built in the centre of the city was rare.
More than a dozen NPCs wearing security uniforms stood guard outside the door. They all held black guns in their hands and stared at Fang Heng who was driving over.
Their eyes were filled with surprise.
A survivor who drove over?
Fang Heng controlled the Lickers to spread out to hunt zombies, then got out of the car with Mo Jiawei.
“I’m here to see Wendy.”
Fang Heng said and waved the note in his hand.
The security captain walked up and looked at Fang Heng from head to toe, then nodded and said, “You must be Mr Fang Heng. Please follow me.”
The two of them followed the security captain into the front yard of the villa.
Fang Heng had already gotten used to it. He subconsciously looked around quickly and observed the overall defense arrangement of the villa.
He couldn’t help but ponder in his heart.
This villa seemed to be quite rich.
However, the security seemed to be too weak.
There were only three groups of NPC mercenaries.
In terms of machinery, let alone light cannons, he didn’t even see any high-level automatic cannons.
It would not be able to withstand an attack from the Tyrant.
If they used the zombie team to attack, the success rate would be 99% .
Should they rob them?
Fang Heng was tempted.
The security captain brought Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei into the villa’s hall.
Wendy had long golden hair. She leaned lazily on the back of the chair and looked at Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei with a probing gaze.
“Hello, I’m Wendy, the apocalypse merchant of Haramori City.”
Alright, so she was the apocalypse merchant...
Fang Heng sighed in his heart and completely dismissed the idea of looting.
This was too much of a loss!
In the game, there used to be a Big Brother who tried to rob the apocalypse merchant.
In the end, he had a tragic outcome.
All the apocalypse merchant’s hatred towards him had reached the peak. They permanently issued a bounty mission to take the player’s life.
Other than dealing with the endless pursuit, the player could not buy materials from any of the apocalypse merchant camp.
Even after establishing a shelter, he would still be attacked by the NPC mercenary army in the game.
Wendy did not know that she had just escaped from the gates of hell. She was very surprised that Fang Heng could come here faster than expected.
“I’ve heard of you, Fang Heng. You were introduced by Vettel. He said good things about you.”
“Thank you. Vettel always had great foresight.”
Fang Heng accepted the compliment generously and asked, “I heard that you need help?”
“Yes, I have a special mission that I’ve been struggling to find people for. Fortunately, you’re here.”
“But before I hand you the mission, I need to confirm whether you have the ability to complete my special mission.”
“I will provide you with some recently difficult missions. You can choose a few of them to complete, and after you complete them, you will receive corresponding camp points.”
“Camp points can be exchanged for various survival resources or materials from me, including but not limited to guns, ammunition, food, medicine...”
“You can treat it as a simple test. Once you received my approval, I will give you a special mission. Of course, I will only give this special mission to one person.”
“Trust me, the mission reward will definitely satisfy you.”
[Hint: You have obtained the mission-Wendy’s test.]
[Hint: You can receive any ordinary mission from Wendy (at most three at the same time) . After completing the mission, you can receive camp points as a reward.]

[Hint: Currently, all players who have found Wendy (only one player can receive it) can receive normal missions from Wendy. After the camp points have accumulated to 5000 points, the subsequent special mission will be triggered by default. Only the first player who has accumulated 5000 points can trigger the subsequent special mission.]
[Hint: After the special mission is completed, the player will not be able to continue receiving normal missions.]
“So that’s how it is...”
Seeing the small game hint that appeared in his retina, Fang Heng quickly sorted out his thoughts.
These were the game settings for special events.
The game deliberately created such a gaudy operation in order to let the players compete and kill each other.
Not only was Wendy’s villa in the city center, even the location of the normal mission given was mostly in the city center.
If he hadn’t found Wendy before the others, he would have met the players from the other three camps outside the villa.
He might have to fight them.
“So despicable...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself and quickly opened the list of normal missions.

The missions provided by Wendy were divided into three parts. They could be completed in a few large areas in the city centre. Among them, there were a series of missions such as killing ordinary zombies, cleaning up buildings and gathering materials.
“How is it? Have you decided?”
“I’ll give you a friendly reminder. Although you’re one step ahead of the other survivors, your time is still limited.”
Wendy was very clear about the difficulty of this mission.
There were no weapons, no food and no medical materials.
The combat ability of the team player would be reduced to a very low level.
That was not the most troublesome part!
Apart from the threat of zombies, they also had to face the attacks of the players from the opposing faction!
It was even more difficult to complete the mission to accumulate enough points!
“I know the mission is very difficult, but this is the only way to pick the most suitable candidate...”
“Forgive me for being blunt.”
Fang Heng raised his head and asked, “It’s that simple?”

sentences.text: During this period, Mo Jiawei also learned a lot of mechanical skills from Victor.
After eating and drinking his fill, he also came up to check the Porsche.
He frowned and said, “Fang Heng, if we want to fix it, I’m afraid we don’t have enough spare parts, right?”
“You don’t know, right?
Have you heard of ‘robbing Peter to pay Paul’?”
As he said that, Fang Heng gave a dozen wrenches he had just collected to the vine zombies behind him.
The zombies received the wrenches and stood there in a daze for a while.
Then, they turned around one by one and ran to find a car to start dismantling.
[Hint: Your vine zombie clone has dismantled the damaged Chevrolet.
You have obtained ordinary parts*2, damaged advanced car parts*1...]
Looking at the zombies working hard beside the car, Mo Jiawei opened his mouth.
He understood.
D*mn it!
No wonder Fang Heng had made it clear from the start that he was here to look for an auto repair shop!
He was here to look for tools and dismantle things!
At least in terms of dismantling, Mo Jiawei felt that he still had a lot to learn from Fang Heng.
Half an hour later, Fang Heng and Victor were driving on the street in a Porsche 356A.
Behind the car, 20 Lickers followed them as they ran wildly.
While driving, Fang Heng originally wanted to make a simple bed and personally go offline to call Chen Yu and ask him about the Federation’s progress in this special event.
Unfortunately, the game prompted that they have not yet completed Tier 2 of the mission, so the player could not go offline.
Fang Heng had no choice but to give up.
Soon, Fang Heng arrived at City Street No.
Eh?
It was a villa?
A villa built in the centre of the city was rare.
More than a dozen NPCs wearing security uniforms stood guard outside the door.
They all held black guns in their hands and stared at Fang Heng who was driving over.
Their eyes were filled with surprise.
A survivor who drove over?
Fang Heng controlled the Lickers to spread out to hunt zombies, then got out of the car with Mo Jiawei.
“I’m here to see Wendy.”
Fang Heng said and waved the note in his hand.
The security captain walked up and looked at Fang Heng from head to toe, then nodded and said, “You must be Mr Fang Heng.
Please follow me.”
The two of them followed the security captain into the front yard of the villa.
Fang Heng had already gotten used to it.
He subconsciously looked around quickly and observed the overall defense arrangement of the villa.
He couldn’t help but ponder in his heart.
This villa seemed to be quite rich.
However, the security seemed to be too weak.
There were only three groups of NPC mercenaries.
In terms of machinery, let alone light cannons, he didn’t even see any high-level automatic cannons.
It would not be able to withstand an attack from the Tyrant.
If they used the zombie team to attack, the success rate would be 99% .
Should they rob them?
Fang Heng was tempted.
The security captain brought Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei into the villa’s hall.
Wendy had long golden hair.
She leaned lazily on the back of the chair and looked at Fang Heng and Mo Jiawei with a probing gaze.
“Hello, I’m Wendy, the apocalypse merchant of Haramori City.”
Alright, so she was the apocalypse merchant...
Fang Heng sighed in his heart and completely dismissed the idea of looting.
This was too much of a loss!
In the game, there used to be a Big Brother who tried to rob the apocalypse merchant.
In the end, he had a tragic outcome.
All the apocalypse merchant’s hatred towards him had reached the peak.
They permanently issued a bounty mission to take the player’s life.
Other than dealing with the endless pursuit, the player could not buy materials from any of the apocalypse merchant camp.
Even after establishing a shelter, he would still be attacked by the NPC mercenary army in the game.
Wendy did not know that she had just escaped from the gates of hell.
She was very surprised that Fang Heng could come here faster than expected.
“I’ve heard of you, Fang Heng.
You were introduced by Vettel.
He said good things about you.”
“Thank you.
Vettel always had great foresight.”
Fang Heng accepted the compliment generously and asked, “I heard that you need help?”
“Yes, I have a special mission that I’ve been struggling to find people for.
Fortunately, you’re here.”
“But before I hand you the mission, I need to confirm whether you have the ability to complete my special mission.”
“I will provide you with some recently difficult missions.
You can choose a few of them to complete, and after you complete them, you will receive corresponding camp points.”
“Camp points can be exchanged for various survival resources or materials from me, including but not limited to guns, ammunition, food, medicine...”
“You can treat it as a simple test.
Once you received my approval, I will give you a special mission.
Of course, I will only give this special mission to one person.”
“Trust me, the mission reward will definitely satisfy you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 312 - Completing Mission
paragraphs: Easy?
Wendy was stunned.
Did she hear him correctly? He said it was easy?
Fang Heng thought so.
The ordinary mission Wendy provided was too ordinary...
The difficulty could not be compared to the high-level missions of the Dark Knights in the outside world.
With the help of the zombie team, the mission difficulty was average...
The Lickers would assist in the monster-killing mission, and the vine zombies could also complete the resource-type mission.
The only problem was transportation.
Fang Heng carefully read through a few common mission descriptions. After thinking for a while, he raised his head and asked, “Before that, I have something I want to ask you.”
“Huh?”
“Can I see the redemption list for the camp points?”
“Sure, consider it as your reward for finding me first.”
Wendy nodded.
The redemption list for the camp points immediately appeared in Fang Heng’s vision.
The materials in the redemption list were extremely abundant.
Red herbs, medical spray, first aid kit, revolver, submachine gun, single-arm rocket launcher, short-term strength-enhancing potions...
What the heck!
They even had pyroxene!
Fang Heng couldn’t help but get excited when he saw the classification for the ores.
He quickly scrolled back.
Found it!
In the redemption column, the five rare resources needed to build a Tier 3 space tearing device were all available for redemption!
He calmed himself down and took a closer look.
Other than pyroxene, the prices of the other five rare resources were also shocking.
He had to plan out how to get the most wool.
Fang Heng held back his excitement, took a deep breath and continued to read.
Soon, Fang Heng saw the treasure he needed on the second page of the transportation tool.
Fang Heng looked up. “Wendy, I have another question. Will the redemption column continue to open for me after the mission is completed?”

“Of course, as long as you have enough camp points,” Wendy nodded and explained, “Similarly, you can choose to keep camp points. The remaining camp points will be converted into final points in the final settlement.”
“Thank you. I understand. I need to accept these few missions.”
Fang Heng said as he gently tapped on the three related missions.

[Hint: You have accepted the mission-collect first aid materials (you can collect first aid materials from the City Central Hospital. There is also a chance that first aid materials will drop after killing zombies in the hospital area).]
[Hint: You have accepted the mission-clean up the zombie horde in the hospital area.]
[Hint: You have accepted the mission-kill a Tier 1 mutated zombie.]
“Wendy, I’ll be back soon.”
After saying that, Fang Heng left the villa with Mo Jiawei.
“There are only 70 minutes left until the end of the Tier 1 mission. We need to speed up.”
After getting back in the car, Fang Heng stepped on the accelerator and commanded the Lickers to gather together and head to the City Central Hospital.
It would take about 20 minutes to drive from the city centre to East Street. Considering the dangers they might encounter on the road, it was reasonable to set aside 30 minutes.
Accounting for the time required for the intermediate delivery of the mission, there was only half an hour left for them to complete the mission.
Fang Heng chose the City Central Hospital as the target area for this mission.
The three missions he had just received from Wendy were all related to each other and could be completed at the same time in the hospital area.
Mo Jiawei was a little nervous.
He felt a little unease about this operation.

“Fang Heng, isn’t the time too tight? There’s no need for us to rush to complete the mission, right? The player competing with us didn’t have time to find Wendy, so there’s no reason for us to collect 5000 points in such a short time.”
“Yes, it’s true.”
Fang Heng stepped on the accelerator and sped on the road.
He had a preliminary plan.
“The number of zombies is not enough. I don’t think I can complete the mission in 30 minutes.”
“The main purpose is to find a way to complete some missions first, exchange some materials from Wendy to pass the Tier 2 special mission, so as to increase the planning for the follow-up plan.”
Fang Heng briefly explained his plan to Mo Jiawei while considering whether it was feasible to optimize it.

“Later, I’ll ask the Lickers to clear a wave of zombies in the hospital area first. After that, when the ordinary vine zombie arrives at the hospital, we’ll immediately return to the East Square to assemble, leaving the zombie group to continue carrying out the search and clearing duties in the hospital.”
Mo Jiawei suddenly understood, “I understand. You mean a two-way operation, a long-range hack?”
“That’s right!”
Five minutes later, the car drove into the parking lot at the main entrance of the City Central Hospital.
“F*ck, so many...”
Looking at the dense zombie horde outside the car window, Mo Jiawei was secretly speechless.
The number of zombies in the hospital was beyond imagination.
A large number of zombies gathered at the periphery of the hospital building. Some of them were Tier 1 mutated zombies.
As soon as the car slowed down, the surrounding zombies swarmed toward them.
“Perfect timing.”
Fang Heng thought, “The more zombies there are, the better!”
The more zombies there were, the more efficient he would be in completing the mission!
He immediately controlled the 20 Lickers that followed him.
The Lickers pounced on the zombie horde and started hunting.
With the buff of the skill-guillotine, the damage output of the Licker increased once again!
Its sharp claws could easily cut through the heads of zombies!
The zombie horde fell like wheat.

[Hint: Your Licker deals critical damage to normal zombies. Normal zombies die. You gain skill-guillotine experience point +1 and 1 survival point. You gain an additional 5 seconds of safe time. Your mission-clearing the zombie horde in the hospital area completion rate has increased to 1.3%.]
[Hint: Your Licker killed a Tier 1 mutated zombie...]
For a moment, Fang Heng’s game log was flooded once again.
[Hint: Your current mission-clearing zombie team in hospital area completion rate has increased to 122.7%.]
Eh?
The mission was over-completed?
It was another surprise!
This way, he could completely save the time of running back and forth between the hospital and Wendy’s apocalypse camp to deliver the mission.
Perhaps, he would be able to complete the mission more than expected and obtain more rewards!
Fang Heng was relieved.
“But if that’s the case, it doesn’t seem to be enough...”
Mo Jiawei blinked and asked curiously, “What? God, what do you mean it’s not enough?”
“There aren’t enough zombies to kill.”
Mo Jiawei: ???
Fang Heng glanced out of the window.
Licker’s speed of killing ordinary zombies was too fast.
Combined with the guillotine skill, as long as it aimed at the head, it was a one-hit kill.
According to this speed, it would take about ten minutes to clear out the zombie horde in the periphery of the hospital.
“Let’s go, we’ll go outside and lure another wave of zombies over.”
Without waiting for Mo Jiawei’s response, Fang Heng stepped on the gas pedal and drove away from the hospital.
After leaving the hospital, Fang Heng honked his horn and slowed down his speed.
The nearby zombie horde was attracted by the sound of the horn and gathered toward Fang Heng’s car.
Fang Heng slowed down the car and led the zombie horde around the hospital twice.
When a large group of zombies gathered behind him, Fang Heng was satisfied and brought them all into the hospital.
The Lickers had just finished killing the zombies at the periphery of the hospital when they immediately pounced on the zombie horde that Fang Heng had lured over and started killing again.

chapters.title: Chapter 313 - Exchange
paragraphs: “Awesome, God!”
Seeing Fang Heng’s actions, Mo Jiawei exclaimed in his heart, “Awesome!”
If he were to kill zombies outside, it wouldn’t count in the mission of clearing the hospital.
Only by luring the zombies into the hospital area and killing them would he be able to cheat the game’s reward.
The ordinary player would find it extremely difficult to clear the zombies in the hospital. They wouldn’t even think about luring the zombies from outside into the hospital area to kill them...
Although Fang Heng’s method was not orthodox, the effect was very good!
[Hint: Your mission-cleaning up the zombie horde in the hospital completion rate has increased to 719.2%.]
Fang Heng glanced at the rapidly increasing completion rate of the mission and replied with a smile, “What do you mean by ‘awesome’? It’s just a basic operation.”
[Hint: You have submitted a mission-collecting first aid materials. Current mission completion rate: 153.4% . You have received 306.8 camp points.]
[Hint: You have submitted a mission-cleaning the zombie horde in the hospital area. Current mission completion rate: 1733.4% . You have obtained 1733.4 camp points.]
[Hint: You have submitted a mission-killing a Tier 1 mutated zombie. Current mission completion rate: 208.3%. You have obtained 416.6 camp points.]
[Hint: Your friendship with Wendy has increased.]
As Fang Heng submitted the missions repeatedly, Wendy’s expression gradually became strange.
In the end, Wendy looked at Fang Heng in disbelief.
She was too surprised!
In her estimation, it would be at least the second or third day before someone would complete the mission she had issued.
But now...
It had only been half an hour!
The two young men in front of her had already completed half of the test!
Their efficiency in killing zombies was unimaginable!
“Ms Wendy?”
Fang Heng saw that Wendy was in a daze, so he called out to her.
Wendy came back to her senses.
“Yes, Fang Heng, your strength surprised me. Can I know how you completed the missions so quickly?”
“Sorry, this is my secret.”
Fang Heng smiled and asked, “Can I use camp points to exchange for rewards now?”
“Of course, you can. You can exchange for anything you want here, provided you have enough points.”
Wendy began to feel curious about Fang Heng.
She could not help but guess what kind of items Fang Heng would choose to exchange for.
If it was an ordinary person, their first choice would most likely be weapons.
2000 points were enough to exchange for a single rocket launcher and three rocket launchers from the camp.
Fang Heng did not hesitate at all. He quickly opened the redemption column and reached out to click on a few options.
“I just want these?”
Wendy was a little surprised by Fang Heng’s choice. She raised her head and asked Fang Heng, “Are you sure? Fang Heng?”
“Of course.”
Fang Heng said seriously, “That’s all I want. I’m sorry, but I don’t have much time. I’ll be leaving soon.”
“Fang Heng, you’re getting harder to understand. Ron, take him to get the materials.”
The bodyguard beside Wendy stepped forward.
“Yes, Mr Fang Heng. Please follow me.”
“Thank you. I’ll get a few more missions while I’m at it.”
[Hint: You’ve taken a mission to collect first aid materials.]
[Hint: You’ve taken a mission to clear out the zombies in the hospital area.]
[Hint: You’ve taken a mission to kill a Tier 1 mutated zombie.]
Fang Heng already had a plan. He quickly took a few missions and left.
Watching Fang Heng leave in a hurry, Wendy rested her chin on her hands in confusion.
Why did he exchange for a military truck?
In the front yard of the villa, Fang Heng saw a familiar military transport truck. As if he had seen an old friend, he walked forward and patted the body of the truck with satisfaction.
“It’s not bad. It’s 100% new.”
“Yes, Mr Fang Heng. This truck is the latest model. In addition, we have already put the compressed biscuits, machete, pistol and pistol bullets that you exchanged into the trailer of the truck.”
“Thank you so much. I’ll leave my Porsche with you for now.”
“Okay, Mr Fang Heng. We’ll take care of it for you.”
Fang Heng counted the materials and waved at Ron.
“See you next time.”
Mo Jiawei followed and sat in the passenger seat.
He was also baffled.
According to Fang Heng, this step of exchanging materials was to wait for the Tier 2 zombie wave
Then shouldn’t they exchange for some high-tech weapons?
For example, get some rifles, grenades, flashbangs and so on.
What was the meaning of exchanging for trucks?
“Fang Heng, why are we exchanging for transport trucks?”
“For better missions, of course.”
Fang Heng had already devised a series of greed plans in his head.
He licked his lips and a hint of unconcealable excitement appeared in his eyes. He patted Mo Jiawei’s shoulder.
“Old Mo, the scale! We need to expand the scale of production!”
Mo Jiawei blinked with a blank look on his face.
For a moment, he didn’t know how to continue asking.
The scale? Expand the scale of production?
Mo Jiawei thought that this didn’t seem like a game that involves pastures and vegetables...
“Fang Heng? Are you on the wrong track?”
“That’s right. Let’s take a detour to the auto repair shop earlier on.”
East Square.
Yu Jie was sure that they were in trouble this time.
Big problem!
There were only 20 minutes left until the Tier 1 assemble mission was completed, and there were only less than 100 players who came to assemble!
Yu Jie discovered that almost all the player teams that came to assemble were from small guilds and small companies in the Eastern region of the Federation.
There were even a few unaffiliated teams among them!
What about those players from large companies and large guilds?
Why didn’t he see any of them?
They couldn’t have all met with trouble in the Tier 1 mission at the same time.
Then the biggest possibility was...
They hadn’t participated in this special event!
Why was that?
Yu Jie had never thought that such a thing would happen.

As the game settings did not allow one to be offline, Yu Jie was temporarily unable to contact the outside world. Through the Federation’s channel, he was able to find out what was happening in the outside world.
Things were getting out of hand!

Tier 2’s mission difficulty to resist the zombie wave was based on the number and level of all the players participating in Tier 2 of the game. In addition, there were a series of difficulty factors such as the game opening time and the game progress.
Their Eastern faction had fewer players, but when they encountered the Tier 2 zombie wave in the game, the intensity would not decrease at all!
In this way, their entire Eastern faction had a high probability of being eliminated in the Tier 2 mission!
Although the mortality rate of special events was extremely high, and all the Federation players who joined this mission had already prepared to sacrifice their lives, this was too...
Based on their current team strength, other than the Federation players, most of them were just a bunch of shrimp soldiers and crab generals.
The probability of safely surviving the Tier 2 zombie wave was less than 10%!
The only way to salvage the situation...
Yu Jie thought of Fang Heng, whom he had met a few days ago.

sentences.text: “Awesome, God!”
Seeing Fang Heng’s actions, Mo Jiawei exclaimed in his heart, “Awesome!”
If he were to kill zombies outside, it wouldn’t count in the mission of clearing the hospital.
Only by luring the zombies into the hospital area and killing them would he be able to cheat the game’s reward.
The ordinary player would find it extremely difficult to clear the zombies in the hospital.
They wouldn’t even think about luring the zombies from outside into the hospital area to kill them...
Although Fang Heng’s method was not orthodox, the effect was very good!
[Hint: Your mission-cleaning up the zombie horde in the hospital completion rate has increased to 719.2%.]
Fang Heng glanced at the rapidly increasing completion rate of the mission and replied with a smile, “What do you mean by ‘awesome’?
It’s just a basic operation.”
[Hint: You have submitted a mission-collecting first aid materials.
Current mission completion rate: 153.4% .
You have received 306.8 camp points.]
[Hint: You have submitted a mission-cleaning the zombie horde in the hospital area.
Current mission completion rate: 1733.4% .
You have obtained 1733.4 camp points.]
[Hint: You have submitted a mission-killing a Tier 1 mutated zombie.
Current mission completion rate: 208.3%.
You have obtained 416.6 camp points.]
[Hint: Your friendship with Wendy has increased.]
As Fang Heng submitted the missions repeatedly, Wendy’s expression gradually became strange.
In the end, Wendy looked at Fang Heng in disbelief.
She was too surprised!
In her estimation, it would be at least the second or third day before someone would complete the mission she had issued.
But now...
It had only been half an hour!
The two young men in front of her had already completed half of the test!
Their efficiency in killing zombies was unimaginable!
“Ms Wendy?”
Fang Heng saw that Wendy was in a daze, so he called out to her.
Wendy came back to her senses.
“Yes, Fang Heng, your strength surprised me.
Can I know how you completed the missions so quickly?”
“Sorry, this is my secret.”
Fang Heng smiled and asked, “Can I use camp points to exchange for rewards now?”
“Of course, you can.
You can exchange for anything you want here, provided you have enough points.”
Wendy began to feel curious about Fang Heng.
She could not help but guess what kind of items Fang Heng would choose to exchange for.
If it was an ordinary person, their first choice would most likely be weapons.
2000 points were enough to exchange for a single rocket launcher and three rocket launchers from the camp.
Fang Heng did not hesitate at all.
He quickly opened the redemption column and reached out to click on a few options.
“I just want these?”
Wendy was a little surprised by Fang Heng’s choice.
She raised her head and asked Fang Heng, “Are you sure?
Fang Heng?”
“Of course.”
Fang Heng said seriously, “That’s all I want.
I’m sorry, but I don’t have much time.
I’ll be leaving soon.”
“Fang Heng, you’re getting harder to understand.
Ron, take him to get the materials.”
The bodyguard beside Wendy stepped forward.
“Yes, Mr Fang Heng.
Please follow me.”
“Thank you.
I’ll get a few more missions while I’m at it.”
[Hint: You’ve taken a mission to collect first aid materials.]
[Hint: You’ve taken a mission to clear out the zombies in the hospital area.]
[Hint: You’ve taken a mission to kill a Tier 1 mutated zombie.]
Fang Heng already had a plan.
He quickly took a few missions and left.
Watching Fang Heng leave in a hurry, Wendy rested her chin on her hands in confusion.
Why did he exchange for a military truck?
In the front yard of the villa, Fang Heng saw a familiar military transport truck.
As if he had seen an old friend, he walked forward and patted the body of the truck with satisfaction.
“It’s not bad.
It’s 100% new.”
“Yes, Mr Fang Heng.
This truck is the latest model.
In addition, we have already put the compressed biscuits, machete, pistol and pistol bullets that you exchanged into the trailer of the truck.”
“Thank you so much.
I’ll leave my Porsche with you for now.”
“Okay, Mr Fang Heng.
We’ll take care of it for you.”
Fang Heng counted the materials and waved at Ron.
“See you next time.”
Mo Jiawei followed and sat in the passenger seat.
He was also baffled.
According to Fang Heng, this step of exchanging materials was to wait for the Tier 2 zombie wave
Then shouldn’t they exchange for some high-tech weapons?
For example, get some rifles, grenades, flashbangs and so on.
What was the meaning of exchanging for trucks?
“Fang Heng, why are we exchanging for transport trucks?”
“For better missions, of course.”
Fang Heng had already devised a series of greed plans in his head.
He licked his lips and a hint of unconcealable excitement appeared in his eyes.
He patted Mo Jiawei’s shoulder.
“Old Mo, the scale!
We need to expand the scale of production!”
Mo Jiawei blinked with a blank look on his face.
For a moment, he didn’t know how to continue asking.
The scale?
Expand the scale of production?
Mo Jiawei thought that this didn’t seem like a game that involves pastures and vegetables...
“Fang Heng?
Are you on the wrong track?”
“That’s right.
Let’s take a detour to the auto repair shop earlier on.”
East Square.
Yu Jie was sure that they were in trouble this time.
Big problem!
There were only 20 minutes left until the Tier 1 assemble mission was completed, and there were only less than 100 players who came to assemble!
Yu Jie discovered that almost all the player teams that came to assemble were from small guilds and small companies in the Eastern region of the Federation.
There were even a few unaffiliated teams among them!
What about those players from large companies and large guilds?
Why didn’t he see any of them?
They couldn’t have all met with trouble in the Tier 1 mission at the same time.
Then the biggest possibility was...
They hadn’t participated in this special event!
Why was that?
Yu Jie had never thought that such a thing would happen.
As the game settings did not allow one to be offline, Yu Jie was temporarily unable to contact the outside world.
Through the Federation’s channel, he was able to find out what was happening in the outside world.
Things were getting out of hand!
Tier 2’s mission difficulty to resist the zombie wave was based on the number and level of all the players participating in Tier 2 of the game.
In addition, there were a series of difficulty factors such as the game opening time and the game progress.
Their Eastern faction had fewer players, but when they encountered the Tier 2 zombie wave in the game, the intensity would not decrease at all!
In this way, their entire Eastern faction had a high probability of being eliminated in the Tier 2 mission!
Although the mortality rate of special events was extremely high, and all the Federation players who joined this mission had already prepared to sacrifice their lives, this was too...
Based on their current team strength, other than the Federation players, most of them were just a bunch of shrimp soldiers and crab generals.
The probability of safely surviving the Tier 2 zombie wave was less than 10%!
The only way to salvage the situation...
Yu Jie thought of Fang Heng, whom he had met a few days ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - Assemble
paragraphs: Before entering the special event, Chen Yu had already informed Fang Heng that the Federation would try its best to help Fang Heng during the special event.
However, why hadn’t Fang Heng appeared yet?
Did something happen to him?
Or could it be that Fang Heng was unable to control the zombie team in the special event?
No matter what, the only thing Yu Jie could do now was to perfect the defense of the East Square as much as possible and wait for Fang Heng’s arrival.
In the crowd, two players were whispering to each other.
“Boss, this isn’t good...”
“Yeah, there are too few people here. We have yet to see the people from the big guilds.”
“Damn, didn’t they say there’s going to be a special mission this time? Why aren’t the big guilds here? Did the boss get scammed? Is the information he bought from the black market fake?”
“It shouldn’t be that bad. I’ve been working with him for quite some time.”
Zhou Yi scratched his hair in frustration.
“You’ve been smart since you were young. Hurry up and think of a way!”
Lu Yu spread his hands. “What else can we do? We can either wait here for death or wait for God to come over and we can rely on him.”
As they spoke, the two of them turned their heads and looked in the direction of the East Square’s entrance with anticipation.
They were waiting for Fang Heng.
When they had just entered the game stage, they had been friends with Fang Heng for some time during the initial prison mission.
Later on, Zhou Yi and Lu Yu stayed near the prison area and felt that they could not compete with Fang Heng, so they went to the outside world to develop.
Later on, they received all kinds of news about the prison through various forums.
They were envious, regretful and helpless...
They couldn’t sleep the whole night...
They had indeed accurately judged the situation back then.
They believed that they absolutely couldn’t compete with Fang Heng, who had occupied the prison.
They might as well quit early and run to other places to seek development.
It was true in theory, but they didn’t expect Fang Heng to be so ridiculously strong!
If they had known earlier, they would have clung to him!
Anything from Fang Heng would be enough for them to earn!
Zhou Yi was full of regret now.
He was only glad that he did not choose to be enemies with Fang Heng at that time. He even had a good relationship with Fang Heng.
They were initially hesitant about participating in this special mission.
After Lu Yu’s reminder, they immediately thought of a way to contact Fang Heng’s studio and greet Fang Heng.
They had already made up their minds before entering the special event.
Regardless of what special event they encountered in Haramori City, they would cling to Fang Heng!
However, Zhou Yi never expected to encounter a problem at the first step.
God couldn’t even be found...
“Do you think God met with an accident?”
Lu Yu said with certainty, “It’s not that serious. I think with God’s ability, he most likely met with some special mission and was delayed.”
“Great minds think alike!”
Zhou Yi nodded his head in approval, then raised his head to look in the direction of the East Square’s entrance.
His eyes were piercing.
Among the many players, Qin Ming was also looking anxiously in the direction of the East Square’s entrance.
“Why isn’t he here yet?”
Qin Ming paced back and forth, mumbling in a low voice. He was extremely confused.
He was the boss of a small gaming company. He had recruited employees from Server 8 and established a shelter.
Originally, everything was developing in a good direction.
He did not expect that he would be tricked by a mercenary from the black market.
The mercenary group cheated him of his security deposit.
Due to the lack of a mercenary’s combat strength during the Blood Moon, the shelter was broken through by the zombie horde during the second Blood Moon, and the players died.
The high compensation made the company’s capital chain break in an instant and face bankruptcy.
When he was desperate, Crimson Technology gave him a chance.
Crimson Technology hoped that Qin Ming would join this special event and monitor Fang Heng’s movements during the special event, trying to think of some way to make things more interesting.
As long as he could successfully kill Fang Heng in this operation, the majority of his company’s debt could be forgiven, allowing the company to continue for some time.
Qin Ming had already planned to lose a chance at rebirth.
As long as Fang Heng died in this special event!
But what Qin Ming never expected was that Fang Heng didn’t appear?
Could it be that Crimson Technology’s plan had been seen through by Fang Heng in advance?
Qin Ming was in a state of bewilderment when he suddenly heard the whispers of the player beside him.
“Look, a truck?”
“Which big company is it? They can even get their hands on a truck?”
What the hell? A truck?
Qin Ming looked up and saw a huge truck driving towards the East Square in the distance.
The trailer on the back of the truck was covered with a thick layer of oilcloth. It looked like there were quite a lot of things inside.
The players turned their attention to the brand new truck and pointed at it.
Most of the players were still on empty stomachs and there was this player who have access to a truck?
The gap between the rich and poor in this game was too big!
Yu Jie frowned and stared at the truck.
The truck stopped steadily in the East Square.
[Hint: You have completed Tier 1 mission-assemble.]
[Hint: Tier 2 mission will start in 9 minutes.]
Fang Heng jumped off the truck and looked around.
Strange.
The number of players seemed to be a little low?
Seeing Fang Heng jump off the truck, Yu Jie’s furrowed brows finally relaxed.
He felt a little more at ease.
There was finally good news in the game.
With Fang Heng, his chances of winning Tier 2 of the game had greatly increased.
“Hello, Fang Heng. I’m Yu Jie, the commander of this special event representing the Eastern region of the Federation.”

Yu Jie led the federal team to greet him. “I’m also the person in charge of the desert region’s shelter. I didn’t have time to thank you in person for what happened last time. On behalf of the desert region’s shelter, I’d like to thank you for your help.”

“You don’t have to be so polite. I’ve heard from Chen Yu about what happened to you. We’re all friends after all. Since we’ve encountered this incident, let’s try our best to cooperate and make a fortune together.”

After a brief exchange of pleasantries, Yu Jie said in a deep voice, “Fang Heng, as you can see, we’ve encountered quite a bit of trouble. For some unknown reason, many of the large guilds in the Eastern region have not participated in this special event. Currently, the overall strength of our faction is relatively weak.”
“Mm.”
Fang Heng also realized that other than the Federation, the strength of the players here was generally not high. Most of the players held wooden sticks and wooden spears as their weapons.
This didn’t make sense!
This special event was so profitable, so why didn’t the large guilds participate?
They couldn’t be that stupid, right?
If they didn’t participate in this special event, it was equivalent to giving away all the rewards for this special event...
Could there be a trap?
Fang Heng could not figure it out for a moment.
In the crowd, Zhou Yi and Lu Yu looked at each other.
As expected, it was God.
Right from the start, he had formed an alliance with the Federation!
For a small company like them, the Federation would not even look at them.
“Hey! God!”
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu immediately took the initiative to join the group chat. “Do you still remember us?”
“Of course I do. We’ve always been a good team.”
Fang Heng had a deep impression of Zhou Yi and Lu Yu.
At that time, he had just entered the Zombie Apocalypse.
The map of the mining area near the prison that Zhou Yi had left behind had helped him a lot.
Therefore, after receiving the message that Zhou Yi had left in the studio, he gladly agreed to form a team.

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - The Election
paragraphs: “God, where did you get that truck? It’s too awesome!”
“My luck is pretty good. I completed a mission along the way.”
“God, we’ll follow behind you on this mission. We’ll go wherever you go.”
“Okay, let’s work together.”
“Hello, I’m Yu Jie, the main person in charge from the Federation.”
Yu Jie nodded at Zhou Yi and continued, “Fang Heng, the biggest problem we’re facing now is food and weapons. These aren’t enough to support us through the Tier 2 zombie wave.”
“I’ve prepared some weapons and food. They should be enough.”
As he spoke, Fang Heng glanced at the sparse players on the East Square.
Great!
It would be better if those big guilds did not participate in this special event!

The players of the big guilds were stronger, but they were also more scheming. They all wanted to get the greatest benefits from the event. They often schemed in the team and it was difficult for them to cooperate wholeheartedly.
In comparison, the ordinary players did not have much ambition. They only followed the big guilds and gaming companies to get some materials.
They were more obedient and more easily satisfied!
The start of a dream!
Fang Heng felt that this special event in the game was like a divine help!
“That’s great,” Yu Jie lowered his voice and asked in a low voice, “Fang Heng, where’s your zombie team? Why didn’t I see them? Are you unable to control the zombies during the special event?”
“Yeah, it’s a little overloaded. Unless there’s an emergency, we will try to use it as little as possible.”
When Fang Heng came back, he walked around the auto repair shop and took more than 30 Lickers with him.
They were used to grow proliferators. If it wasn’t an extremely dangerous situation, it was best not to let them enter combat mode together.
Hearing that Fang Heng could still control zombies to fight, Yu Jie felt a little relieved.
“That’s good.”
The two of them were discussing the battle plan when the game hint rang again.
[Hint: Tier 1 mission-end of assembly. All players who have not completed the assemble mission will be automatically eliminated.]

[Hint: All surviving players in the current faction will vote to choose the faction leader. The faction leader has the right to allocate the final faction points and special passive skills: hegemony (additional 100% HP and 50% basic attribute bonus).]
[Hint: Each player will have one vote by default. You can choose any player in the faction.]

[Hint: If the faction leader is killed by a player from the faction, the killer will automatically become the new faction leader. If the faction leader is killed by a player from the other faction, the killer will receive all the faction points in the current faction.]

[Hint: All players will vote for the faction leader within 60 minutes. If no one votes by default after 60 minutes, the player with the most votes will be the faction leader. If there are no votes, no one will be the faction leader.]
Upon seeing the game hint, the East Square fell silent once again.
Under normal circumstances, the Federation would not participate in the faction leader election.

The Federation would not take the initiative to attack the other three factions throughout the game. They would choose to complete some side missions to earn some personal points in exchange for materials and rewards.
When necessary, the Federation would also protect the player’s safety, but it would try to reduce the number of disputes between players.

Putting aside the fact that the Federation, which had the strongest overall strength, did not participate in the election, the faction leader election was mostly the beginning of internal strife among the large guilds.
The various large guilds would often have disputes over the leader, and even fights would often occur.
But this time, it was very different.
All the players present in the Eastern faction were very weak.
Pairs of eyes turned to look at Fang Heng at the same time.
The shadow of a man’s reputation. Fang Heng’s reputation was too great.
Who in the Eastern faction of Server 8 didn’t hear about Fang Heng and his prison army?
Not to mention, the other three factions also knew about Fang Heng’s strength. His reputation had even spread to other servers.
Fang Heng was already prepared.
He was determined to become the faction leader.
Taking a step forward, Fang Heng gestured at Mo Jiawei with his mouth.
Fang Heng had deliberately spent some effort to get a truck, and he had also brought so many materials over, all to canvass votes!
Mo Jiawei understood and pulled the layer of oilcloth from the back of the truck.
Under the black oilcloth, there were shiny machetes, pistols and bullets, as well as boxes of compressed biscuits.
They were all food!
Seeing the compressed biscuits, the sound of players swallowing their saliva could be heard in the square.
The eyes of the player lit up!

Even though it was the lowest-level compressed biscuit, there was a probability of producing a negative effect of indigestion after consuming it. Eating too much of it would also cause malnutrition...
However, they could not resist hunger!
There was no other way, the players were too hungry!
The satiety consumption of this lousy place was five times that of the outside world. If it was water, it was still fine, and the method of obtaining it was simpler.
Even if it was river water, the game setting allowed the use of the bonfire to boil the water and drink it.
But in this deserted city, it was extremely difficult to find food!
Previously, the players had formed a search team and they managed to find a spicy hot pot shop.
Looking carefully, the shop was filled with zombies.
The players pondered for a long time, but in the end, they did not dare to go up and fight with the zombies.
This game was going to be impossible to play.
“Cough, cough.”
Fang Heng cleared his throat and prepared to give a domineering competition speech.
However, before he could say the first word, a line of small words appeared on his retina.

[Hint: Your votes have exceeded 50% of the current player’s votes. You have become the leader of the Eastern faction. You have obtained a special skill-hegemony (this skill will only take effect before the end of this special event).]
[Hint: The leader of the Eastern faction will be Fang Heng, the player.]
Ah, this...
Things were progressing too smoothly, and Fang Heng was momentarily stunned.
He had thought of many ways to win the election, but he had not expected things to go so smoothly...
“Eh, looks like everyone knows me.”
“Thank you for your support, in short...”
Looking at the pairs of expectant eyes below, Fang Heng sighed in his heart. He turned to look at Mo Jiawei, “Forget it, I won’t say anymore. Let’s distribute the materials.”
“Long live the Prison Army!!”
“The Prison Army is invincible!!”
“Follow the Prison Army forever!!!”
As soon as he finished speaking, the players immediately broke out into all kinds of slogans and thunderous applause.
Whatever they said was fake. Only distributing the materials was the most real thing.
Fang Heng did not have many points. After exchanging for the truck and a large amount of food, he only had twenty pistols and the rest were shiny machetes.
To avoid chaos, Yu Jie sent a few soldiers from the Federation to help maintain order and distribute the food and materials.
In the crowd, Qin Ming narrowed his eyes when he saw the players lining up to receive the materials.
Fang Heng!
He was indeed as terrifying as the rumours said.
The moment he entered the game, he thought of a way to get high-level trucks and a large amount of food!
Originally, the morale of the entire Eastern faction had already fallen to the bottom. It was almost a hundred percent certain that they would die under the zombie wave.
However, Fang Heng’s arrival completely changed the situation.

Now, the players were all in high spirits. They lined up to receive food and machetes. Their will to survive had been completely stimulated. Their morale was completely different from a few minutes ago.

Yu Jie nodded at Zhou Yi and continued, “Fang Heng, the biggest problem we’re facing now is food and weapons.
These aren’t enough to support us through the Tier 2 zombie wave.”
“I’ve prepared some weapons and food.
They should be enough.”
As he spoke, Fang Heng glanced at the sparse players on the East Square.
Great!
It would be better if those big guilds did not participate in this special event!
The players of the big guilds were stronger, but they were also more scheming.
They all wanted to get the greatest benefits from the event.
They often schemed in the team and it was difficult for them to cooperate wholeheartedly.
In comparison, the ordinary players did not have much ambition.
They only followed the big guilds and gaming companies to get some materials.
They were more obedient and more easily satisfied!
The start of a dream!
Fang Heng felt that this special event in the game was like a divine help!
“That’s great,” Yu Jie lowered his voice and asked in a low voice, “Fang Heng, where’s your zombie team?
Why didn’t I see them?
Are you unable to control the zombies during the special event?”
“Yeah, it’s a little overloaded.
Unless there’s an emergency, we will try to use it as little as possible.”
When Fang Heng came back, he walked around the auto repair shop and took more than 30 Lickers with him.
They were used to grow proliferators.
If it wasn’t an extremely dangerous situation, it was best not to let them enter combat mode together.
Hearing that Fang Heng could still control zombies to fight, Yu Jie felt a little relieved.
“That’s good.”
The two of them were discussing the battle plan when the game hint rang again.
[Hint: Tier 1 mission-end of assembly.
All players who have not completed the assemble mission will be automatically eliminated.]
[Hint: All surviving players in the current faction will vote to choose the faction leader.
The faction leader has the right to allocate the final faction points and special passive skills: hegemony (additional 100% HP and 50% basic attribute bonus).]
[Hint: Each player will have one vote by default.
You can choose any player in the faction.]
[Hint: If the faction leader is killed by a player from the faction, the killer will automatically become the new faction leader.
If the faction leader is killed by a player from the other faction, the killer will receive all the faction points in the current faction.]
[Hint: All players will vote for the faction leader within 60 minutes.
If no one votes by default after 60 minutes, the player with the most votes will be the faction leader.
If there are no votes, no one will be the faction leader.]
Upon seeing the game hint, the East Square fell silent once again.
Under normal circumstances, the Federation would not participate in the faction leader election.
The Federation would not take the initiative to attack the other three factions throughout the game.
They would choose to complete some side missions to earn some personal points in exchange for materials and rewards.
When necessary, the Federation would also protect the player’s safety, but it would try to reduce the number of disputes between players.

Putting aside the fact that the Federation, which had the strongest overall strength, did not participate in the election, the faction leader election was mostly the beginning of internal strife among the large guilds.
The various large guilds would often have disputes over the leader, and even fights would often occur.
But this time, it was very different.
All the players present in the Eastern faction were very weak.
Pairs of eyes turned to look at Fang Heng at the same time.
The shadow of a man’s reputation.
Fang Heng’s reputation was too great.
Who in the Eastern faction of Server 8 didn’t hear about Fang Heng and his prison army?
Not to mention, the other three factions also knew about Fang Heng’s strength.
His reputation had even spread to other servers.
Fang Heng was already prepared.
He was determined to become the faction leader.
Taking a step forward, Fang Heng gestured at Mo Jiawei with his mouth.
Fang Heng had deliberately spent some effort to get a truck, and he had also brought so many materials over, all to canvass votes!
Mo Jiawei understood and pulled the layer of oilcloth from the back of the truck.
Under the black oilcloth, there were shiny machetes, pistols and bullets, as well as boxes of compressed biscuits.
They were all food!
Seeing the compressed biscuits, the sound of players swallowing their saliva could be heard in the square.
The eyes of the player lit up!
Even though it was the lowest-level compressed biscuit, there was a probability of producing a negative effect of indigestion after consuming it.
Eating too much of it would also cause malnutrition...
However, they could not resist hunger!
There was no other way, the players were too hungry!
The satiety consumption of this lousy place was five times that of the outside world.
If it was water, it was still fine, and the method of obtaining it was simpler.
Even if it was river water, the game setting allowed the use of the bonfire to boil the water and drink it.
But in this deserted city, it was extremely difficult to find food!
Previously, the players had formed a search team and they managed to find a spicy hot pot shop.
Looking carefully, the shop was filled with zombies.
The players pondered for a long time, but in the end, they did not dare to go up and fight with the zombies.
This game was going to be impossible to play.
“Cough, cough.”
Fang Heng cleared his throat and prepared to give a domineering competition speech.
However, before he could say the first word, a line of small words appeared on his retina.
[Hint: Your votes have exceeded 50% of the current player’s votes.
You have become the leader of the Eastern faction.
You have obtained a special skill-hegemony (this skill will only take effect before the end of this special event).]
[Hint: The leader of the Eastern faction will be Fang Heng, the player.]
Ah, this...
Things were progressing too smoothly, and Fang Heng was momentarily stunned.
He had thought of many ways to win the election, but he had not expected things to go so smoothly...
“Eh, looks like everyone knows me.”
“Thank you for your support, in short...”
Looking at the pairs of expectant eyes below, Fang Heng sighed in his heart.
He turned to look at Mo Jiawei, “Forget it, I won’t say anymore.
Let’s distribute the materials.”
“Long live the Prison Army!!”
“The Prison Army is invincible!!”
“Follow the Prison Army forever!!!”
As soon as he finished speaking, the players immediately broke out into all kinds of slogans and thunderous applause.
Whatever they said was fake.
Only distributing the materials was the most real thing.
Fang Heng did not have many points.
After exchanging for the truck and a large amount of food, he only had twenty pistols and the rest were shiny machetes.
To avoid chaos, Yu Jie sent a few soldiers from the Federation to help maintain order and distribute the food and materials.
In the crowd, Qin Ming narrowed his eyes when he saw the players lining up to receive the materials.
Fang Heng!
He was indeed as terrifying as the rumours said.
The moment he entered the game, he thought of a way to get high-level trucks and a large amount of food!
Originally, the morale of the entire Eastern faction had already fallen to the bottom.
It was almost a hundred percent certain that they would die under the zombie wave.
However, Fang Heng’s arrival completely changed the situation.
Now, the players were all in high spirits.
They lined up to receive food and machetes.
Their will to survive had been completely stimulated.
Their morale was completely different from a few minutes ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 316 - Defending Against the Zombie Wave
paragraphs: Qin Ming had previously thought of deliberately provoking the players to snatch the food on Fang Heng’s truck.
However, before he could make a move, Fang Heng waved his hand and distributed the food and weapons.
Did he not know how much the food could be sold for?
With the Federation as his guarantor, he could sell the food to these players through offline trading!
Qin Ming knew that he could never be as generous as Fang Heng.
His gaze was focused on the truck filled with materials.
How did Fang Heng do it? How did he manage to gather such a large amount of survival materials in such a short time?
The players at the scene were still a little chaotic, but it was impossible to find an opportunity to destroy the food!
If this continued, the Eastern faction would be able to smoothly tide over the zombie wave!
He had to think of another way.
Qin Ming took a deep breath and left the East Square quietly while no one was paying attention.
He decided to find another way to sabotage.
When Qin Ming left, he didn’t notice that a pair of cold eyes were staring at him.
Yu Jie noticed Qin Ming’s strange behaviour.
He narrowed his eyes and remained expressionless.
“Captain Yu?” Zhou Yi looked in the direction of Yu Jie’s gaze and asked in puzzlement, “What’s wrong?”
“No, nothing.”
Yu Jie focused again and turned his head, continuing to discuss with everyone how to deal with the next zombie wave.
“The difficulty of the second zombie wave is related to the total number of players. Now that we have food and equipment, in theory, we can withstand the zombie wave, but...”

Lu Yu was also very clear about the current predicament. He added, “But currently, the overall strength of the players in our camp is weak, and we don’t have enough manpower to build a defense. It’s still very difficult to withstand this zombie wave.”
“Don’t worry. I still have a backup plan.”
“Really? What is it?”

Yu Jie and the others felt that it was a breeze to be teammates with Fang Heng! It was as if no matter what difficulties they encountered, Fang Heng had already done his homework in advance and came up with a smooth solution.
“Old Mo...”
Fang Heng waved his hand at Mo Jiawei, who was distributing food at the side.
“Let’s show them our trump card!”
“Okay!”
Not far away, Mo Jiawei, who was distributing food, responded. He jumped onto the trailer behind the truck and took out barrels of gasoline.
“Oh... gasoline??”
“So much gasoline?”
“Awesome! We can set up a kerosene formation and burn those zombies to death...”
Seeing so many barrels of gasoline, the players started to discuss excitedly.
Without realizing it, the players’ mentality had changed completely.
In the beginning, they were anxious, thinking that their lives would be given away for nothing.
Now, just over ten minutes after Fang Heng returned, the players suddenly felt that the upcoming zombie wave was not a big deal.
They lined up to receive the materials while discussing excitedly in twos and threes how to burn the zombies in the zombie wave.
Mo Jiawei showed the players the gasoline, then got out of the truck and continued to distribute the materials to the players.
He praised Fang Heng in his heart.
God is God, he thought far ahead.
Cleaning up the auto repair shop was killing three birds with one stone.
There was no food in the auto repair shop, but a large amount of gasoline could be collected.
After exchanging for the truck, the gasoline could also be brought back to defend against the zombie wave.
“Good stuff!”
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu were also excited when they saw the gasoline.
Gasoline was a good thing.
In addition to setting traps, it could also be used to make the Molotov cocktail.
Molotov cocktail was the most effective way to deal with large groups of zombies!
One bottle could cause a wide range of fire damage and continuous burning damage.
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu looked at each other. They felt that it was time for them to show off.
“God, we have a good idea.”
Fang Heng looked over.

Lu Yu took out the map of Haramori City and said, “The two of us have explored the terrain before. It’s right here. There’s a brewery here. There’s nothing else in there, but there must be a lot of beer bottles!”
Zhou Yi was also excited. He added, “With the beer bottles, we can make the Molotov cocktail! No matter how many zombies come, we’ll just give them to them!”
Hearing that, Yu Jie went up and looked at the map.

He turned his head and asked, “There should be a zombie horde inside the brewery. The zombie wave will appear in about one and a half hours. It’ll take some time for our people to walk there. Can we handle it?”
“Absolutely. We have investigated the periphery. There are not many zombies. We have the machetes now. It won’t be a big problem to deal with the zombies.”
Fang Heng immediately made a decision, “Okay, let’s not waste time. I’ll bring a group of people to try. If it doesn’t work, we’ll use gasoline to form a defensive line.”

“Okay.” Yu Jie nodded and said, “Fang Heng, my elite players have gun mastery. You bring them with you and think of a way to clean up the brewery. I’ll stay here and lead the rest of the people to form a zombie horde defense line.”
The few of them discussed for a while and then immediately split up.
Yu Jie stayed behind in the East Square to set up defenses, while Fang Heng led an elite team armed with pistols to the brewery.
An hour later, amidst the cheers of the players, Fang Heng drove the truck and carried a few cases of beer back to the East Square.
Liu Yi sat in the trailer behind the truck and bit open a bottle of beer. He gulped down a few mouthfuls and couldn’t help but let out a long sigh.
“Phew! Awesome!”
Most of the zombies in the beer factory were ordinary zombies.

The elite players of the Federation weren’t ordinary people. All of them had gun mastery skills. They had also learned fighting and knife skills outside of the game. They also had a tacit understanding of each other.
If it weren’t for the fact that they were pressed for time, they could have searched more thoroughly and brought back more beer.
Beer was also a good thing. After drinking it, they could slightly increase their recovery speed.
However, if they drank too much, they would also experience a negative dizzy state.
Boxes of beer were moved down from the truck. Yu Jie immediately arranged for his Federation players to make the Molotov cocktail.
The other players also worked together under Yu Jie’s arrangement to form a defensive line, setting up wooden spike traps and kerosene traps.
At this moment, the players had hope and saw the direction they were heading in. They were all fighting for the same goal, inspiring endless motivation.
The Eastern faction was united as never before.
Yu Jie was extremely confident in this battle. He even felt that it would be better if no other large guilds were participating in this special event.
If there were other guilds, the Eastern faction would not be so united.
Fifteen minutes later, the game hint appeared in the player’s vision again.
[Hint: You have triggered the Tier 2 mission-defending against zombie wave.]
Mission name: Defending against the zombie wave
Mission difficulty: S.

Mission description 1: In the next three hours, the East Square will be attacked by the zombie wave. There will be a continuous stream of zombies entering the square. When the number of zombies in the square exceeds 1500, the default mission will fail and all players from the faction will be eliminated.

Mission description 2: The faction leader can adjust the zombie spawn rate (initial and also the slowest-Level 1, highest is Level 10). After killing 4.76 million zombies, the zombie wave will automatically end, and each faction will be ranked according to the completion rate of the zombie wave (the faster the completion rate, the higher the additional reward the faction will receive).

Mission reward: The first player faction will receive food and materials, a safe shelter and additional points. The second player faction will receive a small amount of food and materials, the fourth player faction will receive a deduction of their safe time.
[Hint: The Tier 2 mission will officially begin in 5 minutes. The faction leader can adjust the spawning rate of the zombie wave in advance. Player, please be careful.]
