chapters.title: Chapter 317 - Molotov Cocktail
paragraphs: Fang Heng roughly looked at the game hint.
The Tier 2 mission was similar to previous special events, so there was nothing fancy or new.
“God, how is it?”
“Very steady.”
Fang Heng waved his machete in the air as he spoke.
He was very confident.
Even if the traps and Molotov cocktail couldn’t manage the zombie wave, there was still a group of backup Lickers who could join the battlefield at any time.
As he spoke, Fang Heng adjusted the spawn rate of the zombie wave to the maximum.
On the square, all the players received a hint at the same time.
[Hint: The spawn rate of the zombie wave in your area has been increased to Level 10.]
The maximum difficulty? So strong?
The players whispered to each other.
After all, without the participation of the various large guilds, they were more or less uncertain.
Fang Heng swept his calm gaze across the crowd.
“Brothers, everyone has noticed that most of the large guilds in the Eastern region did not join this game today.”
“Why?”
“At first, I also felt that it was strange, but later, I figured it out.”
“They’re scared. They don’t even have the courage to join the game!”
“But we do! Not only do we have it, we have to get first place! Let the people from the other three regions see how powerful our Eastern region is!”
“I often play on the forums. Many people in the comments say that my Prison Army is a bunch of greedy people.”
“They’re right. I’m just greedy!”
“Think about it carefully. We have so many Molotov cocktails and such a strong defensive line. Why shouldn’t we be greedy? Why shouldn’t we fight for first place?”
“Brothers, come with me to covet the best reward! Let those cowards regret it!”
Fang Heng said as he raised a bottle of beer, “For the reward!”
“Cheers!”
The players had drunk some beer before.
Under the effects of alcohol, the players were also a little intoxicated, and with Fang Heng’s bewitching...
They felt that Fang Heng’s words seemed to be right. Since they already had the Molotov cocktails, how could they not get first place?
The players raised their beer bottles one after another and echoed, “Cheers!”
“Gulp Gulp Gulp...”
“Bang! Bang Bang!”
Beer bottles fell to the ground one by one.
The eyes of the players were red with murderous intent.
After drinking a bottle of beer, even Lu Yu felt his blood boiling. He held the machete tightly in his hand.
[Hint: Tier 2 faction has officially opened.]
The players equipped themselves with machetes and Molotov cocktails, and then gathered at several entrances of the East Square and waited.
In the distance, a dark horde of zombies gradually revealed themselves.
The Federation players at the outermost layer had already started to aim and shoot with their pistols.
Fang Heng raised his machete and took the lead to charge into the zombie horde.
The hegemony skill increased 50% of basic attribute and doubled the HP!
Under the passive skill-bullet time, Fang Heng saw that the zombie horde’s movements were as slow as a turtle’s crawl!
He swung his machete again and again, and each time, he could easily hit the zombie’s head, killing it in one hit!
[Hint: You have killed a normal zombie. You have gained 1 point. You have gained 5 seconds of safe time.]
[Hint: You have killed a Tier 1 mutated zombie. You have gained 2 points. You have gained 15 seconds of safe time...]
Fang Heng quickly reaped the lives of the zombies.
Seeing Fang Heng’s bravery, the morale of the players soared again!
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu looked at each other and carefully swallowed their saliva.
Fang Heng was so brave?
Fang Heng was different from the last time they saw each other!
He had cheated!
How did he do it?
Yu Jie didn’t join the battlefield. He looked at Fang Heng who was fighting bravely against the zombie horde with a strange expression on his face.
Fang Heng’s combat ability also surprised him.
He originally thought that Fang Heng’s strength was based on his ability to control zombies.
Without the Lickers and zombie team, Fang Heng could only be considered an experienced ordinary player.
However, at this moment, Yu Jie suddenly realized that Fang Heng’s ability in close combat was far superior to ordinary people!

Yu Jie suppressed the doubts in his heart and waved his hand to signal for the players of the federal team at the back to press forward. They followed Fang Heng’s footsteps and quickly cleared the zombie horde.
Yu Jie surveyed the battlefield.
He was very clear in his heart that it was not difficult to survive this zombie wave with the help of a large number of incendiary bombs.

After all, this was the first time Server 8 had experienced a special event. The difficulty of the zombie wave was not high. The ones that spawned were all ordinary zombies. Occasionally, one or two Tier 1 mutated zombies would appear.
Originally, the difficulty of this zombie wave was how to fill their stomachs, obtain weapons and build defensive facilities.
Fang Heng’s arrival had perfectly solved these three problems.
The Molotov cocktails were extremely useful against a large group of zombies!
If a Molotov cocktail was used, a large group of zombies would be burned, and their HP would continuously drop.
After killing dozens of zombies, Fang Heng began to think of a way to retreat.
Bullet time was effective but it also consumed a lot of stamina. In just five minutes, two-thirds of his stamina had been consumed.
After retreating to the back of the defense line, Fang Heng once again looked around.
Everything was under control!
The situation of the zombie wave was much better than expected!
The defensive traps set in the core area of the East Square had not been triggered, and there were still many Molotov cocktails left.
The zombie horde could not break through the entrance of East Square!
It was a sure win!
Fang Heng was about to take a break when he suddenly frowned.
What was that?
In the distance, a large group of zombies swarmed over from the right side of the square.
There were so many of them that there seemed to be more than 10,000 of them.
What was going on?
Fang Heng was confused.
The zombie horde had been refreshed at the maximum speed, so why was there suddenly a large group of zombies?
The other players also noticed a large group of zombies swarming over from the distance, and they all realized that things were not looking good for them.
For a moment, the players whose morale was initially high were now in a mess.
Something was wrong!
Fang Heng suddenly turned his head to look at Yu Jie, who was not far away.
Coincidentally, Fang Heng met Yu Jie’s gaze.
Qin Ming slashed the two zombies that were blocking the road. He ran through the periphery of the Eastern District and arrived in front of Yu Jie.

“Captain Yu Jie, we’re in trouble. Someone destroyed the barbed wire that was blocking the zombies at the east school. A large number of zombies were attracted by the noise here and came directly toward us.”
Yu Jie’s heart sank as his eyes were fixed on Qin Ming.
What a coincidence?
Qin Ming had a guilty conscience. Being stared at by Yu Jie like this, he immediately felt a heavy burden on his shoulder.
Yu Jie’s eyes seemed to be able to see through Qin Ming’s heart. He stared at Qin Ming and asked in a deep voice, “Really?”
Qin Ming didn’t even dare to look directly into Yu Jie’s eyes. He couldn’t help but feel his legs trembling slightly.
Quite a number of players in the surroundings were also attracted by this scene and were looking at them.
Qin Ming gritted his teeth and said directly, “I’m sorry, I...”
Halfway through his words, Qin Ming felt a heavy slap on his shoulder.
“Well done, brother!”
Turning around, Qin Ming was stunned when he saw Fang Heng with a smile on his face.

sentences.text: Fang Heng roughly looked at the game hint.
The Tier 2 mission was similar to previous special events, so there was nothing fancy or new.
“God, how is it?”
“Very steady.”
Fang Heng waved his machete in the air as he spoke.
He was very confident.
Even if the traps and Molotov cocktail couldn’t manage the zombie wave, there was still a group of backup Lickers who could join the battlefield at any time.
As he spoke, Fang Heng adjusted the spawn rate of the zombie wave to the maximum.
On the square, all the players received a hint at the same time.
[Hint: The spawn rate of the zombie wave in your area has been increased to Level 10.]
The maximum difficulty?
So strong?
The players whispered to each other.
After all, without the participation of the various large guilds, they were more or less uncertain.
Fang Heng swept his calm gaze across the crowd.
“Brothers, everyone has noticed that most of the large guilds in the Eastern region did not join this game today.”
“Why?”
“At first, I also felt that it was strange, but later, I figured it out.”
“They’re scared.
They don’t even have the courage to join the game!”
“But we do!
Not only do we have it, we have to get first place!
Let the people from the other three regions see how powerful our Eastern region is!”
“I often play on the forums.
Many people in the comments say that my Prison Army is a bunch of greedy people.”
“They’re right.
I’m just greedy!”
“Think about it carefully.
We have so many Molotov cocktails and such a strong defensive line.
Why shouldn’t we be greedy?
Why shouldn’t we fight for first place?”
“Brothers, come with me to covet the best reward!
Let those cowards regret it!”
Fang Heng said as he raised a bottle of beer, “For the reward!”
“Cheers!”
The players had drunk some beer before.
Under the effects of alcohol, the players were also a little intoxicated, and with Fang Heng’s bewitching...
They felt that Fang Heng’s words seemed to be right.
Since they already had the Molotov cocktails, how could they not get first place?
The players raised their beer bottles one after another and echoed, “Cheers!”
“Gulp Gulp Gulp...”
“Bang!
Bang Bang!”
Beer bottles fell to the ground one by one.
The eyes of the players were red with murderous intent.
After drinking a bottle of beer, even Lu Yu felt his blood boiling.
He held the machete tightly in his hand.
[Hint: Tier 2 faction has officially opened.]
The players equipped themselves with machetes and Molotov cocktails, and then gathered at several entrances of the East Square and waited.
In the distance, a dark horde of zombies gradually revealed themselves.
The Federation players at the outermost layer had already started to aim and shoot with their pistols.
Fang Heng raised his machete and took the lead to charge into the zombie horde.
The hegemony skill increased 50% of basic attribute and doubled the HP!
Under the passive skill-bullet time, Fang Heng saw that the zombie horde’s movements were as slow as a turtle’s crawl!
He swung his machete again and again, and each time, he could easily hit the zombie’s head, killing it in one hit!
[Hint: You have killed a normal zombie.
You have gained 1 point.
You have gained 5 seconds of safe time.]
[Hint: You have killed a Tier 1 mutated zombie.
You have gained 2 points.
You have gained 15 seconds of safe time...]
Fang Heng quickly reaped the lives of the zombies.
Seeing Fang Heng’s bravery, the morale of the players soared again!
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu looked at each other and carefully swallowed their saliva.
Fang Heng was so brave?
Fang Heng was different from the last time they saw each other!
He had cheated!
How did he do it?
Yu Jie didn’t join the battlefield.
He looked at Fang Heng who was fighting bravely against the zombie horde with a strange expression on his face.
Fang Heng’s combat ability also surprised him.
He originally thought that Fang Heng’s strength was based on his ability to control zombies.
Without the Lickers and zombie team, Fang Heng could only be considered an experienced ordinary player.
However, at this moment, Yu Jie suddenly realized that Fang Heng’s ability in close combat was far superior to ordinary people!
Yu Jie suppressed the doubts in his heart and waved his hand to signal for the players of the federal team at the back to press forward.
They followed Fang Heng’s footsteps and quickly cleared the zombie horde.
Yu Jie surveyed the battlefield.
He was very clear in his heart that it was not difficult to survive this zombie wave with the help of a large number of incendiary bombs.
After all, this was the first time Server 8 had experienced a special event.
The difficulty of the zombie wave was not high.
The ones that spawned were all ordinary zombies.
Occasionally, one or two Tier 1 mutated zombies would appear.
Originally, the difficulty of this zombie wave was how to fill their stomachs, obtain weapons and build defensive facilities.
Fang Heng’s arrival had perfectly solved these three problems.
The Molotov cocktails were extremely useful against a large group of zombies!
If a Molotov cocktail was used, a large group of zombies would be burned, and their HP would continuously drop.
After killing dozens of zombies, Fang Heng began to think of a way to retreat.
Bullet time was effective but it also consumed a lot of stamina.
In just five minutes, two-thirds of his stamina had been consumed.
After retreating to the back of the defense line, Fang Heng once again looked around.
Everything was under control!
The situation of the zombie wave was much better than expected!
The defensive traps set in the core area of the East Square had not been triggered, and there were still many Molotov cocktails left.
The zombie horde could not break through the entrance of East Square!
It was a sure win!
Fang Heng was about to take a break when he suddenly frowned.
What was that?
In the distance, a large group of zombies swarmed over from the right side of the square.
There were so many of them that there seemed to be more than 10,000 of them.
What was going on?
Fang Heng was confused.
The zombie horde had been refreshed at the maximum speed, so why was there suddenly a large group of zombies?
The other players also noticed a large group of zombies swarming over from the distance, and they all realized that things were not looking good for them.
For a moment, the players whose morale was initially high were now in a mess.
Something was wrong!
Fang Heng suddenly turned his head to look at Yu Jie, who was not far away.
Coincidentally, Fang Heng met Yu Jie’s gaze.
Qin Ming slashed the two zombies that were blocking the road.
He ran through the periphery of the Eastern District and arrived in front of Yu Jie.
“Captain Yu Jie, we’re in trouble.
Someone destroyed the barbed wire that was blocking the zombies at the east school.
A large number of zombies were attracted by the noise here and came directly toward us.”
Yu Jie’s heart sank as his eyes were fixed on Qin Ming.
What a coincidence?
Qin Ming had a guilty conscience.
Being stared at by Yu Jie like this, he immediately felt a heavy burden on his shoulder.
Yu Jie’s eyes seemed to be able to see through Qin Ming’s heart.
He stared at Qin Ming and asked in a deep voice, “Really?”
Qin Ming didn’t even dare to look directly into Yu Jie’s eyes.
He couldn’t help but feel his legs trembling slightly.
Quite a number of players in the surroundings were also attracted by this scene and were looking at them.
Qin Ming gritted his teeth and said directly, “I’m sorry, I...”
Halfway through his words, Qin Ming felt a heavy slap on his shoulder.
“Well done, brother!”
Turning around, Qin Ming was stunned when he saw Fang Heng with a smile on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 318 - Crushing
paragraphs: Turning around, Qin Ming was stunned when he saw Fang Heng’s smiling face.
Fang Heng was still patting Qin Ming’s shoulder. He turned around and explained to Yu Jie.
“Yu Jie, I arranged for a group of people to lure some zombies over. This will speed up the completion of our zombie wave.”
The shock on Yu Jie’s face disappeared in a flash. He quickly looked at Fang Heng.
Fang Heng laughed and patted Qin Ming’s back. He praised, “Impressive, Qin Ming. I didn’t expect you to attract so many zombies at once. When this wave is over, you can take credit for it.”
Qin Ming was about to put up a desperate fight, but when he heard Fang Heng’s words, he suddenly felt baffled.
What was going on? What happened?
Did he misunderstand something?
Fang Heng was still very enthusiastic. “By the way, how should I address you, brother?”
Qin Ming squirmed his throat. “Qin Ming from Qin Fen Gaming Company.”
“Well done!”
Fang Heng took out a loudspeaker from his backpack as he spoke.
“Brothers! There’s work to do! This wave of zombies was lured here by my team! All of you, get your spirits up!”
“Don’t be scared by their numbers! Aren’t they just ordinary zombies? Stay far away from them. Just drop the Molotov cocktail and they’ll die!”
“Just use the Molotov cocktails to handle them. The faster we kill the monsters and complete the zombie wave mission, the more rewards we’ll get!”
Wow! So it was all arranged by Fang Heng!
The players understood in their hearts.
That’s right, the zombies were crowded together. Wasn’t it the best solution to use the Molotov cocktail to kill them?
One bottle could kill at least a dozen zombies!
The players were a little nervous when they saw the horde of zombies approaching them.
Hearing Fang Heng’s words, most of the pressure on the players was relieved.
Since everything was Fang Heng’s plan, there was nothing to be afraid of!
A few brave players rushed to the front and threw a few Molotov cocktails at the zombie horde.
Instantly, the game hint refreshed crazily, and the points and game safe time increased rapidly!
“F*ck! That’s awesome!”
The player testing the damage was so excited that he couldn’t speak.
It was the first time he had tried such a terrifying efficiency of killing monsters since he started playing the game!
The other players also followed suit and rushed to the place where the zombies were gathered, using the Molotov cocktail to bombard the place.
The speed at which the zombies were eliminated in the entire East Square had once again increased greatly!
The scene in front of Qin Ming’s eyes stunned him.
What was going on? Where did they get so many Molotov cocktails?
Fang Heng even sent people to lure the zombies over?
Qin Ming was completely confused.
He had checked the map of the city and spent a lot of effort to lure the zombies from the nearby gathering point to this place.
In Qin Ming’s imagination, it was already very difficult for the players of the Eastern faction to defend against the zombie wave with only the machete in their hands!
Together with the large group of zombies that he had attracted, the entire East Square would fall!
But now...
It was a one-sided massacre!
Qin Ming could not understand what was happening in front of him.
Under the attack of the incendiary bombs, the zombies had no way to resist!
[Hint: The number of zombies in the Eastern region has reached 45%.]
After throwing a bunch of incendiary bombs, the players realized that the zombie horde was not scary at all. In their eyes, these zombies were like piles of experience points!
“Brother, you did well! Thank you for your hard work.”
Fang Heng pretended to be enthusiastic and patted Qin Ming’s shoulder to praise him.
He thought to himself that this kid was a talent. He worked hard for half a day, but in the end, he helped him a lot.
“No, it’s okay. It’s good that I can be of some help to everyone.”
Qin Ming smiled awkwardly.
He wasn’t sure if Fang Heng was being sarcastic.
“Come, try this.” Fang Heng stuffed a bag of biscuits into his hand. “By the way, what about the other player who went out with you to lure zombies? He didn’t go with you?”
“No, we left one after another.”
Qin Ming pretended to be calm and continued.
“No, we separated halfway.”
He felt that the more he talked, the easier it would be for his lie to be exposed. Therefore, he hurriedly nodded and said, “Fang Heng, I’ll go and help.”
“Okay.”
Seeing Qin Ming leave as if he was running away, Yu Jie walked over and whispered to Fang Heng, “Fang Heng, there’s something wrong with him.”
“I know.”
Fang Heng licked his lips. “I have to rely on your help. Think of a way to investigate his identity and background.”
“Yes, I’ll get someone to do it after the Tier 2 mission is unlocked and we can go offline. However, are you still planning to keep him? Isn’t it a little risky?”
“Let’s wait and see. I’m very curious about his real purpose. Why did he want to destroy our Eastern faction? Who is the mastermind behind this?”
Fang Heng pondered and said, “It’s always a little unpleasant to be tricked by someone. We can still retaliate if we keep him alive.”
“That’s good too.” Yu Jie nodded and said, “I’ll keep an eye on him.”
[Hint: The Eastern faction took 26 minutes and 21 seconds to complete the mission-defend against the zombie wave. They are ranked first and will receive the highest level reward.]
The game hint flashed across the retina of all the players in Haramori City.
So fast?
In the other three regional squares, the players who were fighting the zombie wave had strange expressions on their faces.
The zombie wave had only started for less than half an hour, and the Eastern faction had already completed it?
The Eastern faction had gone crazy this year?
How did they do it!
Seeing the players who looked like they had seen a ghost, the leader of the Western faction also felt his heart sink.
Their faction was extremely lucky. During the gathering process, they found 20 landmines.
They thought that victory was within their grasp, but who would have thought that the Eastern faction’s players were even more terrifying.
“Don’t be distracted! Continue! Do you all want to be eliminated? If the first place is gone, there’s still the second place!”
Hearing this, the players got back their senses and continued to focus on dealing with the zombie wave that was pouring into the square.
At the same time, in the East Square, once the zombies stopped spawning, the crowd burst into cheers.
“We won!”
“We won!”
It was too easy! It was just like a dream!
[Hint: You have completed Tier 2 mission-defending against the zombie wave.]

[Hint: The Eastern faction is the first to complete the mission. You have obtained the mission reward-coordinates of the safe point: Haramori City (278, 273). You can find materials in the safe point and the zombies will not spawn near the safe point tonight.]

[Hint: You have obtained 37,551 faction points. You can assign the points to any player in your faction after the end of this special event (the player must successfully clear the level and survive).]
[Hint: Haramori City is in a special location. The nighttime is only six hours. Player, please get ready.]
[Hint: Tier 3 mission will be released within 30 minutes after all factions complete Tier 2 mission.]
[Hint: The player’s offline function has been unlocked. Player can use the simple bed function to log off.]
[Hint: The inquiry function is open. Player can inquire about the number of remaining players from other factions and the location of the shelter.]
Fang Heng quickly checked the game hint.
The faction leader’s authority was extremely high. With 37,000 faction points, when everyone got a share, he would naturally get the lion’s share.

chapters.title: Chapter 319 - Tier 3
paragraphs: In addition, the game also rewarded them: A shelter.
At least for tonight, if they stay in the shelter, they didn’t have to worry about zombie attacks and could sleep peacefully.
The players were especially excited.

Not only did they earn a lot from the zombie wave mission, but they also earned a free shelter. They didn’t have to work so hard to find a shelter as the players in the other regions, nor do they need to search for food and materials...
Just thinking about it made Zhou Yi feel good.
“Hey, what’s wrong with you guys? Didn’t we win? Why do you all look distraught?”
“We won for the time being. The real crisis has just begun.”
Yu Jie shook his head and explained, “Zhou Yi, our Eastern region player count is very low.”
Zhou Yi opened the game query function to check the faction details.
The joy on his face instantly dissipated by more than half.
The number of players in the other three factions was more than 10 times their number!
“There’s something even more troublesome. The other three factions must also know that our faction obtained the first place and obtained the food and materials reward.”
“In their eyes, we have fewer people, our overall strength is weaker and we also have a lot of materials.”
Lu Yu said in a deep voice, “Without a doubt, we will become the most perfect prey in their eyes.”
“Ah, this...”
Zhou Yi’s expression also became heavy.
They had won, and it was a huge victory. Why did it sound more and more dangerous?
“There’s no need to be so nervous. We’ll just have to defend ourselves.”
Fang Heng laughed, easing the tense atmosphere.
He was not flustered at all. He was very relaxed.
From the beginning to the end, he did not take the players from the other three factions too seriously.
Fang Heng had been competing with the King of Gods’ game, thinking about how he could maximize the benefits of this special event and take one more wave of benefits.
“Besides, maybe the Tier 3 mission will be exciting?”
Fang Heng was looking forward to Tier 3 of the mission.
In every game, the first two tiers of the mission were about the same, but starting from Tier 3, the mission would be very different.
“Clean up the battlefield. We’ll go back to the system shelter first and then make the next step.”
Fang Heng and Yu Jie had a simple discussion. They immediately led the team to clean up the battlefield and move to the system shelter.
Crimson Technology headquarters.
Shen Xiaoxiao, the secretary with a slim figure, walked into the meeting room.
“Manager he, we just received news from Qin Ming that the Eastern faction has successfully survived the second zombie wave and has even received the first place reward.”
“That’s impossible!”
He Liang stood up from his office chair.
He looked as if he had seen a ghost and stared at Shen Xiaoxiao.
Shen Xiaoxiao was shocked by He Liang’s expression and couldn’t help but take half a step back.
He Liang said in a deep voice, “Continue!”

“Qin Ming explained that Fang Heng obtained a large number of Molotov cocktails through some unknown method in the game. The Eastern faction players used the Molotov cocktails to protect the square and even increased the efficiency of killing zombies. In the end, they got first place in the Tier 2 mission.”
“Molotov cocktail? There must be at least hundreds of Molotov cocktails to resist the zombie wave. How did he get so many Molotov cocktails from the game?”
“I don’t know. Qin Ming didn’t explain that.”
He Liang opened his mouth. He realized that he had lost his composure and sat back in his office chair.
“Is it a zombie team? Can Fang Heng control Lickers during the special event?”
Shen Xiaoxiao shook her head and said, “According to Qin Ming’s feedback, Fang Heng didn’t control Lickers or any zombies during the special event.”
“Bang!”
He Liang punched the table with all his strength and said hatefully, “That trash!”
Shen Xiaoxiao lowered her head and didn’t say a word.
“What else did he say?”

“In the previous battle, the Eastern region players have used up most of the Molotov cocktails. Although they received the reward shelter provided by the system, the overall situation of the players is not optimistic.”
“Qin Ming suggested that we contact the other three faction players offline to launch a surprise attack on the Eastern faction’s shelter.”
He Liang rubbed his aching temples and tried his best to restrain his anger and remain calm.
The Molotov cocktail was indeed very effective against large numbers of zombies, but it was not so effective against players.
Moreover, after the end of the Tier 2 mission, all faction information was made public.
The players of the three factions would realise that Fang Heng’s Eastern faction had the least number of players and the weakest strength!
Their crisis had just begun!
He Liang also received accurate information from Qin Ming that Fang Heng didn’t show his ability to control the zombie team during the special event.
Fang Heng might not be able to do that!
In theory, everything was going according to plan.
Even if Fang Heng was lucky enough to get through Tier 2, he would not be able to get through Tier 3 safely!
But for some reason, He Liang felt more and more uneasy.
He was confused.
Where did Fang Heng get so many incendiary bombs?
If this problem could not be solved, He Liang could not sleep or eat in peace.
He Liang asked in a deep voice, “Does Qin Ming know what Fang Heng and the others are going to do next?”
“There’s no news yet. They have just arrived at the shelter which was their Tier 2 reward.”
“Help me pass a message to Qin Ming. Tell him not to make any move and to keep an eye on him. If anything happens, report back.”
“Okay.”
[Hint: You have found and occupied a special shelter. You can bind the camp’s shelter here.]

[Hint: You can spend 10,000 faction points to unbind the shelter once (if you unbind it multiple times, the cost will be doubled). You need to re-bind the new shelter within 1 hour after unbinding. If the player dies or is eliminated in the process, all Eastern faction players will be eliminated. If the binding is not completed after 1 hour, all Eastern faction players will be eliminated.]
The system reward’s shelter was a large abandoned warehouse near the sea.
Fang Heng had just arrived at the warehouse when a row of game hints appeared in his vision.
[Hint: All factions have completed Tier 2 zombie wave. Player has triggered Tier 3 mission-faction shelter.]
Mission name: Faction shelter.
Mission 1: Player is requested to find a suitable location (the location of the shelter confirmed by the system) within 3.5 hours to bind the faction shelter.
Mission 2: Player is requested to guard the faction shelter for 24 hours. If the faction shelter is destroyed during the process, all players from the faction will be eliminated.
Mission 3 (optional): Attack the other faction’s shelter. You will receive all faction points and additional points as rewards.
Penalty for failure: If Mission 1 or Mission 2 fails, all players from the faction will be eliminated.
The hint for Tier 3 mission surprised Fang Heng.
It was a faction-based killing mission!
In previous games, missions like this were the most tragic.
Yu Jie did not dare to be careless. After receiving the hint for the mission, he immediately discussed the next battle strategy with Fang Heng and the others.

“We won for the time being.
The real crisis has just begun.”
Yu Jie shook his head and explained, “Zhou Yi, our Eastern region player count is very low.”
Zhou Yi opened the game query function to check the faction details.
The joy on his face instantly dissipated by more than half.
The number of players in the other three factions was more than 10 times their number!
“There’s something even more troublesome.
The other three factions must also know that our faction obtained the first place and obtained the food and materials reward.”
“In their eyes, we have fewer people, our overall strength is weaker and we also have a lot of materials.”
Lu Yu said in a deep voice, “Without a doubt, we will become the most perfect prey in their eyes.”
“Ah, this...”
Zhou Yi’s expression also became heavy.
They had won, and it was a huge victory.
Why did it sound more and more dangerous?
“There’s no need to be so nervous.
We’ll just have to defend ourselves.”
Fang Heng laughed, easing the tense atmosphere.
He was not flustered at all.
He was very relaxed.
From the beginning to the end, he did not take the players from the other three factions too seriously.
Fang Heng had been competing with the King of Gods’ game, thinking about how he could maximize the benefits of this special event and take one more wave of benefits.
“Besides, maybe the Tier 3 mission will be exciting?”
Fang Heng was looking forward to Tier 3 of the mission.
In every game, the first two tiers of the mission were about the same, but starting from Tier 3, the mission would be very different.
“Clean up the battlefield.
We’ll go back to the system shelter first and then make the next step.”
Fang Heng and Yu Jie had a simple discussion.
They immediately led the team to clean up the battlefield and move to the system shelter.
Crimson Technology headquarters.
Shen Xiaoxiao, the secretary with a slim figure, walked into the meeting room.
“Manager he, we just received news from Qin Ming that the Eastern faction has successfully survived the second zombie wave and has even received the first place reward.”
“That’s impossible!”
He Liang stood up from his office chair.
He looked as if he had seen a ghost and stared at Shen Xiaoxiao.
Shen Xiaoxiao was shocked by He Liang’s expression and couldn’t help but take half a step back.
He Liang said in a deep voice, “Continue!”
“Qin Ming explained that Fang Heng obtained a large number of Molotov cocktails through some unknown method in the game.
The Eastern faction players used the Molotov cocktails to protect the square and even increased the efficiency of killing zombies.
In the end, they got first place in the Tier 2 mission.”
“Molotov cocktail?
There must be at least hundreds of Molotov cocktails to resist the zombie wave.
How did he get so many Molotov cocktails from the game?”
“I don’t know.
Qin Ming didn’t explain that.”
He Liang opened his mouth.
He realized that he had lost his composure and sat back in his office chair.
“Is it a zombie team?
Can Fang Heng control Lickers during the special event?”
Shen Xiaoxiao shook her head and said, “According to Qin Ming’s feedback, Fang Heng didn’t control Lickers or any zombies during the special event.”
“Bang!”
He Liang punched the table with all his strength and said hatefully, “That trash!”
Shen Xiaoxiao lowered her head and didn’t say a word.
“What else did he say?”
“In the previous battle, the Eastern region players have used up most of the Molotov cocktails.
Although they received the reward shelter provided by the system, the overall situation of the players is not optimistic.”
“Qin Ming suggested that we contact the other three faction players offline to launch a surprise attack on the Eastern faction’s shelter.”
He Liang rubbed his aching temples and tried his best to restrain his anger and remain calm.
The Molotov cocktail was indeed very effective against large numbers of zombies, but it was not so effective against players.
Moreover, after the end of the Tier 2 mission, all faction information was made public.
The players of the three factions would realise that Fang Heng’s Eastern faction had the least number of players and the weakest strength!
Their crisis had just begun!
He Liang also received accurate information from Qin Ming that Fang Heng didn’t show his ability to control the zombie team during the special event.
Fang Heng might not be able to do that!
In theory, everything was going according to plan.
Even if Fang Heng was lucky enough to get through Tier 2, he would not be able to get through Tier 3 safely!
But for some reason, He Liang felt more and more uneasy.
He was confused.
Where did Fang Heng get so many incendiary bombs?
If this problem could not be solved, He Liang could not sleep or eat in peace.
He Liang asked in a deep voice, “Does Qin Ming know what Fang Heng and the others are going to do next?”
“There’s no news yet.
They have just arrived at the shelter which was their Tier 2 reward.”
“Help me pass a message to Qin Ming.
Tell him not to make any move and to keep an eye on him.
If anything happens, report back.”
“Okay.”
[Hint: You have found and occupied a special shelter.
You can bind the camp’s shelter here.]
[Hint: You can spend 10,000 faction points to unbind the shelter once (if you unbind it multiple times, the cost will be doubled).
You need to re-bind the new shelter within 1 hour after unbinding.
If the player dies or is eliminated in the process, all Eastern faction players will be eliminated.
If the binding is not completed after 1 hour, all Eastern faction players will be eliminated.]
The system reward’s shelter was a large abandoned warehouse near the sea.
Fang Heng had just arrived at the warehouse when a row of game hints appeared in his vision.
[Hint: All factions have completed Tier 2 zombie wave.
Player has triggered Tier 3 mission-faction shelter.]
Mission name: Faction shelter.
Mission 1: Player is requested to find a suitable location (the location of the shelter confirmed by the system) within 3.5 hours to bind the faction shelter.
Mission 2: Player is requested to guard the faction shelter for 24 hours.
If the faction shelter is destroyed during the process, all players from the faction will be eliminated.
Mission 3 (optional): Attack the other faction’s shelter.
You will receive all faction points and additional points as rewards.
Penalty for failure: If Mission 1 or Mission 2 fails, all players from the faction will be eliminated.
The hint for Tier 3 mission surprised Fang Heng.
It was a faction-based killing mission!
In previous games, missions like this were the most tragic.
Yu Jie did not dare to be careless.
After receiving the hint for the mission, he immediately discussed the next battle strategy with Fang Heng and the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 320 - Catapult Device
paragraphs: There were still three and a half hours before sunset. Players from the other three factions did not receive any rewards, so they could only rely on themselves to find shelter.
After binding the faction shelter, players from the other factions could find out the specific coordinates through the system, so Fang Heng was not in a hurry to bind it.
Since the Eastern faction had found the shelter ahead of the others, they had nearly three and a half hours more development time than the rest.

“We’ve already searched the warehouse. There are still a lot of canned fruits and water left in the storage room at the back. There are benefits to having fewer players in our faction. These are enough for us to eat for three to four days.”
Yu Jie briefly explained the situation of the system shelter to everyone.
“We don’t lack food and water. What we lack the most right now are weapons.”

“We’ve almost used up all the Molotov cocktails to deal with the zombie wave. They’re very effective against zombies, but they’re very average to players. We need to hurry up and think of ways to arm the team.”
“Also, the system defense will protect us tonight. We just need to be careful of other players.”
“The possibility of other players launching an attack on the first night is not high, but we still have to do a good job of defense.”
“Later, I will have people re-check the defense of the warehouse. I will also arrange for people to take turns to guard the warehouse at night.”
“There will also be some gaps in the construction materials. Wood can be obtained by felling trees and furniture. The main thing is that we lack tools...”
As Yu Jie spoke, he spread out a map on the table.
“I’m going to send people to start from the nearest gun shop, medicine shop and hardware store.”
During special events, the damage of guns to players was reduced by 50%. However, guns were still the most effective way of attacking players in combat.
Robbing a gun store was a good choice.
“Fang Heng, what do you think?”
Everyone turned to look at Fang Heng.
“Not bad, you guys go ahead. I’ve received a special mission and I need to finish it quickly. I’ll come back to look for you guys after I finish it.”
“Special mission?” Yu Jie was stunned, and then he realized, “You mean Wendy’s mission?”
“Yes.”
“I know this mission. The mission difficulty is quite high.”
Yu Jie did not know that Fang Heng had already completed more than half of Wendy’s missions. He thought that Fang Heng had only just received the mission.
He advised, “Fang Heng, I do not recommend you to participate. This mission consumes a lot of time and energy. You need to gather the strength of the entire faction to complete it.”
“It doesn’t matter. I have plans. While the players from the other three factions are still looking for shelter, I will complete it as soon as possible.”
Yu Jie sighed in his heart.
He felt that Fang Heng was still too young.
What were three hours?
In the old region, he had gathered the strength of the entire faction and spent 30 hours just to complete the first part of the special mission.
Tier 2 was even more troublesome.
Usually, the player would leave after completing Tier 1.
Yu Jie nodded and said, “Alright then. Wendy’s mission is very complicated. You have to be mentally prepared.”
“Okay, let’s split up.”
After a simple discussion, Fang Heng and Yu Jie split up. They agreed to contact each other through survival radio if they encountered any special situations.
Fang Heng was about to drive the truck back to the city centre with Mo Jiawei when Zhou Yi and Lu Yu quickly followed.
Zhou Yi came up and whispered outside the window, “God, don’t be in a hurry to leave. There’s a special mission that I mentioned to you before.”
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows and opened the truck door.
“Let’s go. Let’s talk inside.”
Fang Heng had heard from Pei Anan that Zhou Yi had found a special mission through a special channel and was able to make a large sum of money from this special event.
“The people from the Federation were here just now. I didn’t dare to mention it.”
Only when the truck left the warehouse area did Zhou Yi chuckle.
“This is a mission that I learned from a special channel. It doesn’t come from an honest source.”
Lu Yu nudged Zhou Yi with his elbow. “Boss, let’s get down to business.”
“Oh, oh, it’s like this. I learned that there’s a super-sized modern weapons factory in Haramori City. The resources in the weapons factory are enough to equip an army of a few hundred people!”
Zhou Yi was inexplicably excited. “Most importantly, there are firearms forging blueprints and precision instruments for manufacturing guns!”
Fang Heng nodded.
This information was very useful.
However, to him, the temptation was not that great.
After the zombie team was formed, the players were no longer a threat in his eyes.
Firearms were just to improve the safety of the camp shelter.
It was like the icing on the cake.
“Cough, cough.” Lu Yu saw Fang Heng’s indifferent expression and coughed lightly. He could not help but remind him again, “Boss, let’s get down to business.”
“I know. Don’t rush me.”
Zhou Yi looked at Lu Yu with dissatisfaction.
He turned to look at Fang Heng and said word by word, “God, we can still think of a way to transport these weapons out of Haramori City.”
“What? Send them out?”
Fang Heng was stunned.
He turned to look at Zhou Yi.
“There’s such an operation?”
According to what Fang Heng knew, the special incident was indeed in a certain region of the apocalypse game world.
However, he had never heard of a player moving materials out of Haramori City.
This was because Haramori City was surrounded by a type of purple poisonous gas.
The purple poisonous gas was extremely toxic and corrosive.
The high concentration of the poisonous gas would kill the player instantly.
Even if the player wore a full set of biochemical clothes, if he were to be exposed to the poisonous gas for five to six minutes, the biochemical clothes would still be damaged due to corrosion.
After the game officially started, the concentration of the poisonous gas around Haramori City would gradually decrease, but it would not disappear immediately.
In the past, after a special event, the city would always be destroyed because of all kinds of accidents.
“It can be done! A friend of mine tested it himself.”
“It took me a lot of effort to get this method. It’s reliable.”
Zhou Yi’s eyes lit up when he said this, and he was a little excited.
Mo Jiawei was also curious, so he came up and asked, “What method?”
“God is right. Haramori City is surrounded by poisonous gas, so it’s impossible to walk on the ground, so we have to find another way...”
Mo Jiawei instantly understood.
He asked almost reflexively, “We have to dig a tunnel?”
“No, that’s not it.”
Zhou Yi raised his hand and pointed at the roof of the car.
“We have to fly from the sky.”
“You mean a helicopter?”

Mo Jiawei frowned when he heard that. “I don’t think so. I’ve checked the information. The poisonous gas in the periphery of Haramori City is very powerful. Even at high altitudes, the helicopter will be affected by the poisonous gas and will soon fall due to the corrosion of the propeller.”
“No, no, no. We don’t need something as high-end as a helicopter yet.”

“We just need to make a strong catapult device with super high torque, bring the materials into the high buildings at the edge of Haramori City, and then use the advanced catapult device to launch the materials out of the town.”

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - An Important Question
paragraphs: “Just like this.”
As Zhou Yi spoke, he made a slingshot gesture with his hand.
“I’ve already prepared the skill blueprint. I’ve spent a lot of effort. The maximum range is at least 1.5 kilometres. With the height advantage, it’ll work.”
Zhou Yi made a detailed plan and then gestured at Lu Yu with his mouth.

“I’ve already learned the blueprint to modify the catapult device. As long as I gather the materials, I can immediately create them. It’ll take about half a day to build the building. If there’s a potion to speed up the recovery speed, the efficiency will continue to increase.”
“Of course, we still need someone outside to help us collect the materials we threw out.”
“We’ll have to rely on God’s help in this aspect.”
Fang Heng lowered his head and carefully considered the feasibility of this plan.
“God, what do you think?”
“It’s probably okay.”
Fang Heng pondered for a moment in his heart, then raised his head and said, “But there are a few details that I still have some doubts about.”
Zhou Yi said solemnly, “God, what do you think?”

“The firearms processing precision instrument should be a large-scale instrument, right? In terms of dismantling, our skill level is not enough. Forcefully dismantling it will cause damage to the instrument parts.”
“Secondly, if we throw it over a long distance, the fall will cause even more damage to the parts.”
Zhou Yi was stunned. He had not considered this question.
“This... In the future, we should be able to find someone to repair it, right?”
“Indeed, but I want to say, since we can use the catapult device to throw materials out of Haramori City, why not directly build a spatial rift?”

Fang Heng felt strange and asked, “Why don’t we just do it in one step and pack up all the materials and instruments, including the firearms forging blueprints and the firearms processing precision instrument, and bring them back to the shelter from Haramori City?”
Spatial rift???
Pack them up and take them away?!
This idea was too far-fetched. The people in the truck instantly became silent and looked at Fang Heng quietly.
No one had ever considered this question.
Was there even a need to ask?
Because it was simply impossible!
The spatial rift was a large-scale device. It required a large amount of the player’s vitality and materials to complete the construction.
Other than that, there was also a time limit.
It would require three days just to locate the time passage for the spatial rift.

Moreover, in Haramori City, other than searching for survival materials, dealing with the zombie wave and completing the game mission, the player also had to be careful of attacks from players from the other three factions.
It was extremely difficult to survive. There was simply no extra time, energy and materials to build the spatial rift device.
Most importantly, a server only had a handful of space tearing device blueprints.
Even if the player had unlimited vitality, it would take two to three days for a person to build the spatial rift device.
“Looks like it’s possible.”
All the problems were not a problem for Fang Heng.
He did not lack food.
On one hand, the zombie team could gather some of the materials. On the other hand, Fang Heng had originally planned to empty Wendy’s apocalypse shop.
He also had plenty of construction workers!
The zombie team had inherited his construction skills.
With so many zombies, it was easy to build a spatial rift device.
As for materials, some of the rarer materials could be purchased from Wendy’s shop. The other common materials could be found in Haramori City by the zombie team.
As for the players from the opposing faction, he was not afraid of them at all.
After tonight, when the Lickers finished self-proliferation, no matter how many players from the opposing factions come, they would be goners.
The only problem was time.
It would take three days to locate the spatial rift device’s location.
If he wanted to open the spatial rift, he had to control the time. He could not let this special event end too soon.
If everything went smoothly...
He would plunder the entire Haramori City!
Fang Heng was tempted.
If he could have the firearms forging blueprints and the firearms processing precision instrument, it meant that his shelter would be able to produce a steady stream of guns and bullets!
This business was profitable!
“Squeak!!”
An hour and a half later, the military truck filled with goods once again stopped in front of a villa in the centre of the city.
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu were the first to jump out of the truck.
A bumper harvest!
During the time they were hacking, the zombies had thoroughly searched the entire hospital in the city centre.
Other than collecting a lot of medical supplies, there was also half a truck full of mission item-first aid materials.
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu felt that this wave was too exhilarating.
According to the points, a truck full of materials could earn at least 4000 points. By then, they would be able to acquire a large number of materials and resources.
Perhaps...
Fang Heng’s grand plan of building a spatial rift device was possible!
The two of them were very enthusiastic. Just as they were about to move the first aid materials from the truck, Fang Heng reached out to stop them.
“Don’t rush, wait first, don’t rush to hand in the mission.”
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu stopped and looked at Fang Heng in confusion.
“Wait? Why is that?”
Fang Heng sighed silently.
“Game mission restrictions. Wendy will not continue to issue normal missions after 5000 points. I guess this camp is quite big. Just 10,000 points are far from enough to buy out the shop...”
The Tier 1 point mission provided by Wendy would become invalid once the accumulated points reached 5000 points. Normal missions would no longer be issued to the public.
Therefore, Fang Heng planned to receive a few missions that could greatly stack the completion rate, and then submit them all at once. The last wave would earn a large number of points.
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu looked at each other, speechless.
D*mn it. Including half a truck of mission items, Fang Heng could exchange for more than 8000 points.
Fang Heng was still not satisfied!
Did he want to empty the whole place?
But...
It felt so good!
[Hint: You have submitted the mission-to collect first aid materials. Current mission completion rate: 500.4%. You have received 1000.8 camp points.]
[Hint: You have submitted the mission-to clear the zombie horde in the hospital area. Current mission completion rate: 1336.4%. You have received 1336.4 camp points.]
[Hint: Your friendship with Wendy has slightly increased.]
“Fang Heng, your mission completion rate has exceeded my expectations. I think you are the best candidate to complete the mission.”
Wendy praised him from the bottom of her heart.
“Unfortunately, you still need to complete another 200 points mission to pass my assessment.”
Fang Heng smiled kindly, “Of course, I will continue to work hard.”
“I believe in your ability. In addition, do you need to exchange for some materials and tools now? I will do my best to help you. We have many new weapons here, you should be able to...”

Fang Heng shook his head and raised two fingers. “No, I don’t need anything else. I only need to exchange for two military trucks. The rest of the points will be exchanged for canned coffee. Thank you.”
It was happening again.
Trucks again!
Wendy really could not understand why Fang Heng needed so many military trucks.
“Also, Wendy, I have a very important question.”
Wendy said seriously, “Please speak.”
“Can the trucks in the camp be exchanged indefinitely?”
“What?”

It required a large amount of the player’s vitality and materials to complete the construction.
Other than that, there was also a time limit.
It would require three days just to locate the time passage for the spatial rift.

Moreover, in Haramori City, other than searching for survival materials, dealing with the zombie wave and completing the game mission, the player also had to be careful of attacks from players from the other three factions.
It was extremely difficult to survive.
There was simply no extra time, energy and materials to build the spatial rift device.
Most importantly, a server only had a handful of space tearing device blueprints.
Even if the player had unlimited vitality, it would take two to three days for a person to build the spatial rift device.
“Looks like it’s possible.”
All the problems were not a problem for Fang Heng.
He did not lack food.
On one hand, the zombie team could gather some of the materials.
On the other hand, Fang Heng had originally planned to empty Wendy’s apocalypse shop.
He also had plenty of construction workers!
The zombie team had inherited his construction skills.
With so many zombies, it was easy to build a spatial rift device.
As for materials, some of the rarer materials could be purchased from Wendy’s shop.
The other common materials could be found in Haramori City by the zombie team.
As for the players from the opposing faction, he was not afraid of them at all.
After tonight, when the Lickers finished self-proliferation, no matter how many players from the opposing factions come, they would be goners.
The only problem was time.
It would take three days to locate the spatial rift device’s location.
If he wanted to open the spatial rift, he had to control the time.
He could not let this special event end too soon.
If everything went smoothly...
He would plunder the entire Haramori City!
Fang Heng was tempted.
If he could have the firearms forging blueprints and the firearms processing precision instrument, it meant that his shelter would be able to produce a steady stream of guns and bullets!
This business was profitable!
“Squeak!!”
An hour and a half later, the military truck filled with goods once again stopped in front of a villa in the centre of the city.
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu were the first to jump out of the truck.
A bumper harvest!
During the time they were hacking, the zombies had thoroughly searched the entire hospital in the city centre.
Other than collecting a lot of medical supplies, there was also half a truck full of mission item-first aid materials.
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu felt that this wave was too exhilarating.
According to the points, a truck full of materials could earn at least 4000 points.
By then, they would be able to acquire a large number of materials and resources.
Perhaps...
Fang Heng’s grand plan of building a spatial rift device was possible!
The two of them were very enthusiastic.
Just as they were about to move the first aid materials from the truck, Fang Heng reached out to stop them.
“Don’t rush, wait first, don’t rush to hand in the mission.”
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu stopped and looked at Fang Heng in confusion.
“Wait?
Why is that?”
Fang Heng sighed silently.
“Game mission restrictions.
Wendy will not continue to issue normal missions after 5000 points.
I guess this camp is quite big.
Just 10,000 points are far from enough to buy out the shop...”
The Tier 1 point mission provided by Wendy would become invalid once the accumulated points reached 5000 points.
Normal missions would no longer be issued to the public.
Therefore, Fang Heng planned to receive a few missions that could greatly stack the completion rate, and then submit them all at once.
The last wave would earn a large number of points.
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu looked at each other, speechless.
D*mn it.
Including half a truck of mission items, Fang Heng could exchange for more than 8000 points.
Fang Heng was still not satisfied!
Did he want to empty the whole place?
But...
It felt so good!

Wendy praised him from the bottom of her heart.
“Unfortunately, you still need to complete another 200 points mission to pass my assessment.”
Fang Heng smiled kindly, “Of course, I will continue to work hard.”
“I believe in your ability.
In addition, do you need to exchange for some materials and tools now?
I will do my best to help you.
We have many new weapons here, you should be able to...”
Fang Heng shook his head and raised two fingers.
“No, I don’t need anything else.
I only need to exchange for two military trucks.
The rest of the points will be exchanged for canned coffee.
Thank you.”
It was happening again.
Trucks again!
Wendy really could not understand why Fang Heng needed so many military trucks.
“Also, Wendy, I have a very important question.”
Wendy said seriously, “Please speak.”
“Can the trucks in the camp be exchanged indefinitely?”
“What?”

chapters.title: Chapter 322 - Submission of Mission
paragraphs: “Can the trucks in the camp be exchanged indefinitely?”
“What?”
“Uh, I mean, how many trucks can I exchange for at most? Also, I saw that you have a mission to purchase wood here, and I want to know the demand for wood in your camp.”
Wendy was completely confused by Fang Heng’s question.
She thought that Fang Heng would ask about the situation in Haramori City, but she didn’t expect such a strange question.
Seeing that Wendy didn’t answer for a moment, Fang Heng changed the question. “I mean, how much wood can your camp collect at most?”
Wendy pressed her temples and replied gently, “There are still 20 military trucks left in our camp. Also, there are no restrictions on purchasing. We need a lot of resources, the more the better.”
There were 20 large trucks?!
Fang Heng was ecstatic.
Great!

As expected of the apocalypse camp in a big city. Unlike the dilapidated camp at the prison entrance, there was no exchange for a single truck, and there was also a limit on the number of materials that could be purchased.
The warehouse was always full...
The smile on Fang Heng’s face became even more brilliant.
If you say so, then I can be at ease and boldly empty your shop!
“Thank you, Wendy, I still need to collect some more missions, sorry to trouble you.”
[Hint: You have received a mission-collect first aid materials.]
[Hint: You have received a mission-collect construction materials: wooden planks.]
[Hint: You have exchanged points for military trucks*2, Nestle canned coffee (24 bottles)*4.]
After accepting the missions and exchanging for two trucks and four small boxes of coffee, the camp’s security captain, Ron, brought Fang Heng out of the villa.

“Fang Heng, I heard that you’ve accepted the mission of collecting wooden planks. I suggest that you go to the furniture factory in the west of the city. I remember that there are quite a few high-quality ready-made wooden planks there, but it’s a bit far there, so it’s more troublesome to go back and forth. In addition, there’s also a wood processing factory in the north of the city.”
“Thank you for your suggestion, Ron, but collecting wooden planks doesn’t need to be so troublesome.”
Ron felt a little strange, wondering if Fang Heng had a better choice?
“Alright, I wish you good luck. Also, I’ve already asked someone to park the military truck you need outside the villa. Here are the car keys.”
“Thank you. Also, wait a little longer. This batch of goods is prepared to be submitted to Ms Wendy later. I will put it here for the time being.”
Fang Heng took the keys and raised his hand, waving at Mo Jiawei and the other two who were sitting beside him in the trailer behind the truck.
“It’s done. Come and unload the goods! Hurry up!”
“Coming!”
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu were very excited. They immediately jumped onto the truck and threw bags of first-aid materials down the truck.
They would empty the apocalypse camp!
And it was a large-scale apocalypse camp in a special event!
It was exciting just thinking about it.
“This is... ?”
Looking at the bags of first aid materials, the camp’s security captain, Ron, opened his mouth and was puzzled.
“Fang Heng, do you still have the first aid materials that haven’t been submitted yet?”
“Shh, there’s no rush. I have to give Wendy a surprise. I’ll leave these goods with you for now. I’ll submit them to Wendy tomorrow morning.”
Fang Heng made a gesture to Ron to keep mum about this matter and patted him on the shoulder.
“There will be a lot of materials delivered tonight. Be prepared to receive them.”
Under Ron’s puzzled gaze, Zhou Yi and the other two moved half of the first-aid materials from the trailer onto the ground.
“Let’s go! Let’s go!”
After moving the materials, the four of them got into three trucks.
“Fang Heng, where are we going next?”
Fang Heng was already prepared. He quickly glanced at the map of the city with excitement on his face.
“East Park. There’s a lot of wood there. Let’s work hard tonight and think of a way to flatten all the trees in the park! Bring back all the wooden planks!”
“Okay!”
Zhou Yi and Lu Yu responded loudly, full of fighting spirit.
Looking at the three military trucks slowly leaving the villa, Ron suddenly had a strange thought.
These people exchanged for three trucks, could it be that they were using the trucks to transport materials?
How could it be...
Ron smiled self-deprecatingly and shook his head.
Early in the morning, the sun shone through the window and entered the room.
Wendy had just finished her breakfast.
The situation in Haramori City was not very good. The evacuation would be in the next few days.
“Wendy, Fang Heng is waiting for you outside the villa.”
Has he finally completed the mission?
Wendy thought to herself.
With Fang Heng’s ability, it was very easy for him to complete the last 200 points mission.
Wendy originally thought that he would be able to complete it successfully yesterday.
She did not expect him to still spend an entire night.
That was true. After all, it was too dangerous to act at night.
This group of survivors had just arrived in Haramori City. They still needed to find a safe shelter to deal with all kinds of crises.
It was indeed a little difficult for them.
Ron stood at the door, feeling conflicted. He looked at Wendy, as if he wanted to say something but hesitated.
Wendy noticed Ron’s expression.
“Ron? Did something happen?”
“Ms Wendy, those survivors...”
Ron felt that Wendy would not believe him even if he told her. He pointed at the window. “You should look out of the window yourself.”
Wendy was puzzled. She walked to the window and looked out.
“This...”
Wendy rubbed her eyes in disbelief.
The entire back garden was filled with wooden planks.
It was as high as a storey.
“Wooden planks? So many? Where did they come from?”

“Mr Fang Heng found a way to get them. Since last night, he has been sending wooden planks to the shelter. The warehouse, the front yard and the back yard are all full. The extra ones can only be temporarily stored in the living room on the first floor of the villa.”
“But Ron, where did he get so many wooden planks?”
Ron shook his head.
What a coincidence. He couldn’t figure this out either.
Even if the furniture factory and the wood processing factory were emptied, there wouldn’t be so many logs!
Wendy quickly regained her usual composure. “Forget it, Ron. Bring me to meet him.”
To facilitate the transportation of goods, Fang Heng and the others simply waited for Wendy at the entrance of the villa.
This was a place for unloading goods. It was rare for an area to be cleared out.
The guards in the camp were still helping to move the materials back and forth, walking with difficulty among the piles of wood.
Mo Jiawei and the other two lay in the backseat of the trailer to rest.
They stayed up all night, driving trucks to and fro between the city’s Central Park and the villa to transport the materials, acting as coolies.
Although it was very tiring, the result was very satisfying.
The thought of emptying the entire store made Zhou Yi and Lu Yu feel like they were on steroids.
Fang Heng threw a few cans of coffee to his friends and gulped down tons of coffee into his stomach.
Seeing Ron and Wendy walking over, Fang Heng waved to greet them.
“Good morning, Wendy. These woods are a surprise that I prepared for you.”
A surprise?
Wendy was indeed surprised for a while, but she didn’t feel much joy.
“Fang Heng, you surprised me too much.”

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - Crystals
paragraphs: Hehe!
250,000 points were obtained!
Fang Heng felt that the whole night had not been in vain!
The exchange price for a truck was 1200.
Originally, exchanging for 10 trucks was more than enough.
But considering that he still had to build a teleportation passage later, the trucks here could all be brought back to the shelter.
Fang Heng decided to empty all the trucks in the camp!
After all, his shelter was very short of trucks.
“Fang Heng, your ability has exceeded my expectations. I have a special mission for you.”
Fang Heng said seriously, “Please speak.”
“Haramori City is different from the outside world. This is a very strange place. When we were collecting materials in the city, we found a very strange crystal.”
“These strange crystals have different colors and have very weak strength. If we can collect all the crystals and fuse them into one, perhaps we can find more valuable information
“Fang Heng, I hope you can search the entire city and find all the crystals
[Hint: You have received Wendy’s approval. You have triggered Wendy’s final mission: Fusion crystals.]
Mission name: Fusion crystals.
Mission difficulty: SSS.

Mission description: You have learned from Wendy that some strange crystals have recently been discovered in Haramori City. Wendy needs to collect different types of crystals in an attempt to obtain the secret of crystals.
Mission requirements: Please collect 21 different types of crystals and fuse them (each type of crystal*500).
Mission reward: Skill book.
Skill book!
Seeing the mission reward, Fang Heng was shocked.
However, looking at the mission requirements, it seemed to be very troublesome.
There were 21 types of crystals in total, and each type required a total of 500 crystals!
He estimated that he would need to search the entire Haramori City before he could do it.
Wasn’t it a little too time-consuming?
After all, the zombie team still had to focus on building the space-time rift, so they didn’t have much spare time in terms of productivity.
While Fang Heng was pondering in his heart, a row of game hints appeared in his vision once again.
[Hint: Under special influences, Tier 4 mission has been triggered. Player to carry out Tier 3 and Tier 4 missions simultaneously.]
[Tier 4 mission-resource point competition.]
Mission name: Resource point competition.
Mission difficulty: S.

Mission description 1: 21 special resource points (including health stations, restaurants, gun shops, factories, etc.) will be refreshed in 2 hours in Haramori City. The player can search for materials in the system’s special resource points, the faction leader can choose to obtain the ownership of the resource points after clearing the resource points (player can also seize the resource points that have been occupied by other factions).

Mission description 2: After successfully occupying the resource points, player can obtain the special crystals produced by the resource points every 1 hour (the crystals produced by each resource point are different. Player can directly exchange materials through the crystals).
Mission description 3: After the end of the special event, the crystals that had not been consumed would be converted into special event points at a fixed rate.

Clear Option 1: Obtain 10 special crystals from any of the eight different types. Player could choose to go to City Street No. 3822 in the city to look for Wendy to deliver the crystals. After the delivery is completed, the special event is deemed to be completed and the player will enter the settlement state. (After completing the event through this method, you will be rewarded with 30 King of Gods’ points.]
Clear Option 2: After three days in the game, you can choose to directly exit the special event and enter the settlement state.
[Special hint: As time passes, the strength of the zombies in Haramori city will gradually increase.]
Fang Heng carefully read through the mission description and immediately came to a realization.
It turned out that Wendy’s crystal gathering mission and the main storyline mission for the special event were related to each other!
21 different types of crystals coincidentally corresponded to 21 different resource points!
In other words, the mission for Tier 4 was to obtain resources.
The system was divided into a total of 21 resource points. In order to complete the mission and obtain the reward, the player would certainly launch an intense battle around these 21 resource points.
In a short moment, Fang Heng already had a rough plan in his mind.
He raised his head and smiled, “Wendy, I will try my best to complete the mission. But before that, I need to exchange for some things.”
“Of course, Fang Heng. If It’s a weapon, I can provide it to you...”
Fang Heng waved his hand and interrupted, “No, what I need is a truck.”
“Another truck?”
Wendy was stunned.
“Yes, I want all the remaining trucks.”
Wendy didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. She even suspected that Fang Heng had some special preference for trucks.
“Fang Heng, do you really need so many trucks?”
“Of course.”
Fang Heng opened the exchange column of the apocalypse camp as he spoke.
“Also, this item is not bad. I will use up all the remaining points to exchange for it. Thank you.”
Wendy was even more confused when she saw the item Fang Heng was referring to.
“Are you sure? This item doesn’t seem to be of any help to the next mission.”
Warehouse shelter.
The Eastern faction’s players had a peaceful night.
After going online, the players began to strengthen the warehouse’s defense.
Yu Jie was slightly stunned when he saw Fang Heng and the other two driving four large trucks into the warehouse’s entrance.
D*mn it, they hadn’t seen each other for a night. Why did they bring back three more trucks?
Many players also noticed the large trucks that Fang Heng brought back.
More observant players noticed that two of the trucks were carrying heavy items behind them.
Because they were covered by tarps, the players did not know what was inside.
Fang Heng jumped down from the first truck.
Yu Jie walked up.
“Fang Heng, is everything going well? How’s the completion of Wendy’s mission?”
“Tier 1 was successfully completed, but Tier 2 is a little troublesome.”
“Yes, Wendy’s mission is very difficult. If there’s anything I can help you with, just let me know...”
As he spoke, Yu Jie realized that something was wrong. He looked at Fang Heng.
“Wait, what did you say? You’ve completed Wendy’s Tier 1 mission?”
“Yes, it’s indeed a little troublesome. It took me an entire night to complete it.”
Yu Jie stared at Fang Heng in a daze for a long while.
Only took an entire night?
In the old server, similar missions like Tier 1 usually required the strength of the entire faction to complete in an entire day.
This was under the premise that the other factions would not cause any trouble.
How did he manage to complete the mission in one night?
Fang Heng stretched his body, raised his head and gulped down another bottle of coffee. He passed another bottle to Yu Jie. “Do you want one?”
Yu Jie came back to his senses. “No, there’s no need.”
“How’s the situation at the shelter?”
“It was very peaceful last night, but...”
Yu Jie thought of something unpleasant.
His expression darkened. He gestured for Fang Heng to walk to a corner and whispered in Fang Heng’s ear.
“I’ve asked around. This time, the Eastern region’s various large guilds agreed to not participate in the special event because they planned ahead. Moreover, their target is you.”
