Mission description 3: After the end of the special event, the crystals that had not been consumed would be converted into special event points at a fixed rate.
Clear Option 1: Obtain 10 special crystals from any of the eight different types.
Player could choose to go to City Street No.
3822 in the city to look for Wendy to deliver the crystals.

After the delivery is completed, the special event is deemed to be completed and the player will enter the settlement state. (After completing the event through this method, you will be rewarded with 30 King of Gods’ points.]
Clear Option 2: After three days in the game, you can choose to directly exit the special event and enter the settlement state.
[Special hint: As time passes, the strength of the zombies in Haramori city will gradually increase.]
Fang Heng carefully read through the mission description and immediately came to a realization.
It turned out that Wendy’s crystal gathering mission and the main storyline mission for the special event were related to each other!
21 different types of crystals coincidentally corresponded to 21 different resource points!
In other words, the mission for Tier 4 was to obtain resources.
The system was divided into a total of 21 resource points.
In order to complete the mission and obtain the reward, the player would certainly launch an intense battle around these 21 resource points.
In a short moment, Fang Heng already had a rough plan in his mind.
He raised his head and smiled, “Wendy, I will try my best to complete the mission.
But before that, I need to exchange for some things.”
“Of course, Fang Heng.
If It’s a weapon, I can provide it to you...”
Fang Heng waved his hand and interrupted, “No, what I need is a truck.”
“Another truck?”
Wendy was stunned.
“Yes, I want all the remaining trucks.”
Wendy didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
She even suspected that Fang Heng had some special preference for trucks.
“Fang Heng, do you really need so many trucks?”
“Of course.”
Fang Heng opened the exchange column of the apocalypse camp as he spoke.
“Also, this item is not bad.
I will use up all the remaining points to exchange for it.
Thank you.”
Wendy was even more confused when she saw the item Fang Heng was referring to.
“Are you sure?
This item doesn’t seem to be of any help to the next mission.”
Warehouse shelter.
The Eastern faction’s players had a peaceful night.
After going online, the players began to strengthen the warehouse’s defense.
Yu Jie was slightly stunned when he saw Fang Heng and the other two driving four large trucks into the warehouse’s entrance.
D*mn it, they hadn’t seen each other for a night.
Why did they bring back three more trucks?
Many players also noticed the large trucks that Fang Heng brought back.
More observant players noticed that two of the trucks were carrying heavy items behind them.
Because they were covered by tarps, the players did not know what was inside.
Fang Heng jumped down from the first truck.
Yu Jie walked up.
“Fang Heng, is everything going well?
How’s the completion of Wendy’s mission?”
“Tier 1 was successfully completed, but Tier 2 is a little troublesome.”
“Yes, Wendy’s mission is very difficult.
If there’s anything I can help you with, just let me know...”
As he spoke, Yu Jie realized that something was wrong.
He looked at Fang Heng.
“Wait, what did you say?
You’ve completed Wendy’s Tier 1 mission?”
“Yes, it’s indeed a little troublesome.
It took me an entire night to complete it.”
Yu Jie stared at Fang Heng in a daze for a long while.
Only took an entire night?
In the old server, similar missions like Tier 1 usually required the strength of the entire faction to complete in an entire day.
This was under the premise that the other factions would not cause any trouble.
How did he manage to complete the mission in one night?
Fang Heng stretched his body, raised his head and gulped down another bottle of coffee.
He passed another bottle to Yu Jie.
“Do you want one?”
Yu Jie came back to his senses.
“No, there’s no need.”
“How’s the situation at the shelter?”
“It was very peaceful last night, but...”
Yu Jie thought of something unpleasant.
His expression darkened.
He gestured for Fang Heng to walk to a corner and whispered in Fang Heng’s ear.
“I’ve asked around.
This time, the Eastern region’s various large guilds agreed to not participate in the special event because they planned ahead.
Moreover, their target is you.”

chapters.title: Chapter 324 - Target
paragraphs: “What? Their target is me?”
Fang Heng frowned. He was very surprised by this.
“The prison’s influence is developing too quickly. These large guilds feel a great threat from you, especially the Lickers that you and the Dark Knights control.”

“They think that if they continue to let you develop, the entire District 8’s apocalypse game world will be under your complete control. Therefore, the various large guilds in the Eastern region have secretly reached an agreement. They want to use this special event as an opportunity to attack you.”

“Other than the Eastern region, all the players in the entire Server 8’s apocalyptic world are very wary of you. They have all come to an agreement in private that they will first target the Eastern region during the special event.”
“Once they confirm that you have died in the special event, the Eastern region’s large guilds will immediately launch an attack on the prison, hindering your development in the game.”
Fang Heng curled his lips in disdain.
It turned out that these big guilds were targeting him.
They were not stupid.
It was just a pity...
Their timing wasn’t right.
It was too late.
The prison’s development had long exceeded their imagination.
No matter how many came, they were going to be goners.
Fang Heng felt that the Eastern region’s big guilds did a good thing by not participating in this special event.
Otherwise, the worst thing that could happen was that a large group of disgusting teammates had snuck into the camp.
“I found out that the sponsors of this joint attack on the prison are the two large companies, Crimson Technology and Phoenix Sound Gaming Company.”
Yu Jie was also quite displeased.
These large guilds had secretly agreed to go against the prison, and even the Eastern Federation had fallen into their trap.

If Fang Heng had not thought of a way to obtain many Molotov cocktails in the Tier 2 zombie wave mission to turn the tide, he and his subordinates would most likely have lost their lives in this special event.
“In addition, I have also secretly investigated Qin Ming. His company has recently owed a large sum of money. If our guess is correct, he was most probably bribed by Crimson Technology.”
“He joined the game to monitor our every move and provide information to the players from the other three camps.”
“During the Tier 2 zombie wave, he deliberately lured a wave of zombies over to destroy our defensive line.”
As Yu Jie spoke, his gaze swept in the direction of the warehouse.
“Given my identity, it’s not convenient for me to take action. It’s best for you to take care of him.”
“Of course.”
Even a mole had to die!
“However, killing him like this is a little too easy for him.”
Fang Heng’s eyes narrowed slightly.
“That’s the gist of the situation. The other three factions must have already found out about the internal situation of our faction through Qin Ming.”
Yu Jie felt that the Eastern faction was becoming more and more dangerous this time.
“Fang Heng, there aren’t many Molotov cocktails left. The overall strength of our Eastern faction is relatively weak. It’s estimated that the players from the other three factions will attack soon.”
“When that time comes, our Federation will not participate in the battle between players. I hope you can understand.”
Fang Heng nodded lightly. “Mm.”
As Yu Jie spoke, he turned his head to look at Fang Heng’s truck. “Right, what good stuff did you bring back? Can you help us tide over this crisis?”
“Of course. Those are all pretty good stuff.”
“Really?”
Fang Heng smiled casually and patted Yu Jie’s shoulder like an old friend. “Yu Jie, do you know, I have a great plan...”
As he listened to Fang Heng’s initial plan, Yu Jie’s expression gradually became strange.
He turned around again and looked at the big trucks.
“Fang Heng, Eh... you mean the ones inside are... You’re not joking with me, right?”
“Of course, I’m serious.”
After a brief discussion with Fang Heng, Yu Jie gathered all the player representatives to discuss the next step of the Eastern faction’s battle plan.
“Everyone, the system has given a hint that the Tier 4 mission had been triggered in advance, and the method to complete the special event earlier has also been unlocked.”
As Yu Jie spoke, he spread out the map of the original city on the wooden table.
“Among the 21 resource points given by the system, there is a large-scale firearms manufacturing factory and two firearms and weapon stores.”
“These two places will be the first few targets that the players want to occupy.”
“With the strength of our player team, forcefully attacking the firearms factory will not give us an advantage.”
“In addition, the Tier 4 mission will most likely trigger conflicts with other factions. The Federation of the various regions will not participate in similar conflicts.”
Fang Heng lowered his head to observe the map and pondered for a moment.
After yesterday’s battle, Fang Heng’s prestige among the players had reached its peak.
The players looked at Fang Heng at the same time, waiting for him to plan his strategy.
Yu Jie also looked at Fang Heng.
“Fang Heng, what do you think our faction should do next?”
“Hmm, I think this place is not bad. We can start from here and occupy this resource point first.”
Fang Heng lowered his head as he spoke and pointed at a corner of the city map near the west side of Haramori City.
The players all looked in the direction that Fang Heng was pointing at the same time.
This place was...
What the hell!
Building materials market???
Everyone was confused by Fang Heng.
From the perspective of an ordinary player, the most important thing at this stage was undoubtedly weapons!
With weapons, one’s combat power could be greatly increased!
One would have a huge advantage after ensuring combat power, whether it was gathering materials, dealing with zombies or dealing with players.
Next would be necessities such as food and medical supplies.
Next would be special materials, such as gasoline, fortifications and so on.
As for the building materials market?
That place was mostly filled with tools and various building materials, so it was completely useless.
Seeing the puzzled looks of the player, Fang Heng remained calm.
“We can occupy the building materials market first and use the building materials market as the base point to gradually occupy the surrounding resources points. What do you think?”
This answer was too unexpected and everyone fell silent.
The guild leader of a small guild raised his hand and asked weakly.
“Boss Fang, is there a reason? Why didn’t we choose to occupy the firearms factory first?”
“If you want a reason...”
Fang Heng thought for a while.

“Alright, I’ll be honest with you. I don’t think the strength of the other camps is worth mentioning. It’s a waste of time to go to the firearms factory first. After all, firearms don’t improve the overall strength of our team at this stage.”

“Finding an opportunity to occupy the resource points in the building materials market and expanding the production capacity is the most time-saving way to develop. There are high-level building materials and tools in the building materials market, which will greatly improve our building ability.”
While speaking, Fang Heng gestured to a few big trucks that were parked not far away.
Mo Jiawei was already prepared. He opened the tarp at the back of the big truck.
The back of the big truck was filled with more than 20 large-scale furnaces.
When the players first saw the tarp at the back of the big truck, they thought that it was filled with some survival materials or gasoline, like last time.
Who would have thought that it was filled with furnaces?!
“This...”

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - Production Line
paragraphs: “With tools and a furnace, we can complete autonomous ironmaking and vigorously develop our productivity.”

“In addition, I’ve learned that there’s a complete production line for firearms in the firearms factory in the center of the city. With enough metal materials, if everything goes smoothly, we should be able to occupy the firearms factory and start mass-producing low-level guns in two days...”
“Everyone, do you have any questions?”
The players looked at each other.
They were completely dumbfounded by Fang Heng’s series of fancy operations.
This was a huge thing!
Although most of the players didn’t quite understand, they still understood a few key words.
D*mn it, other people came to the special event to survive, but he came solo to build infrastructure?
“Cough, cough.”
Yu Jie couldn’t take it anymore. He cleared his throat and explained to the players.

“Actually, what Fang Heng is trying to say is that the current strength of our Eastern region is relatively weak. The success rate of competing with the other regions for firearms is very low. Rather than fighting head-on, it’s better to find another way to quickly occupy a few marginal resource points.”
“We’ll withdraw from the competition for the firearms resource point and let the players from the other three factions compete for them, depleting their strength.”
“We’ll take advantage of this time to quickly occupy the marginal resource points and obtain a large number of crystals.”
“The mission requirement for clearing the level is to collect the crystals from eight different resource points. There are no requirements for the type of crystals.”

“In the future, we can also trade with players from other factions in exchange for crystals from other resource points. We can avoid direct conflict with players from other factions and achieve the ultimate goal of everyone safely clearing the game.”
So that was the case...
Hearing Yu Jie’s explanation, everyone came to a sudden realization and started discussing in low voices.
So that was what God meant.
It seemed that this was indeed the safest solution at the moment.
This was much more reliable than Fang Heng’s infrastructure plan.
In the crowd, Qin Ming’s expression was a little ugly. He stole a glance at Fang Heng.
He had to admit that Fang Heng’s plan was somewhat operational.
Once it succeeded, it was very likely that the Eastern faction players could successfully end this special event.
Fang Heng maintained his smile and took in everyone’s expressions.
It was really hard to let people believe in others in this world.
He was clearly telling the truth, but no one believed him.
He really wanted to build infrastructure.
Building the teleportation passage required a large amount of iron and metal. He needed to quickly occupy the building materials market!
There were advanced steel tools and special production resources there, which could greatly speed up the efficiency of the zombie team’s resource acquisition.

Yu Jie reached out his hand and pressed down, waiting for the player’s discussion to become a little quieter. He continued, “So after discussing with Fang Heng, we decided to go to the building materials market together and occupy the resource points in the building materials market as soon as possible.”
“Then, we’ll use the building materials market as the starting point to quickly clear out the surrounding resource points.”
“This operation is very important. Our time is very tight. Other than leaving a few players to guard against those wandering zombies, the rest of the player team will move out.”
Hearing Yu Jie’s words, the players were in an uproar again.
“All of them?”
“Are we all going to attack the resource points?”
“There’s no need for so many people to go over together, right? If we all run over there, what will happen to the shelter?”
“That’s right. What if our shelter is attacked by other factions at this time...”
The players all felt that the risk this time was too great.
If they were attacked by other factions, it was equivalent to all of them being eliminated!
“There is indeed a risk.”
Yu Jie waited quietly. After everyone’s discussion died down, he swept his gaze across everyone.

“However, we have no other choice. Compared to the other factions, we are at a disadvantage in terms of numbers and strength. If we stay here passively or split our forces, our combat power will be greatly reduced.”

“We have tried other methods as well. To put it bluntly, the other methods are all slow deaths. Only by quickly occupying at least six regions and quickly collecting crystals will we have a chance to successfully leave this special event.”
The players all fell silent.
The logic seemed to be the same, but..
This was too much!
“Everyone.”
Fang Heng did not want to waste any more time.
He took a small step forward.
Ever since he joined the game, the prestige that Fang Heng had accumulated made all the players quiet down at the same time. They all turned their heads to look at Fang Heng.
“Molotov cocktails are almost exhausted. The fewer players heading to clean up the resource points, the more time will be wasted.”
“Even if half of our players stay here, we won’t be able to resist the attacks of the other three factions.”
“Instead of waiting for death, why don’t we take a gamble and see how lucky we are? What do you think?”
After a moment of silence, one of the players yelled, “D*mn it! Fang is right! We’ll take the gamble!”
“F*ck it! Instead of waiting for death, let’s take the gamble!”
“We’ll take the gamble!”
“Go, go, go...”

“Our chances of winning are still very high.” Fang Heng smiled calmly, “I think the first target of the other three camps will be the firearms resource points. It’s unlikely that they will attack our shelter.”

“We don’t have time. The truck is our biggest advantage now. It can save us a lot of time on our journey. Before the players from the other camps can react, we’ll occupy the small-scale resource points first. Let’s go.”
In the crowd, Qin Ming clenched his fists tightly as he looked at the red-eyed players who were prepared to fight to the death.
he was so agitated that his body could not help but tremble.
Gamble?
Hehe.
They would definitely lose this gamble!
Leaving behind an empty shelter was Fang Heng’s biggest flaw!
He only needed to leak this information.
Fang Heng would die!
When Crimson Technology’s office got wind of the movements of the Eastern faction players, He Liang was shocked again.
“Fang Heng brought all the Eastern faction players to the resource point? There’s practically no protection in the shelter?”
Was he crazy?
Was he prepared to fight to the death?
Or was he deliberately setting up a trap?
He Liang was bewildered.
“Qin Ming even reported the specific strategic arrangements to Crimson Technology. What he said was a bit disorganised. I sorted it out.”
Secretary Shen Xiaoxiao handed the file over.
He Liang flipped through the file on the desk, his brows furrowed.
So that was it.
Tier 4 mission...
He Liang finished reading the entire plan and was admiring it in his heart.
Bold.
Looking at the strategic arrangements, Fang Heng’s decision was indeed reasonable.
He Liang took a deep breath and closed the file.
“Act immediately. Contact the guilds in the other three regions.”

“Tell them that, with Crimson Technology’s reputation as a guarantee, there are only a few defenses in the Eastern shelter. Whoever gets there first will be able to seize all of the Eastern shelter’s resources and points.”

“Our chances of winning are still very high.” Fang Heng smiled calmly, “I think the first target of the other three camps will be the firearms resource points.
It’s unlikely that they will attack our shelter.”
“We don’t have time.
The truck is our biggest advantage now.
It can save us a lot of time on our journey.
Before the players from the other camps can react, we’ll occupy the small-scale resource points first.
Let’s go.”
In the crowd, Qin Ming clenched his fists tightly as he looked at the red-eyed players who were prepared to fight to the death.
he was so agitated that his body could not help but tremble.
Gamble?
Hehe.
They would definitely lose this gamble!
Leaving behind an empty shelter was Fang Heng’s biggest flaw!
He only needed to leak this information.
Fang Heng would die!
When Crimson Technology’s office got wind of the movements of the Eastern faction players, He Liang was shocked again.
“Fang Heng brought all the Eastern faction players to the resource point?
There’s practically no protection in the shelter?”
Was he crazy?
Was he prepared to fight to the death?
Or was he deliberately setting up a trap?
He Liang was bewildered.
“Qin Ming even reported the specific strategic arrangements to Crimson Technology.
What he said was a bit disorganised.
I sorted it out.”
Secretary Shen Xiaoxiao handed the file over.
He Liang flipped through the file on the desk, his brows furrowed.
So that was it.
Tier 4 mission...
He Liang finished reading the entire plan and was admiring it in his heart.
Bold.
Looking at the strategic arrangements, Fang Heng’s decision was indeed reasonable.
He Liang took a deep breath and closed the file.
“Act immediately.
Contact the guilds in the other three regions.”
“Tell them that, with Crimson Technology’s reputation as a guarantee, there are only a few defenses in the Eastern shelter.
Whoever gets there first will be able to seize all of the Eastern shelter’s resources and points.”

chapters.title: Chapter 326 - Feint Attack
paragraphs: Western region.
Pan Jinwen was flipping through the map in his hand. His gaze was focused on a resource point in a hotel.
His expression was solemn.
The overall strength of the Western region players was not low, but they were especially fond of internal strife.
To fight for the position of faction leader, their people fell out first and started fighting.
This resulted in their Western region being placed at the bottom of the Tier 2 mission based on their strength.
The only good news was that the two Big Brothers had fought to the bitter end and were eliminated one after another. In the end, Pan Jinwen, who was ranked third, succeeded in becoming the leader.
Yesterday, Pan Jinwen and the remaining defeated soldiers had spent a lot of effort finding and clearing out a shelter.
By the time they bound the shelter, it was already dark.
They had no time to go out and collect food and materials.
In one night, the team had lost a third of their members.
The morale of the entire Western region players had fallen to the lowest point. If they could not find food, they could collapse at any time.

“Boss, Crimson Technology contacted us. The Eastern region has mobilized all of their members to attack the resource point. The Eastern region shelter has almost no defenses, and there are still a lot of materials inside. This is a great opportunity for us.”
Pan Jinwen was shocked.
“All of them? is the information reliable?”
His subordinate hesitated and said, “Crimson Technology is vouching for themselves. They shouldn’t dare to offend so many guilds in the three regions at the same time.”
“Moreover, the Eastern faction has fewer players than us. It’s not a waste for us to fight them head-on.”
Pan Jinwen had always been cautious.
“Something’s still not right. I’ve heard that Fang Heng’s Prison Army can control a zombie team to fight. It’s not a fluke that they were able to win the first place in the Tier 2 mission yesterday.”

His subordinate continued to explain, “But according to the information we got from Crimson Technology, Fang Heng was unable to use zombies in the game. Yesterday, he accidentally obtained a large number of Molotov cocktails as a weapon. That’s why he was lucky enough to win the first place.”

“Captain, make your decision quickly. The other two camps should have also received the news. They are already on their way. There are fewer people in the Eastern faction, so they couldn’t have used up all the large amount of food and materials they obtained through the Tier 2 mission yesterday. Moreover, we are the closest to the Eastern region...”
“No, the risk is too great.”
Pan Jinwen was always cautious. He thought carefully for a moment and said, “We are not going to the Eastern region.”
“Why?”
“If we encounter the other two camps when we get to the Eastern region, can we defeat them?”

Pan Jinwen glanced at his subordinates and said, “While they’re all going to cause trouble on the Eastern side, we should seize the time to occupy the firearms store and the food store’s resource points!”
“Okay!”
The players of the Eastern faction all sat in the back seats of the big trucks.
A team of fewer than 50 people arrived at the building materials market.
The screams of zombies could be heard from the market.
“Team 1! Team 2! Team 3! Team 4! Follow me! The rest of you stay put and set up a defensive line!”
“Understood!”
Yu Jie and Fang Heng quickly exchanged glances. They led the four pre-assigned team players into the building materials market to start cleaning up the zombies.
Fang Heng, on the other hand, was taking his time. He lit a bonfire on the spot and opened the game mission log.
Qin Ming felt very uneasy.
He turned his head from time to time to look at Fang Heng, who was sitting in a corner, resting with his eyes closed.
The players from the other regions did not have trucks. If they wanted to go to Fang Heng’s shelter, they would need to travel a long distance, so they would need to spend more time.
Eh?
Qin Ming noticed that Fang Heng had brought Mo Jiawei and the others into a truck.
Where were they going? Could it be that there were changes?
Qin Ming’s heart stirred, and he quickly followed them.
“Fang Heng, are you guys planning to go somewhere?”
Fang Heng looked at Qin Ming and said with a smile, “It’s you. There’s a slight change in plan.”
“Ah?”
Could it be that he had been discovered?!
Qin Ming’s breathing instantly became hurried, and a layer of cold sweat covered his back.
“It just so happens that we still lack manpower. Are you interested in coming with us?”
Qin Ming was stunned for a moment. “Me? Can I?”
“Of course, let’s go together.”
Qin Ming gritted his teeth and made up his mind. He boarded Fang Heng’s truck.
The truck headed toward the main road.
“Fang Heng, is there a problem at the shelter?”
“No, how could it be? I believe that my plan is perfect unless the news of the shelter without any defense is leaked.”
Qin Ming shuddered and smiled awkwardly. “How could that be?”
He opened the map and saw Fang Heng heading towards the south of the city.
“Fang Heng, where are you planning to go?”
“I’m planning to attack the Southern region shelter.”
“What?”
“Don’t panic, it’s just for show. In order to ensure the smooth progress of the plan, we have to pretend to attack the Southern region shelter.”
A smile appeared on Fang Heng’s face. “It’s just a bluff. The bigger the commotion, the more alert the Southern shelter will be. They won’t dare to make a move.”
“Phew...”
Qin Ming breathed a sigh of relief.

“I get it. You are trying to say that we are feigning to attack the Southern shelter so that the enemy won’t be able to determine our movements. They will think that we are strong, which will slow them down so that they won’t dare to attack us directly. Am I right?”
“Hahaha, Yu Jie is right. You are really smart.”
Fang Heng laughed and patted Qin Ming’s shoulder enthusiastically.
Qin Ming laughed in agreement, but he was laughing coldly in his heart.
Feign? There was no need to feign anymore!
He had already told Crimson Technology all about the Eastern faction’s background and battle plan!
In the back seat, Lu Yu and Zhou Yi looked at each other silently.
Poor guy.
Twenty minutes later, Fang Heng parked his truck in a corner outside the Southern faction’s shelter.
Through the window, Fang Heng looked at the defensive layout of the shelter from afar.
The Southern faction’s shelter was located at an abandoned factory.
He could vaguely see a few players patrolling the area.
“Fang Heng, there don’t seem to be many people inside. Are you ready to make your move?”
“Yes, let’s wait a little longer.”
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes slightly and focused on controlling the group of Lickers.
Chi Chi Chi...
What was that sound?
Qin Ming heard a strange sound and his heart skipped a beat. He suddenly had a bad premonition.
“Look, they are here.”
Through the rearview mirror, Qin Ming’s face instantly turned extremely pale.
How could it be!!
Lickers?!
More than 20 Lickers caught up from the back of the truck and quickly rushed towards the Southern faction’s shelter not far away.
It was not a frontal assault. Instead, they took a detour from the side and avoided the frontal defenses at the periphery of the shelter.
“It’s the Lickers!!”
The player standing on the high ground immediately issued an alarm. Two players holding bows and arrows even aimed below and shot a few arrows.
Unfortunately, it had no effect at all!
The Licker had even inherited the effect of Fang Heng’s passive skills, ‘hegemony’. All attributes increased by 50%, HP increased by 100%!
Normal wooden arrows would not be able to pierce through the outermost layer of Licker’s skin!
More than 20 Lickers directly climbed around the wall of the building.

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - Total Annihilation
paragraphs: “Kerosene! Use kerosene!”
Normal traps were useless against the Lickers!
Barrels of kerosene poured down from the top.
Lickers that were burning all over fell from the wall.
Soon, the flames on their bodies were extinguished, and they climbed up the wall again.
The remaining Lickers directly bypassed the attack range of kerosene, climbed up the wall quickly and broke into the abandoned building through the window.
The players wanted to resist but their equipment was extremely shabby, and their attribute points were also a lot lower than the Lickers.
“Get lost!”
A player raised the steel rod in his hand and drew a sound in the air.
“Ka!”
A red light flashed.
The steel rod in the player’s hand was cut into two by the Licker’s sharp claws.
It was a one-sided massacre.
At the current stage of the game, players were simply not a match for a top-tier hunter like the Licker with just the tools in their hands.
The game hint entered Fang Heng’s vision from the lower right corner of his retina.
[Hint: Your Licker has killed a player from the Southern faction. Your safe time has been increased by 62 seconds. You have obtained an additional 209 points...]
Hmm?
So killing a player can obtain additional points?
Fang Heng’s eyes flashed with a sharp glint.
Good! Then clean up the remaining players!
The player who dared to take the initiative to enter this special event was already prepared to die.
Fang Heng would not show the slightest mercy.
Looking at the group of Lickers that were climbing along the wall into the abandoned factory, Qin Ming’s heart pounded wildly.
Very soon, the noise in the entire abandoned factory gradually stopped.
“Fang, Fang Heng, these Lickers...”
“Yes, I controlled them.”
As Fang Heng spoke, his gaze swept towards the building and he added in a low voice, “The Southern region players are a little weaker than I thought.”
If all the Southern faction players had gathered in the shelter, they might not have been so easily attacked by Fang Heng’s Lickers
But it was different now.
Most of the Southern faction players had already left the shelter and headed towards Fang Heng’s Eastern shelter.
Qin Ming suddenly realized something and his face turned deathly pale. “Fang Heng, our shelter...”
“Of course. Just to be on the safe side, I’ve left even more Lickers in the shelter.”
Fang Heng smiled. “I am trying to scam those idiots in the other factions. Don’t tell me you’re really that naive to think that I don’t have any arrangements in the shelter?”
In an instant, Qin Ming’s heart sank to the bottom. He felt that Fang Heng’s smile was too terrifying.
It’s over! It’s all over!
Qin Ming’s back was already drenched in cold sweat.
Crimson Technology and the others’ intelligence was completely inaccurate!
Who said that Fang Heng couldn’t control the zombie team during special events?!
He could!
Moreover, the strength of the Lickers had become extremely terrifying under Fang Heng’s control!
What would happen next?
Qin Ming did not dare to think too deeply about it.
At this moment, in the Eastern shelter.
The warehouse looked very quiet.
The Southern region players approached from all directions.
The information provided by Crimson Technology was very accurate. There was not a single player scouting around the entire warehouse periphery.
The player team entered the warehouse one by one.
There was still food left in the warehouse that had not been eaten.
Suddenly, a player heard a soft sound.
Looking in the direction of the sound, his expression immediately changed.
Red...
Lickers!
A group of red Lickers was crawling on the ceiling, densely packed together!
There were at least 50 of them!
The Southern region players stood in place, back to back, with a layer of cold sweat on their foreheads.
Tier 2 Lickers!
How should they fight? Should they use the scrap metal in their hands to poke at it?!
“It’s a trap.”
Not a single player dared to speak loudly as they lowered their voices.
“D*mn! We’ve been tricked by the people of the Eastern Region! They said there was no defense here but they intentionally...”
“Shoosh! Shoosh!!”
Before they could finish speaking, the Lickers on the ceiling charged toward the players gathered in the middle of the room.
For a moment, the entire warehouse was filled with the smell of blood.
“Captain, the zombies in the hotel have been cleaned up. We found food when we searched the cold storage.”
“Okay! Distribute it.”
Pan Jinwen’s spirits were slightly lifted.
The abundant food gave them a little breathing time.
“Tell our brothers to speed up. After we’re done packing, we’ll immediately head to the next firearms district.”
After jointly destroying the Eastern faction, the other two camps could split up a large number of resources and points.
After that, the remaining three camps would continue to compete with one another.
Right now, he needed to get his hands on firearms as soon as possible.
Looking at the time, it should be soon.
Just as Pan Jinwen was thinking, a game hint suddenly appeared in his vision.
[Hint: The Southern faction has been destroyed. The Eastern faction receives additional points.]
What was going on?
Pan Jinwen was stunned. He opened the game log again to confirm.
Was the Southern faction eliminated?
Didn’t they say that the two factions would join hands to deal with the Eastern faction?
Why was the Southern faction destroyed by the Eastern faction in the blink of an eye?
Something happened!
Pan Jinwen was shocked.
It was a trap!
There was a conspiracy!!
Pan Jinwen was drenched in cold sweat.
He was glad that he was cautious enough.
To be able to eliminate the Southern region in such a short period, the Eastern region must have some powerful trump card.
Just a little bit more and their entire region would be eliminated.
Then, next...
Would it be their Western region’s turn?
“Quick! We have to retreat in 20 minutes! Return to the shelter immediately!”
At the same time, the Eastern region players who were cleaning up the zombies in the building materials market received a hint from the game.
The players were also stunned when they heard the news.
“What was going on? We have eliminated the entire Southern faction?”
“Was there a mistake? Aren’t we still killing zombies?”
Yu Jie sighed in his heart.
‘He did it.’
An hour later.

Fang Heng led the Lickers around the Southern region and the Northern region, eliminating the players from the two regions and leaving only the Western region alive, and then return to the building materials market.
He did not get the record of the Western region attacking the shelter from the game log.
This meant that the Western faction players might be on guard and the 20 Lickers might not be able to do anything to them.
Moreover, Fang Heng was worried that if he killed all the Southern faction players, it might cause the special event in the game to end.
Such things had happened before.
Back at the building materials market, the zombie horde was completely cleaned up by the Eastern faction players.
The players began to collect valuable materials, put them into boxes and moved them onto trucks.
[Hint: You have completed the clearing-building materials market. You can now choose to bind to the resource point-building materials market.]
[Hint: You are bound to the building materials market. You can get 10 grey crystals per hour. All Eastern region players have a probability of getting 1 grey crystal per hour.]
Fang Heng opened the resources exchange list.
Grey crystals could be exchanged for materials, such as a wrench, steel pickaxe and some common building materials.
According to this rule, the 21 types of crystals corresponded to the types of resources that could be exchanged.

Fang Heng led the Lickers around the Southern region and the Northern region, eliminating the players from the two regions and leaving only the Western region alive, and then return to the building materials market.
He did not get the record of the Western region attacking the shelter from the game log.
This meant that the Western faction players might be on guard and the 20 Lickers might not be able to do anything to them.
Moreover, Fang Heng was worried that if he killed all the Southern faction players, it might cause the special event in the game to end.
Such things had happened before.
Back at the building materials market, the zombie horde was completely cleaned up by the Eastern faction players.
The players began to collect valuable materials, put them into boxes and moved them onto trucks.
[Hint: You have completed the clearing-building materials market.
You can now choose to bind to the resource point-building materials market.]
[Hint: You are bound to the building materials market.
You can get 10 grey crystals per hour.
All Eastern region players have a probability of getting 1 grey crystal per hour.]
Fang Heng opened the resources exchange list.
Grey crystals could be exchanged for materials, such as a wrench, steel pickaxe and some common building materials.
According to this rule, the 21 types of crystals corresponded to the types of resources that could be exchanged.

chapters.title: Chapter 328 - Cooperation
paragraphs: Fang Heng flipped through the map again. On the map, there was only one resource point related to rare ores.
Yu Jie walked to Fang Heng’s side and asked softly, “Is everything settled?”
“It’s easy.”
“Where’s Qin Ming? He didn’t come back with you?”
“He’s of no use, so I have got rid of him.”
As Fang Heng spoke, he cast his gaze towards the warehouse’s square and lowered his head in thought.
It was too troublesome to go back and forth. He might as well directly place the spatial rift in the warehouse shelter.
Other than that, Haramori City was a good place. It was very suitable for completing the next Tier 1 plan ahead of time.

As he thought, Fang Heng raised his head. “Can you think of a way to talk to the people of the Southern region? I want to cooperate with them. We are willing to share the crystals with them so that everyone can clear the level.”
It was naturally best to reduce meaningless casualties. Yu Jie was also happy to see this happen. He nodded and said, “Alright, I’ll get someone to ask.”
The Crimson Technology Gaming Company was in a mess.
“He Liang, what are you doing? My phone has been ringing off the hook. What exactly happened? Come to my office right now. I need an explanation!”
“Director He, Lin Xin Guild just sent us a message saying that their cooperation with our company has been terminated. They even requested for compensation.”
“He Liang, the video has been sent to you. There’s been a major error in your intelligence. Fang Heng is able to control a large number of Lickers, and it’s during the special event!”
“Hong Yu Gaming Company wants an explanation from us. They’re preparing to file a complaint against us for unfair competition...”
He Liang sat there, listening to the messages. His face was gloomy.
He had originally planned to kill Fang Heng, but he didn’t expect to be tricked by Fang Heng instead. He had dragged Crimson Technology Company into a quagmire.
He clenched his fists so tightly that his teeth were about to shatter. “I’ll remember this, Fang Heng.”
In the afternoon, a team of Western region elites headed to the periphery of the warehouse in the Eastern region according to the map’s instructions.
Before coming here, Pan Jinwen had specially climbed over the wall to watch a video of the Lickers massacre on the Eastern Federation’s player forum.
The content of the video was from yesterday. The location was the warehouse shelter in the Eastern region. The main character was Fang Heng’s Lickers.
The background panel was the players from the Southern and Northern regions.
They had all died very tragically.
Pan Jinwen was very glad that he had made a wise choice at that time.
After hearing the thoughts of the Eastern region wanting to cooperate, Pan Jinwen brought the player team over without a second word.
Firstly, Fang Heng’s strength was tyrannical and he could control a large number of powerful Lickers.
Pan Jinwen expressed that the Western region could not defeat them.

A dead pig was not afraid of boiling water. It would naturally be best if they could cooperate. ” n3wn0vel . ” If the other party did not care about martial virtue and was already so strong and still wanted to use the name of cooperation to set up a trap, then he could only pinch his nose and accept it.
Secondly, the arranged meeting would be guaranteed by the Federation.
At the very least, on the surface, all the major player companies and guilds would give face to the Federation and would not make things very ugly.
Just as they entered the periphery of the warehouse, Pan Jinwen and his team were dumbfounded.
More than ten sentry towers had been set up at the periphery of the warehouse.
More than ten large trucks were entrenched at the periphery of the warehouse. The players were constantly moving materials down from the trucks.
Large amounts of building materials were piled up on the square, forming ‘small hills’.
More players were sorting out materials on the square.
At first glance, wooden planks, stones, iron ore, copper ore..
Pan Jinwen and his team looked at each other, puzzled.
What was the situation on Fang Heng’s side? What were they planning to do with so many building materials?
Were they really here to build infrastructure in Haramori City?
Pan Jinwen couldn’t figure it out.
The thing he couldn’t figure out the most was that the special event in this game was more of a battle between players. Fang Heng could be said to be able to crush them with his powerful Lickers.
Why would he still want to cooperate with others?
Three large trucks filled with materials slowly drove past the side of the small team.
Fang Heng jumped down from one of the large trucks.
“Hello, I’m Fang Heng.”
“I’m Pan Jinwen. Nice to meet you.”
Pan Jinwen shook hands with Fang Heng and sized up the young man.
He was very sure that Fang Heng would definitely become the overlord-level team of Server 8 shortly.
As for how many overlord-level teams there would be in Server 8, it was still uncertain.
“Let’s talk about cooperation. Our Western region is here with sincerity.”

“Straightforward. I’ll be frank. All the materials for this special event will belong to me. I’ll be in charge of the next actions of the Western region. I guarantee that all of you will clear the game safely.”
“After the special event is over, I won’t take a single cent of the points you receive. In addition, I’ll give you a batch of guns and resources as compensation.”
Pan Jinwen’s eyes lit up and he agreed immediately. “Alright, deal!”
A great start. It was already good enough for everyone to leave the game safely.
Furthermore, he would receive an additional batch of guns and resources for free.
As for materials?
What was the use of the materials in Haramori City? It was not like he could bring them out..
After settling some of the details of the cooperation, Pan Jinwen completely relaxed. He looked at the bustling square and became even more confused.
“Fang Heng, can you tell me what you’re going to do?”
“Maximize the benefits. Stay in the special event for as long as possible and earn more points. As long as you work with me, I’m sure everyone will make money.”
Fang Heng turned to Pan Jinwen and said, “By the way, how long do you think we can stay here?”
How long?
Pan Jinwen felt that this question was a little difficult to answer.

“The intensity of the zombie horde in the special event area will get higher and higher. According to the experience of previous games, players will be able to fight each other within three days. There are very few players who can last until the fifth day.”

“Five days after entering the special event, the game will spawn a new wave of zombies every day. Eight days later, a powerful Tier 4 creature will appear in the zombie wave. With the high intensity of the game, the strength of the Tier 4 creature may have surpassed that of the Tier 5 creature.”
“Indeed. The longer we stay, the more difficult it will be.”

Hearing this, Fang Heng estimated the time in his heart and nodded repeatedly, “The defense level of the warehouse is too low. I need to repair them to resist the zombie wave. In addition, I still need to find a place to build something. When the time comes, I’ll need your help.”
Pan Jinwen felt somewhat baffled. He did not understand what Fang Heng was trying to do.
“Ahem, Fang Heng, since we’re working together, you have to tell me what you need me to do, right?”
“Of course. There’s something urgent that I need your help with.”
While speaking, Fang Heng took out a map that he had prepared beforehand and spread it out, pointing out a few areas.
“Look, here, here and here.”
“I’ve sent people to clean up the zombie horde in these areas, but I haven’t collected the materials yet.”
“I’ll go and collect and bind the 21 resource points that the system has released one by one. So, I need your help to collect the materials and send them all back.”
Pan Jinwen looked at Fang Heng in surprise.
In just one day, not only did he clean up 21 resource points, he even swept through several construction sites and building materials companies in Haramori City?
“Oh right, you can use that.”
Fang Heng pointed at the truck parked in the square.

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - Sulfuric Acid and Guns
paragraphs: After watching Pan Jinwen leave with the truck, Fang Heng turned to look at Mo Jiawei.
“In addition, we have to move ahead with our plan. We have to speed up the acquisition of sulfuric acid.”
“I’m afraid it will be very difficult.”
Mo Jiawei felt that this matter would not be easy to settle.
“Ordinary player can’t get their hands on something like sulfuric acid. Even if they could, it would be very troublesome to transport it to the prison shelter.”
“No, I can’t wait any longer. I have to get a large amount of sulfuric acid within seven days.”
Fang Heng lowered his head and thought for a moment. He nodded and said, “Let’s directly announce the purchase of sulfuric acid to the big guilds.”
“But Fang Heng, these big guilds have joined forces to deal with us this time. Can they still provide us with sulfuric acid?”
“Simple.”
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng had another idea. He leaned over and whispered into Mo Jiawei’s ear, “Later, make a statement to the public...”
Mo Jiawei opened his mouth.
“This... do we have that many guns?”

“When we have a gun production line, we can mass-produce guns and bullets. The low-level guns in the shelter are no longer useful. We can directly exchange them with the player union for sulfuric acid.”
Mo Jiawei thought for a moment and felt that there was no problem, so he nodded and said, “Okay, I’ll do it right away.”
“Since Fang Heng is still in the middle of a special event, our only choice is to go all out and directly attack the prison! Destroy his base in District 8!”
He Liang was unusually emotional.
The previous team-wipe incident had already caused the bosses of the various gaming companies to distrust Crimson Technology, but it also made them more aware of the strength of the prison.

Crimson Technology had spent a lot of hard work to think of a way to reconvene the various large guilds in the Eastern region of the Federation. They had once again held a video conference in an attempt to gather the various large guilds to make a move against Fang Heng.
“I’m sorry, our Chen Xing game union, have withdrawn.”
The guild leader of Chen Xing’s game union could hear the obvious provocation in He Liang’s tone.

He shook his head and said, “With all due respect, Crimson Technology currently only has a map of the prison’s outer defense fortifications. You don’t know anything about the situation inside the prison.”
“Moreover, just dealing with the defense net at the periphery of the prison, based on my estimation, the probability of us being able to break into it is only 50%.”

The boss of another company also nodded and agreed, “President Chen is right. Whether or not we can obtain the position of the overlord in District 8 is one thing, but sending ourselves to death is another.”

“If we don’t act now, we won’t have another chance! Are you willing to let go of this opportunity? Fang Heng is still in a special event. He can’t control the zombie team to guard the prison. This is our last chance!”
He Liang’s eyes were red. He used his last strength to encourage the various player guilds that were participating in the meeting.
However, the effect was not good. No one voiced their agreement.
“Okay, even if you are willing, you are all willing to withdraw from the fight for overlord. Then, do you think Fang Heng will let you all go easily?”
“Everyone is involved in the alliance and designing the prison. Who can guarantee that Fang Heng won’t hold a grudge against you because of this and that Fang Heng will come looking for you?”
“Everyone, you all have seen the strength of the Lickers. The video is now on the forum. who dares to guarantee that your shelter will be able to defend against Fang Heng’s Lickers?”
The meeting room fell into silence again.
“Sorry to interrupt everyone, but the prison has made another move.”

In the projection, a white-haired old man held a file in his hand. He looked up and said, “Ten minutes ago, North River Heavy Industry proposed to purchase a large number of sulfuric acid resources in District 8.”
Sulfuric acid?
He Liang frowned when he heard that.
There’s something fishy!
When everyone heard North River Heavy Industry, they would subconsciously think of Fang Heng.
Everyone knew the connection between North River Heavy Industry and Fang Heng’s prison.
Immediately, someone asked in confusion, “Sulfuric acid? Why do they need so much sulfuric acid?”
“Sulfuric acid is a chemical raw material, and it is also the material used to make some special weapons. Could it be that they want to develop special weapons?”

He Liang immediately said, “No matter what their purpose is, we absolutely can not give them sulfuric acid. Not only that, we have to seal off the sulfuric acid on the market to ensure that it doesn’t end up in the hands of the prison.”
“Director He, you’re a little anxious. It’s not too late to wait for me to finish.”

The old man said and waved his hand. “In addition to the acquisition, North River Heavy Industry has also issued a statement saying that they are willing to establish a good cooperative relationship with the major gaming companies.”
“To improve the overall survivability of the players in Server 8, North River Heavy Industry has proposed to use guns and bullets to trade for sulfuric acid.”
“I’ve looked at the exchange rate. It’s very generous. I’ve sent the file to everyone.”
Guns!
When they heard the word guns, everyone had shocked expressions on their faces.
At the current stage, the number of guns in the player’s hands had always been very small.
No matter who it was, unless they were forced to, they would not take out such an important item for no reason.
Not to mention the exchange of sulfuric acid...
He Liang’s heart sank.
Fang Heng!
What was he trying to do?
“Don’t believe him...”
He Liang almost blurted out.
But he suddenly realized that no one was listening to him.
Almost everyone’s brows were tightly knitted. They kept flipping through North River Heavy Industry’s announcement and the exchange ratio, lowering their heads and thinking about something.
For a moment, He Liang suddenly thought of something. His pupils constricted.
Suddenly, he understood.
The point was not the sulfuric acid!
It was the ‘cooperation’ and the ‘guns’!

The statement issued by North River Heavy Industry had two meanings. One was to send a message to the public that the prison was willing to cooperate, that they were willing to let bygones be bygones, and that they were willing to continue cooperating.

The second was to show off their wealth, to show off their muscles and to tell the Eastern region players that they were very rich and had a large supply of guns. If they obediently cooperated with him, he would give them some points.
From the perspective of the various large companies, it was either to cooperate or not cooperate.

If they cooperated, they could exchange their unused sulfuric acid for guns. They could even use a small amount of King of Gods’ points to exchange sulfuric acid for guns. In a short period, they could greatly improve the shelter’s combat ability.
If they chose not to cooperate, not only would they lose their guns, but they would also be subjected to Fang Heng’s revenge.
This was not the worst part. Since the start of the game, the friction between the various player guilds was also gradually taking place. Every one of them was competing openly.
If the other guilds chose to cooperate with Fang Heng and obtained a batch of guns to increase their strength, but his guild did not do so...
Their shelter’s development speed would lag behind the other companies’ guilds by a large margin!

Based on experience, with just one server, there would at most be three or four overlord-level guilds. However, there were still hundreds of large and small guilds left. They could at least make a living.
To prevent Fang Heng from becoming the overlord, it was not worth the sacrifice.
Moreover, even if one was willing to sacrifice himself, what about the other guilds?
For a moment, He Liang felt a chill run down his spine.

From the perspective of the various large companies, it was either to cooperate or not cooperate.
If they cooperated, they could exchange their unused sulfuric acid for guns.
They could even use a small amount of King of Gods’ points to exchange sulfuric acid for guns.
In a short period, they could greatly improve the shelter’s combat ability.
If they chose not to cooperate, not only would they lose their guns, but they would also be subjected to Fang Heng’s revenge.
This was not the worst part.
Since the start of the game, the friction between the various player guilds was also gradually taking place.
Every one of them was competing openly.
If the other guilds chose to cooperate with Fang Heng and obtained a batch of guns to increase their strength, but his guild did not do so...
Their shelter’s development speed would lag behind the other companies’ guilds by a large margin!
Based on experience, with just one server, there would at most be three or four overlord-level guilds.
However, there were still hundreds of large and small guilds left.
They could at least make a living.
To prevent Fang Heng from becoming the overlord, it was not worth the sacrifice.
Moreover, even if one was willing to sacrifice himself, what about the other guilds?
For a moment, He Liang felt a chill run down his spine.

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - Self-destruct
paragraphs: “Um... everyone, I suddenly remembered that I have something urgent to attend to. I’ll take my leave first.”
“Unfortunately, an old friend came to look for me and couldn’t get away. We’ll talk next time.”
“It’s getting late. Let’s call it a day for today’s meeting. I still have an emergency meeting.”
As if they had agreed, everyone understood. One by one, they made excuses and left the meeting.
The projections disappeared one by one.
In a short while, the meeting room was empty, leaving He Liang alone.
“Director He, North River Heavy Industry has just released their statement regarding the acquisition of sulfuric acid. Since you’re in a meeting, we didn’t disturb you immediately.”
Secretary Shen Xiaoxiao pushed the door open and entered.
“Since North River Heavy Industry announced the purchase of sulfuric acid, the price of sulfuric acid in the game has been soaring.”
“Give it to me.”
He Liang took a deep breath and looked over.
North River Heavy Industry’s guns were too cheap!
In the Zombie Apocalypse game, the various shelters could use their King of Gods’ points to exchange for some resources, including sulfuric acid.
According to the shelter’s level, there was a limit to the amount of exchange per month, which was related to the shelter’s level.
This meant that most shelters could get sulfuric acid to trade with Fang Heng in exchange for a large number of guns!
Standing where he was, He Liang felt a deep sense of powerlessness from the bottom of his heart.
The desperate struggle he had painstakingly built was like a joke, shattered by a simple statement from North River Heavy Industry.
Fang Heng did not know that outside of the game, the price of sulfuric acid had increased dozens of times in an hour.
After circling Haramori City, he finally completed the binding of the 21 resource points in the game.
Then, Fang Heng went to Wendy’s villa to submit the mission in advance.
[Hint: You have gathered 100 crystals each. Do you want to proceed with the fusion?]
Fang Heng reached out and chose ‘Yes’.
The coloured crystals in his backpack were deducted by 100, and one by one, transparent fusion crystals appeared.
[Hint: You have completed the fusion of crystals.]
Fang Heng held the crystal in his hand and observed it.
Item: Fusion crystal (Mission item, unable to bring it out of Haramori City).
Special description: A crystal that possesses a portion of its energy. After the end of a special event, a fusion crystal can be exchanged for 50 King of Gods’ points.
Eh? There were unexpected gains?
Each resource point could be exchanged for 10 crystals per hour. If converted, for every 10 hours, 50 King of Gods’ points could be obtained.
There was money to be made!
“Fang Heng, I’m surprised by your speed in collecting crystals.”
Wendy put away the crystals and handed over a book.
“Thank you for your help. This is the reward we agreed on. I hope it will be of some help to you.”
[Hint: Since you completed the mission within 30 hours, your reward level has increased. You will have a higher chance of obtaining a skill that is more compatible with your current skill system.]
[Hint: Randomly selecting skill...]
[Hint: You have randomly obtained a skill from the vampire system: A+ level skill book-Blood explosion.]
Skill book: Blood explosion (Soul binding).
Usage note: After using it, you can directly learn the skill-blood explosion.

Skill description: When your HP is below 10%, it can be released actively. It will detonate your entire body’s blood essence, causing a large amount of damage to your blood attribute within a 500-meter radius, (the damage ignores both friend and foe, and the damage value is related to the skill level and basic attribute of the vampire bloodline.) After the skill is activated, the player will have 0.1 seconds of invincibility and will retain 1 HP. (Can only be used with the vampire bloodline.)
Skill cooldown time: 180 minutes.
Self-destruct??
After carefully reading the skill description, Fang Heng was shocked.
Wasn’t that just self-destruct?!
At first glance, this was a trash skill with low applicability.
The damage was high enough, but normally after using it, he would only have 1 HP left. Most likely, he would die along with it.
But considering that he had a large number of zombie clones...
Baby!
With the addition of this skill, the zombie clone was about to turn into a self-destruct bomb! It would greatly increase its combat power!
The scene was beautiful.
The only problem was probably the active skill. In actual combat, Fang Heng had to do it himself and divert his attention to control the self-destruct.
Learned!
Fang Heng was itching to learn it, so he slapped the skill book on his head.
[Hint: You have learned the skill-blood explosion.]
[Hint: Blood explosion does not match the attribute of your zombie clone. Your zombie clone can still inherit and use this skill, but the overall damage will be reduced by 30%.]
“Hmm... it’s actually weakened.”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
“The effect isn’t that big.”
Since the beginning of the game, most zombies could inherit normal skills with a 100% success rate.
This was the first time Fang Heng had encountered such a special setting that didn’t match the attribute.
It didn’t matter. It was a skill that he had picked up for free anyway.
It just so happened that he had a tough battle to fight in a few days. He could try out the strength of this skill.
Six days later.
Eastern region warehouse.
Looking at the time passage in front of him, Pan Jinwen still felt like he was in a dream.
Although he didn’t understand how Fang Heng did it, he was greatly shocked.
All this while, Pan Jinwen couldn’t figure out what Fang Heng wanted to do, or why he would collect large amounts of materials and resources to build infrastructure in Haramori City.
It was not until two days ago that he saw the time teleportation passage built at the periphery of the warehouse, only then did Pan Jinwen come to a realization.
So Fang Heng was playing such a big game!
Who would have thought that someone would build a time teleportation device during a special event in Haramori City? It could be used to transport the materials out of Haramori City endlessly...
Fang Heng understood the game!
Pan Jinwen looked at Fang Heng with admiration.
The zombies kept transporting the materials and resources they had collected back to the shelter through the spatial rift.
More zombies kept coming out of the spatial rift with plastic buckets filled with special solutions.
Yu Jie was also shocked when he saw this scene.
He felt that Chen Yu’s description of Fang Heng was correct.
A player who could constantly surprise people.

Yu Jie did not expect that Fang Heng would think of a way to directly create a teleportation passage in Haramori City. He even packed up all the materials and resources, including the firearms production line, and brought them back to the shelter.
Theoretically, players could not do this at all.
After calming down, Yu Jie felt that this was a great thing.

The popularity of guns in District 8 would raise the overall strength of the players in Server 8 to a whole new level. The development speed would also be greatly increased, and the survival rate of the player would naturally increase.
Moreover, the Federation had also exchanged a lot of intermediate guns with Fang Heng for sulfuric acid.
“Eh?”
Pan Jinwen noticed that groups of zombies were moving blue barrels out of the warehouse.
“Fang Heng, what are those?”
“Yeah, I asked a friend to make a special sulfuric acid solution.”
Pan Jinwen was extremely curious.

In the past few days, the exchange of sulfuric acid for weapons had become very popular on the forums. The three regions were all fighting to trade with North River Heavy Industry, for fear of not catching up.
“Fang Heng, what are you collecting so much sulfuric acid for?”

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - Earn Him a Wave
paragraphs: “Sulfuric acid is the most important thing. I have another use for it.”
“Alright.”
Pan Jinwen didn’t continue to ask.
He was very sure that Fang Heng had a plan.
To be able to get to where he was today, Fang Heng didn’t rely on luck alone.
Yu Jie was also very curious and was itching to know the reason.
It was one thing to collect sulfuric acid from the outside, but why did Fang Heng go through so much trouble to move the sulfuric acid here?
After all, the cost of opening the teleportation passage was too expensive.
Pan Jinwen asked, “Fang Heng, there are still five hours left to the next zombie wave. Shouldn’t our people prepare to evacuate?”
“Evacuate? Who said we’re going to evacuate?”
Pan Jinwen was stunned.
Not leaving?
He and Yu Jie looked at each other and saw doubt in each other’s eyes.
Fang Heng still wanted to continue defending against the zombie wave?
Could it be that all the sulfuric acid he saw before was prepared for the zombie wave?
Pan Jinwen pondered for a moment and was about to ask when a game hint quickly flashed across the retina of every player in Haramori City.
[Hint: A new zombie wave will be coming in five hours. This zombie wave will spawn eight Tier 4 mutated zombie-One-eyed. Player, please get ready.]
[Hint: After this zombie wave is completed, you will receive 100,000 faction points and individual points based on your contribution.]
From the third day of the special event, there would be a new wave of zombies every day at a fixed time.
The player faction would receive a large number of points after defeating the zombie wave.
Until the seventh day, there would be a new Tier 4 mutated zombie in the zombie wave, which greatly increased the difficulty.

Different from the outside world, the zombie attribute in special events would gradually increase with time. On the seventh day, the Tier 4 mutated zombie’s attribute was comparable to the Tier 5 mutated zombie in the outside world. The player could not resist it at all.
Until now, no player team had survived the seventh day of the zombie wave during special events.
Similarly, once they passed the seventh day of the zombie wave, the points reward would be extremely shocking.
“Don’t worry, I’m prepared. There are only 16 Tier 4 mutated zombies between the two camps. We can handle them.”
Fang Heng was in a good mood. He chuckled and patted Pan Jinwen on the shoulder. “I promised you. If there are benefits, we’ll earn them together. Keep the 1,000,000 faction points.”
Danger also meant opportunity.
That was 100,000 points!
It was enough for him to exchange for another batch of rare ores and return to the shelter.
Pan Jinwen looked at Fang Heng, who was full of confidence. For a moment, he was in a daze.
If anyone else had said that to him, Pan Jinwen would have thought that the other party was a lunatic.
But...
Fang Heng’s words...
Pan Jinwen felt that Fang Heng could do it.
Could he do it?
Pan Jinwen hesitated.
Reason told Pan Jinwen that with their current defense, they wouldn’t be able to hold on even if there were only three of them, let alone 16 one-eyed zombies!
Although the one-eyed zombie was known to be a Tier 4 mutated zombie, its actual strength had already reached Tier 5!
“Look, the thing I prepared is here. With it, we’ll be able to survive this zombie wave.”
Pan Jinwen looked up.
In the distance, Zhou Yi and Lu Yu drove a truck from the periphery into the warehouse area and stopped in front of them.
That was...
A crystal coffin?!
Seeing the crystal coffin behind the truck, Yu Jie’s pupils shrank.
Yu Jie was very familiar with this crystal coffin!
It was used to carry a crystallized creature!
Not long ago, his desert shelter had almost been destroyed by a Tier 4 crystallized creature.
Yu Jie turned around and asked, “Fang Heng, is it a crystallized creature?”
“Yes, that’s right.”
“How did you get them to Haramori City?”
Lu Yu opened the car door and jumped out of the driver’s seat. “I used a powerful catapult device to call for help from outside the city.”
“These coffins are very sturdy and stable.”
Yu Jie immediately realized something.
Several keywords flashed through his mind.
Sulfuric acid... crystallized form...
No way... Fang Heng couldn’t be thinking of...
“Well done! I’ll give you a credit!”
Fang Heng and Lu Yu high-fived, their expressions excited.
Fatten and kill!
Season 2!
Previously, Fang Heng had planned to set up the experimental field of the ‘Fatten up Project’ on Paradise Island.

In the original rough plan, Fang Heng wanted to make use of the next Blood Moon to try and gather a large number of players to stay on Paradise Island, thus triggering the appearance of Tier 5 Berserk Corpse King.
Then, he would cultivate a group of high-tier crystallized forms on Paradise Island in advance, triggering a battle between the high-tier crystallized forms and the Berserk Corpse King.
When the battle was almost over, Fang Heng would take advantage of the situation. He would kill the Berserk Corpse King and the crystallized forms, and collect the high energy evolution crystals.
But then he encountered a special event.
Now that he thought about it, Haramori City was a better place to carry out the Fatten up Project!
The risk was more controllable!

Fang Heng had already calculated that even if he directly withdrew from the special event now, the points obtained from this event had already been used to purchase the rare metal materials needed to upgrade the space tearing device, as well as the pyroxene ore used to manufacture blue energy crystals.
In other words, other than the last two high energy evolution crystals, all the tools needed to construct Tier 3 space tearing device were already prepared!
Only the last two crystals were left!
Fang Heng’s eyes flashed with madness.
He couldn’t wait any longer!
Upgrading to a Tier 3 space tearing device was imminent!
With such a good opportunity now, he could directly get the last two high energy evolution crystals!
At the same time, he could use the strength of the crystal to survive the high-intensity zombie wave on the seventh day and earn a wave of points from it!
It was today!
“Let’s go and see how to set up the trap.”
Soon, Fang Heng led his team to a space in front of the shelter.
A huge pit had been dug in the ground after a few days.
The pit had a radius of more than 20 meters and a depth of more than 15 meters.
In the past two days, Pan Jinwen and his team had reconstructed the entire pit according to the construction drawings given by Fang Heng.
About three meters above the ground, Pan Jinwen ordered his team to continue digging parallel to the ground and dug out a platform on the second basement.
The second basement was not deep, only four meters.
The player was currently moving buckets of sulfuric acid into the second basement through the sling.
Yu Jie looked at the busy player below and already guessed in his heart. He whispered, “As expected, it’s sulfuric acid...”
Fang Heng waved his hand in the direction of the truck that Zhou Yi was driving.
The truck slowly drove over.
“Crash!!!”
The blue crystal ores loaded on the truck were all poured into the bottom of the pit.
Seeing the large number of blue crystal ores falling into the bottom of the pit, Yu Jie was now completely sure of what Fang Heng wanted to do.
To use a Tier 5 crystallized form to deal with a Tier 5 one-eyed zombie!
But...
Would it be that easy?
It looked beautiful on the surface, but there were too many details that needed to be considered. If one was not careful, the whole plan would fail.
“Fang Heng invested so much for such an early stage?”
Yu Jie turned around and asked with a bitter smile, “Fang Heng, aren’t you working a little too hard?”
“A little, but I have a plan.”
Fang Heng put away the smile on his face and opened the game log to take a last look at the time.
There were less than four hours left before the zombie wave. It was enough to transport all the remaining sulfuric acid to the second basement platform.
Everything else had been arranged.
This was a sure thing.
