“Crash!!!”
The blue crystal ores loaded on the truck were all poured into the bottom of the pit.
Seeing the large number of blue crystal ores falling into the bottom of the pit, Yu Jie was now completely sure of what Fang Heng wanted to do.
To use a Tier 5 crystallized form to deal with a Tier 5 one-eyed zombie!
But...
Would it be that easy?
It looked beautiful on the surface, but there were too many details that needed to be considered.
If one was not careful, the whole plan would fail.
“Fang Heng invested so much for such an early stage?”
Yu Jie turned around and asked with a bitter smile, “Fang Heng, aren’t you working a little too hard?”
“A little, but I have a plan.”
Fang Heng put away the smile on his face and opened the game log to take a last look at the time.
There were less than four hours left before the zombie wave.
It was enough to transport all the remaining sulfuric acid to the second basement platform.
Everything else had been arranged.
This was a sure thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - Nurturing
paragraphs: “The zombie wave will respawn in 10 minutes. In theory, we will encounter a Tier 4 mutated zombie this time.”
“Let’s talk about the battle plan. The difficulty of this zombie wave is the mutated zombie, One-eyed. Its actual combat ability can reach Tier 5, so we can’t fight it head-on.”
“What we need to do later is to think of a way to lure the one-eyed zombie into the pit. As for the other low-level zombies, it will be like before where we rely on traps and guns to deal with them.”
“To prevent accidents, the Lickers will also help deal with the normal zombies.”

Fang Heng roughly laid out the battle plan. As he spoke, he nodded at Pan Jinwen and said, “The zombie horde has an additional hatred towards the faction leader, later you will follow me. Yu Jie, you will be in charge of mobilizing the other players. We will contact each other through the walkie-talkie.”
Pan Jinwen nodded heavily and said, “Alright.”
Yu Jie nodded solemnly as well.
He still felt that the risk was too great.
Fang Heng’s plan might be feasible in theory.
However, it was only in theory. It was too difficult to operate in reality.
For example, how could Fang Heng push all the one-eyed zombies into the pit?
If one was not careful, as long as one was missed out, the shelter might suffer a devastating blow.
“Bang! Bang Bang!”
Heavy footsteps sounded behind them.
The Tyrant form carried a crystal coffin and strode forward, arriving at the edge of the pit.
Fang Heng nodded at the Tyrant form.
The Tyrant form pulled open the coffin and threw the crystallized form into the pit.
Seven tiny worms landed at the bottom of the pit.
The worms that were already in suspended animation sensed a certain aura.
“Chi Chi Chi...”
The seven crystallized worms immediately reacted. They quickly woke up and slowly climbed towards the blue crystal ores.
In just a few minutes, the crystallized worms laid on the blue crystal ores one by one, greedily absorbing the blue crystal ore’s energy.
The crystallized worm’s body slowly expanded at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Fang Heng nodded at the crowd.
“Let’s begin! Get ready for battle.”
[Hint: In three minutes, there will be a new zombie wave. In this zombie wave, our camp will spawn eight Tier 4 mutated zombies-One-eyed. Player, please get ready.]
“It’s coming! Raise your spirits and defend this wave!”
Fang Heng shouted to boost the morale.
When the three-minute countdown was up, the zombie horde immediately spawned around the shelter.
The players stood on the newly built sentry tower and aimed their guns at the zombie horde.
In seven days, with the addition of the game’s difficulty, the HP of the ordinary zombies had increased by more than ten times.
The damage of the pistol to the zombies was already very small.
However, the movement speed of the zombies was still a weakness.
The players were also very experienced. They used all kinds of traps to slow down the zombie horde’s attack on the shelter, and used them in an orderly manner.
Wave after wave of zombies fell on the way to the shelter.
Hundreds of Lickers formed combat units and would occasionally charge out from the side of the zombie wave to help the player reduce the number of ordinary zombies.
Fang Heng’s eyes were fixed at a distance.
With the help of the Lickers and the players, dealing with ordinary zombies was not a problem.
The real threat was the higher level Tier 4 zombie-One-eyed.
The one-eyed zombie was a special mutant, with a huge eyeball protruding from its head. It had powerful regenerative and destructive abilities.
Its biggest characteristic was that it used a huge bone club as a weapon to carry out an area-of-effect attack.
Among the zombies, a one-eyed zombie stepped forward and waved the huge bone club in its hand.
It was coming!
The one-eyed zombie was the same size as the Tyrant form. They were both large-scale living forms and were especially eye-catching among the zombies.
Fang Heng immediately controlled a Tyrant form to charge at the one-eyed zombie.
With the high attribute boost from the special event, the destructive power of the one-eyed zombie had long broken through to Tier 5!
The one-eyed zombie waved the huge bone club in its hand and smashed it in the direction where the Tyrant form was charging at.
“Bang!!!”
There was a heavy muffled sound! Following that, there was the sound of bones breaking one after another.
Tyrant form was hit in the chest by a bone club and was sent flying three to four meters away.
“Roar!!!”
The one-eyed zombie roared.
An opportunity!
Taking advantage of this gap, Fang Heng immediately controlled the other three Tyrant forms to pounce on the one-eyed zombie.
“Bang!!!”
The one-eyed zombie was hit by the three Tyrant forms at the same time. They tangled together and fell into the deep pit behind them.
“Boom!!”
The one-eyed zombie fell heavily into the bottom of the pit.
The three Tyrant forms used the vines formed by their right hands to hang on the edge of the pit.
“Chi Chi Chi...”
The vines quickly contracted and pulled the three Tyrant forms back to the ground.
“Roar!!!”
The one-eyed zombie that was trapped at the bottom of the pit was completely enraged and let out a wild roar.
Its scarlet eye was filled with blood vessels. It raised its bone club and smashed it at the rock wall.
“Bang!”
“Bang Bang!”
The entire pit shook violently!
The Tier 5 crystallized worms that were greedily devouring the blue crystal ores at the bottom of the pit were disturbed.
Coincidentally, the crystallized worms needed to devour some flesh and blood in addition to devouring the blue crystal ores.
As for whether the flesh and blood were fresh or not, it didn’t matter.
“Chi Chi Chi! !”
Facing the delicious food that was delivered to their doorstep, the seven Tier 5 crystallized worms pounced on the one-eyed zombie and started tearing at it.
Their sharp mouthparts directly bit off pieces of flesh and blood from the one-eyed zombie’s body!
“Roar!”
The one-eyed zombie was in pain. It swung its bone club and started hammering the crystallized worms in the pit.
“Bang!”
“Bang! Bang!”
The crystallized evolved armour had fine cracks after being hammered by the one-eyed zombie many times!

They were both at Tier 5, so the one-eyed zombie wasn’t weak. However, it was hard to fight against four hands with two fists. After being bitten by seven crystallized creatures continuously, it was soon unable to make an effective counterattack.
“It’s done.”
Standing on the high ground, Fang Heng clenched his fists.
The one-eyed zombie was as strong as a Tier 5 zombie, but couldn’t gain any advantage under the attack of the crystallized creatures, so it became the prey of the crystallized worms.
If it weren’t for the help of the crystallized worms, he wouldn’t have been able to kill 16 one-eyed zombies.
Pan Jinwen, who was standing beside Fang Heng, was also shocked by such aggressive creatures.
“So this is Fang Heng’s trump card that allows him to have the confidence to deal with this crisis?”
While he was still in shock, Pan Jinwen saw something out of the corner of his eye and shouted, “Fang Heng! Over there!”
Fang Heng turned his head and looked at the other side of the battlefield.
Another one-eyed zombie that had just respawned walked towards the sentry tower on the right side of the shelter.
It swung its huge bone club.
“Boom!!”
The bone club hit the sentry tower!
After taking a heavy hit, the durability of the sentry tower was only left with a little bit of HP. It was directly destroyed and could not be used.
The player on the sentry tower was so scared that he immediately turned his head and jumped down.
Fang Heng was already prepared. He raised his sniper rifle, switched to armour-piercing bullets and aimed at the one-eyed zombie’s head.
“Bang!!!”
A gunshot was heard.
The bullet exploded into a cloud of blood mist on the one-eyed zombie’s head.
The one-eyed zombie slowly turned its head and looked in the direction where Fang Heng was standing.
Fang Heng looked at it calmly.

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - Vines
paragraphs: Under the zombie wave, the zombie horde had an additional hatred for the player’s faction shelter and faction leader.
The one-eyed zombie gave up on the sentry tower in front of it, changed its target and strode toward Fang Heng.
“It’s taken the bait...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself.
He held his breath and focused, then aimed at the one-eyed zombie and pulled the trigger again.
“Bang!”
The one-eyed zombie had extremely high HP. It resisted Fang Heng’s attacks and moved forward step by step.
Yu Jie’s voice was heard through the communication device hanging by his ear.
“Fang Heng, Pan Jinwen, a one-eyed zombie has appeared in Position C. It has caused a lot of damage to the defensive building. We need to think of a way to lure it away!”
Fang Heng turned his head to look in Area C’s direction.
A newly spawned one-eyed zombie was destroying the defensive building in Area C.
Fang Heng immediately controlled the other three Tyrant forms to chase after the newly-spawned one-eyed zombie, trying to temporarily hold them back.
“Fang Heng, be careful! It’s coming towards us.”
Pan Jinwen nervously swallowed his saliva.
The one-eyed zombie that was attracted by Fang Heng’s sniper rifle was about to walk past the hole in the ground.
Fang Heng suddenly turned his head and fixed his gaze on the one-eyed zombie.
“Chi... Chi... Chi...”
At that moment, the intertwining vines under the one-eyed zombie’s feet suddenly moved. They extended upward at an extremely fast speed, wrapping around the one-eyed zombie’s ankle in an instant!
The one-eyed zombie was striding forward. Its right ankle, which was about to move away, was unable to break free from the vines for a moment. Its body swayed slightly.
The one-eyed zombie wasn’t in a good state of mind. Before it realized what was happening, the vines under its feet tightened and contracted rapidly.
“Squeak, Squeak...”
The vines were pulled to the limit!
Under the huge pulling force, the one-eyed zombie couldn’t maintain its balance for a moment. It fell to the ground and was quickly dragged into the pit.
“Bang!”
The one-eyed zombie fell heavily to the bottom of the pit.
The seven crystallized worms in the pit were on a massacre. Seeing the new one-eyed zombie, they immediately pounced on it and started biting it crazily.
“Roar!”
The one-eyed zombie was in pain and was furious. It waved the bone club in its hand and struggled.
“What... What was that just now?”
Everything happened too fast. Pan Jinwen, who was standing next to Fang Heng, was shocked.
What the hell was that?
Vines?
Pan Jinwen rubbed his eyes and looked carefully.
The ground around the pit was covered with a layer of light-colored vines. Half an hour ago, these things were not there.
Were these vines part of his plan?
Pan Jinwen took a deep breath and looked at Fang Heng with lingering fear.
He felt that Fang Heng was unfathomable.
“That’s right, vines.”
Fang Heng also let out a sigh of relief.
It seemed that he had succeeded.
He had indeed made double preparations in advance and gathered more than 300 vine zombies in the second layer of the pit.
The vine zombies had extended the vines and covered the ground outside the pit.
As long as a high-tier zombie passed by, the vines would jump out and tie it tightly, dragging it into the pit and leaving it for the crystallized form to eat.
To do this, Fang Heng needed to focus on controlling them, which was very exhausting.
“The plan succeeded. This is the second one. Come and help me lure the one-eyed zombie to the pit.”
After succeeding, Fang Heng raised his head and drank a bottle of Red Bull. His eyes swept across the battlefield again, searching for the next one-eyed zombie.
“Okay!”
Seeing that, Pan Jinwen’s fighting spirit soared. He responded and raised his long-barreled shotgun, aiming at the one-eyed zombie in the distance.
“The fourteenth one.”
“The fifteenth one!”
“The sixteenth one...”
Fang Heng said in a low voice.
Half an hour later, the last zombie was tied up by the vines and dragged into the bottom of the pit.
“Done! Let’s go and take a look.”
Seeing that all the one-eyed zombies had been cleaned up, Fang Heng immediately jumped down from the sentry tower and ran toward the pit not far away.
The angle of the sentry tower wasn’t very good, so Fang Heng couldn’t see the bottom of the pit clearly.
Coming to the edge of the pit, Fang Heng lowered his head to observe the inside.
The crystallized bodies of the worms were in a bad condition. The crystallized armour on their bodies had been broken into many pieces, and traces of red blood were oozing out.
But in comparison, the one-eyed zombies were in a worse state!
Most of the 16 one-eyed zombies had been devoured, and the last three were still fighting back, using their huge bone clubs to hit the crystallized worms.
The crystallized worms still had the upper hand!
Every bite they made could take away a large piece of flesh from the one-eyed zombies.
On the other hand, the one-eyed zombies’ bone clubs seemed to be very heavy, but they didn’t seem to be able to cause fatal damage to the crystallized worms.
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes and observed, thinking that it was terrifying.
The strength of the crystallized worms was beyond imagination. They had the upper hand in the fight against the one-eyed zombies!
Although it looked miserable, its vitality was still strong.
After devouring the blue crystal ores and the flesh of the one-eyed zombies, the few crystallized worms had a faint layer of purple under their skin.
It was a sign that they were about to evolve.
If they continued to devour, they might level up to Tier 6 crystallized form!
“Fang Heng, what’s the situation?”

Pan Jinwen caught up with them. As he spoke, he lowered his head and looked down at the bottom of the pit. Seeing the crystallized worms tearing at flesh and blood, he immediately felt his scalp go numb.
“It’s grown big enough. I’m afraid it won’t be able to eat any more...”
Fang Heng didn’t waste any more time. He immediately controlled the vine zombies in the second basement and poured the special sulfuric acid solution into the pit.
“Splash...”
More than ten barrels of sulfuric acid solution were poured down from the sky.
The special sulfuric acid solution was modified by Qiu Yaokang, and it was more effective against the crystallized armour of the worms!
“Sizzle! Sizzle! Sizzle!”
The sulfuric acid solution fell on the body of the crystallized forms and white mist immediately rose from their bodies.
The dark red crystallized armour on the outermost layer of the crystallized form was rapidly corroded, showing a burnt black colour.
The crystallized worms felt intense pain!
They struggled on the ground and kept rolling.
However, the more they rolled, the more the sulfuric acid solution splashed out and accelerated the corrosion speed of the crystallized armour!
The survival instinct made several crystallized worms try to climb up the stone wall.
“Want to run?”
Fang Heng snorted in disdain.
More sulfuric acid mixed solution poured down from the high ground!
It splashed toward the crystallized worms that were trying to escape up the stone wall.
The crystallized worms were drenched by the sulfuric acid and immediately fell down from the stone wall, struggling even more painfully.
“Chi Chi Chi...”
Instantly, white mist visible to the naked eye rose from the cave entrance!
“Fang Heng, how’s the situation on your side?”
Yu Jie was very nervous. As he commanded the players of the shelter to deal with the zombie wave, he would occasionally use binoculars to stare at the entrance of the deep pit.
Seeing the mist rising from the hole, he could not help but feel uneasy.
“Not bad, everything is going well.”
Fang Heng replied.
When the mist had dispersed a little, he lowered his head and continued to observe the hole.

He immediately controlled the vine zombies in the second basement and poured the special sulfuric acid solution into the pit.
“Splash...”
More than ten barrels of sulfuric acid solution were poured down from the sky.
The special sulfuric acid solution was modified by Qiu Yaokang, and it was more effective against the crystallized armour of the worms!
“Sizzle!
Sizzle!
Sizzle!”
The sulfuric acid solution fell on the body of the crystallized forms and white mist immediately rose from their bodies.
The dark red crystallized armour on the outermost layer of the crystallized form was rapidly corroded, showing a burnt black colour.
The crystallized worms felt intense pain!
They struggled on the ground and kept rolling.
However, the more they rolled, the more the sulfuric acid solution splashed out and accelerated the corrosion speed of the crystallized armour!
The survival instinct made several crystallized worms try to climb up the stone wall.
“Want to run?”
Fang Heng snorted in disdain.
More sulfuric acid mixed solution poured down from the high ground!
It splashed toward the crystallized worms that were trying to escape up the stone wall.
The crystallized worms were drenched by the sulfuric acid and immediately fell down from the stone wall, struggling even more painfully.
“Chi Chi Chi...”
Instantly, white mist visible to the naked eye rose from the cave entrance!
“Fang Heng, how’s the situation on your side?”
Yu Jie was very nervous.
As he commanded the players of the shelter to deal with the zombie wave, he would occasionally use binoculars to stare at the entrance of the deep pit.
Seeing the mist rising from the hole, he could not help but feel uneasy.
“Not bad, everything is going well.”
Fang Heng replied.
When the mist had dispersed a little, he lowered his head and continued to observe the hole.

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - Serial Explosions
paragraphs: Did he succeed?
He did.
But it didn’t seem to be a complete success.
Fang Heng frowned.
At the bottom of the pit, there was a one-meter-deep mixture of sulfuric acid mixed with red blood.
The three severely injured one-eyed zombies had died a long time ago.
The remaining seven crystallized worms were still soaking in the corrosive solution,
“They are not dead yet?”
Fang Heng was very surprised.
Looking carefully, the crystallized worms were secreting a layer of pale white mucus.
The mucus seemed to be able to block part of the corrosive effect.
Fang Heng’s eyelids twitched.
The corrosive sulfuric acid solution had only damaged the crystallized armour on the outermost layer of the crystallized worm.
It was the same last time. In the end, they had to rely on the attacks of a large number of Lickers to finally finish off the crystallized worms.
Pan Jinwen was secretly speechless, wondering what the hell was that thing?
The one-eyed zombies, whose strength was close to Tier 5, had long been melted to the point that not even their bones were left. How could they still be alive?
If they were allowed to come out, things would be troublesome.
“Fang Heng, what should we do? You should have a backup plan, right?”
“Of course, I just prepared it.”
Fang Heng waved his hand!
The three vine zombies in the second basement fell toward the bottom of the pit.
“Pa! Pa! Pa!”
The three vine zombies fell into the sulfuric acid solution one by one.
What was that for?
Pan Jinwen was confused and was about to ask.
In the next second, the three vine zombies exploded at the bottom of the cave.
“Boom! Boom! Boom!”
The intense explosion caused the sulfuric acid solution to fly more than ten meters into the air.
Pan Jinwen quickly retracted his head.
His face slightly changed. He turned his head in disbelief and looked at Fang Heng, his heart filled with shock.
The zombies...
Exploded?
Fang Heng opened the game log and took a look.
[Hint: Your vine zombie clone has received corrosion damage-181.]
[Hint: Your vine zombie clone has received corrosion damage-181...]
[Hint: Your vine zombie clone has used skill-blood explosion.]
[Hint: Your vine zombie clone has dealt 6891 damage to the crystallized form (Tier 5)!]
[Hint: Your vine zombie clone (proliferator) has died.]
Not bad.
An area of damage of about 7000 points.
This power was much more reliable than a small grenade!
Fang Heng was getting more and more satisfied with the self-destruct skill that he had just acquired. He licked his lips and waved his hand.
“Continue!”
The zombie team in the second basement received the command. They lined up and jumped toward the bottom of the pit.
“Boom! Boom! Boom!”
The zombie clone proliferators self-detonated at the bottom of the pit.
The ground kept shaking.
Pan Jinwen felt the continuous explosions in his ears and felt his legs go soft.
He felt like he was going crazy.
Fang Heng hid such a powerful fighting strength!?
They were far more terrifying than the Lickers.
Those idiots from Crimson Technology, the intelligence they gave was not reliable at all!
How arrogant were they? How could they think that they could kill Fang Heng in this special event?
They would be thankful if they weren’t killed!
After dealing with the ordinary zombies, Zhou Yi, who had just arrived to watch the fight, was also shocked. He silently turned his head and exchanged a glance with Lu Yu.
Wow, Fang Heng had such a trick?
He hid it well!
After five minutes of continuous long-range bombardment, a line of game hints appeared in front of Fang Heng.
[Hint: Your faction will be able to survive this zombie wave. You will receive 100,000 faction points (you can distribute the points after completing the special event).]
[Hint: Due to your performance in this zombie wave, you will receive 25,450,000 individual points. The next zombie wave will have a Tier 5 creature. Please be careful.]
Even the zombie wave had ended, yet the Tier 5 crystallized worms had not been blown to death?
Fang Heng had a clear understanding of the strength of a Tier 5 creature.
Fortunately, he was lucky this time and obtained the self-destruct skill in advance.
Otherwise, he would still need to use the backup plan and rely on the Lickers to engage in melee combat.
Fang Heng was secretly vigilant. He quickly glanced at the game hint and controlled another batch of zombie clones to come over, preparing to self-destruct together.
After confirming that the zombie wave had ended, Yu Jie immediately brought the player team over.
Many players stood by Fang Heng’s side and watched as the zombie team of the second basement fell into the bottom of the pit and self-destructed continuously.
From the initial shock to the fear that followed, it eventually turned into joy.
The huge explosion made all the players have the same thought.
Fortunately, Fang Heng was their teammate.
From now on, they could not be enemies with Fang Heng’s Prison Army.
Which shelter could withstand such a zombie suicide attack?
Finally, after nearly 20 minutes of continuous bombing, a few game hints rang in Fang Heng’s ears.
[Hint: Your zombie clone killed the crystallized worm (Tier 5 strength)*7, and you received high energy evolution crystal * 3.]
It’s over!
Fang Heng’s spirit was lifted!
Seven Tier 5 crystallized worms had dropped a total of three high energy evolution crystals!
Other than that, perhaps because the crystallized worm itself was not a special event, killing it did not earn any other points or survival points.
That was not important!
Fang Heng controlled the zombie corpse to stop committing suicide. He moved to the front of the deep pit and raised his hand.
At the bottom of the pit, the three light purple crystals in the mixed solution were pulled by a special strength and flew out of Fang Heng’s hand.
[Hint: You have obtained high energy crystal*3.]
Fang Heng felt the cold aura coming from the high energy evolution crystal.
Done!
After completing the last piece of the puzzle, they could successfully upgrade the teleportation device completely!
Next, he could think of a way to find the first-generation meteorite from another server!
After that, he would complete the main storyline mission! He would obtain the ownership of this world!
Fang Heng felt that the road ahead had become wider, and his goals after that became extremely clear.
But...
Fang Heng was full of fighting spirit when he suddenly realized a very big problem.
Which server should he find the first-generation meteorite from?
Beside him, Yu Jie was quite serious. He looked at Fang Heng from top to bottom, as if he wanted to get to know him again.
Unbelievable, he did it!
Not only did he lead the player team through the seventh day of the zombie wave, he even killed a Tier 5 crystallized worm.
The strength he revealed during the process was even more shocking.
Yu Jie was very sure that the Federation’s investigation report on Fang Heng was a piece of sh*t.
Other than misleading them, there was no other use.
The other players were still immersed in joy. The high-level zombie wave had allowed each of them to earn a large sum of points.
When this was over, the shelter could welcome a big transformation!
Pan Jinwen could no longer control the joy on his face. He walked forward and congratulated Fang Heng, “Fang Heng, congratulations, we’ve succeeded.”
“Thank you.”
Fang Heng finally reacted.
He put away the smile on his face and decided to take a step back.
Perhaps Qiu Yaokang would have an answer.
After he went offline, he could try to look up information on the internet.
Victor’s actions were very fast. Once all the materials were gathered, it would only take less than half a day to complete the construction of the Tier 3 space tearing device...

For a moment, Fang Heng was eager to return. He could not wait to go offline to search for information. He turned around and looked at everyone. “I think we can prepare to evacuate from Haramori city now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 335 - Exchange for Reward
paragraphs: The next morning.
The last batch of materials collected from Haramori City was sent back to the shelter through the teleportation passage.
The zombie clones disassembled the military truck into parts and went through the spatial rift.
After doing all this, they brought the players back to Wendy’s apocalypse camp and officially left the special event through the special teleportation portal.

“We found a special toxin in the fusion crystal. It was this toxin that caused the rapid evolution and mutation of the zombies in Haramori City. After you leave Haramori City, I’ll think of a way to destroy this place and prevent the toxin from spreading.”
Wendy nodded and looked at the crowd. “If you’re ready, you can leave this place at any time.”
The players chose to deduct their points and directly left the game through the teleportation formation.
Fang Heng was the last to stand on the teleportation array.
“By the way, help me calculate my points with these crystals.”
Wendy received the fusion crystals from Fang Heng, her eyes full of surprise.
She put away the crystals and looked at Fang Heng again.
“Fang Heng, I see hope in you. I look forward to the next time we meet. I hope you can bring a glimmer of hope to our world.”
In the next moment, Fang Heng’s eyes were enveloped by a blinding white light.
When he opened his eyes again, Fang Heng had already returned to Vettel’s apocalypse merchant camp.
“Welcome back, Fang Heng. I knew you could do it! This cup of 44-year-old Maotai was specially prepared for you to celebrate.”
Vettel had bet a large sum of money on Fang Heng. At this time, he had earned a large sum of money and was in a great mood.
He opened the bottle cap and a strong aroma of wine instantly filled the entire camp.
“Uh, thank you.”
Fang Heng did not like drinking so much. He answered perfunctorily and observed the rows of messages that appeared on his retina.
[Hint: This special event has been completed and the points are being calculated... calculating the surplus safe time... calculating the special hidden mission...]

[Hint: The statistics have been completed. The player of this special event has obtained a total of 3,282,900 faction points and 23,522,100 personal points. (You have obtained the final victory of this special event. You have obtained an additional 1,000,000 personal points.) As the faction leader, please choose to allocate your faction points.]
[Hint: You have submitted fusion crystals. Based on your performance, you have obtained an additional 680 King of Gods’ points as a reward.]
[Hint: You can use your points to exchange for items in any apocalypse merchant camp.]
[Hint: This time, your points will be cleared in a week. Please use it as soon as possible.]
The rewards were not bad.
Fang Heng was very satisfied with his trip to Haramori City.
These days, his Licker clones had been killing zombies in the city to earn points. In addition, he had safely survived several zombie waves and his personal points had soared.
Compared to his personal points, the faction points and the final personal victory reward were not enough.
Fang Heng chose to take half of the team points and allocate the remaining half to Yu Jie so that he could distribute them to the small companies based on their contribution.
The next step was to use these points!
It was very difficult to obtain King of Gods’ points. He had to use them to upgrade the space tearing device and save the remaining King of Gods’ points for a rainy day.
“Vettel, I need to exchange for some rewards.”
“Of course you can. You’ve always been so focused on your work. Fang Heng, when the time arises, you have to enjoy life.”
Vettel winked at Fang Heng and then handed him a small cup of Maotai.
Fang Heng took the cup and took a sip, then opened the exchange column for this special event.
Most of the items that could be exchanged for special event points were production-type materials, such as special ores, rare materials, chemicals and so on.
And they were very cheap!
“Glazed stone, black marbles, hydrochloric acid, sulfuric acid, caustic soda, concrete...”
“They’re so cheap, I’ll buy some for storage...”
Fang Heng waved his hand.

Due to the time limit for the exchange, other than upgrading the rare ores needed for the construction of the Tier 3 teleportation device and pyroxene required for construction, Fang Heng also bought a lot of rare ores for storage in the shelter.
“Oh, and sulfuric acid.”
Fang Heng thought and bought out all the remaining sulfuric acid in the shop.
The crystallized form was a good thing.
“In the future, I might have to raise the crystallized form to Tier 6 before killing it. It’s always good to stock up on sulfuric acid, just in case.”
Fang Heng muttered to himself and flipped through the pages. If he saw anything good, he would buy it out, like a nouveau riche.
After all, he had sufficient points.
Eh? There was a skill book?
At the end of the page, Fang Heng noticed two skill books.
Skill book-lock picking.
Description: After reading, master the skill-lock picking.

Skill description: You can make and use a lock picking tool to open some locks. The success rate of picking locks is related to skill level and basic attributes (agility, perception). (This skill can be upgraded to Level 20, the skill level cannot exceed the player’s current level).
Skill book-basic planting.
Description: After reading, master the skill-basic planting.

Skill description: After learning the skill, you can farm and plant all kinds of plants. You can also perform other related operations, upgrading the skill level can make the crops mature faster (this skill can be upgraded to Level 20, the skill level cannot exceed the player’s current level).
Picking locks was a pretty good skill, mainly because it did not need to make a sound to destroy the door, and it could be used in certain special situations.
As for the basic planting, it was also a more casual life skill in the later stages...
In the real world, many game workers chose this skill. Farming for the big player guilds in the game was a pretty good part-time job.
“Let the zombie clones try farming? Isn’t that a bit of a waste?”
Fang Heng laughed at himself.
“Who cares! We’ll talk about it after we learn it!”
There was no upper limit to the number of skills that could be learned in the game. One day, when they could no longer survive, the farming skill could be used.

Fang Heng understood the principle that having more skills did not weigh him down. Taking advantage of the fact that he had more points, he directly bought two skill books and slapped them on his head.
[Hint: You have learned the skill-lock picking (Level 1); you have learned the skill-basic planting (Level 1).]
After settling all this, Fang Heng turned on the survival radio and contacted Liao Bufan to bring more than thirty large trucks from the shelter to move materials back.
The harvest this time was too abundant. Just moving materials would take a long time with more than thirty large trucks.
The shelter was not even big enough. When they went back, they had to divide several warehouses to store the materials and resources.
The apocalypse merchant, Vettel, saw Fang Heng’s income and was unusually envious.
He poured half a cup of Maotai into his mouth.
“Hey Fang Heng, if it’s not convenient to move it back, it’s okay to leave it with me.”
“No, no, no, that won’t do, Vettel.”
Fang Heng shook his head repeatedly and handed over a bag of drunkard peanuts to prevent Vettel from getting too drunk.
“These things are of great use to me.”

The harvest this time was too abundant.
Just moving materials would take a long time with more than thirty large trucks.
The shelter was not even big enough.
When they went back, they had to divide several warehouses to store the materials and resources.
The apocalypse merchant, Vettel, saw Fang Heng’s income and was unusually envious.
He poured half a cup of Maotai into his mouth.
“Hey Fang Heng, if it’s not convenient to move it back, it’s okay to leave it with me.”
“No, no, no, that won’t do, Vettel.”
Fang Heng shook his head repeatedly and handed over a bag of drunkard peanuts to prevent Vettel from getting too drunk.
“These things are of great use to me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 336 - Warp Backpack Slot
paragraphs: Prison Shelter, second basement.
After the large-scale space tearing device was expanded to Tier 3, it took up a larger area. It also needed to coordinate with the main control platform for positioning and control.
For this, it was moved to the newly built super-large research room.
The researchers in the shelter gathered together and discussed in private.
Qiu Yaokang crossed his arms, his eyes shining with unconcealable excitement.
Even the Dark Knights’ David and the Dark Knights’ research team were invited to witness this miracle.
Victor was in high spirits.
“Fang Heng, the space tearing device has been successfully relocated. There is only one step left to complete it. We only need to install three high energy evolution crystals!”
“This is a historic step in the history of human development. It is worth remembering. I believe that you should personally install it.”
“Okay.”
Fang Heng took the wrench from Victor’s hand and took out three high energy evolution crystals from his backpack.
He thought to himself that it was quite a ritual.
Walking to the large-scale space tearing device in the middle of the room, Fang Heng reached out and touched the device.
[Hint: The current space tearing device has been modified to 90%. The player can use high energy evolution crystals*3,150,000 survival points and 1000 King of Gods’ points to level up.]
“Yes, level up.”
Saying this, Fang Heng started to stuff the three high energy evolution crystals into the holes left by the space tearing device.
[Hint: You have completed the upgrade of the Tier 3 space tearing device. Your shelter’s level has been increased to Level 50.]

[Hint: Your researcher has received encouragement. He has received a special status-sincere cooperation (lasts for 5 days). All members’ loyalty has been increased. Some of the researcher’s experience points have been increased. Some of the researcher’s level has been increased.]
The spatial rift emitted a faint green light.
The entire hall was filled with the enthusiastic applause of the researchers.
Including Victor and Qiu Yaokang, almost all the researchers clenched their fists tightly and were excited.
Parallel universe teleportation!
They had witnessed the birth of history!
Fang Heng immediately opened his character’s attribute and clicked on the space tearing device’s attribute to check.
Item: Large-scale space tearing device.
Current level: Level 3.
Current level effect 1: Permanently shorten the location time of the branch tearing device.
Current level effect 2: Currently, large-scale space tearing device can be transported across a region (server)(maximum duration: 48 hours).
Fang Heng turned off the description and turned his head to ask, “Victor, can we teleport now?”
“Wait a moment, I still need to do some positioning to find a time anchor point that can teleport.”
Victor suppressed the excitement in his heart. He took a breath and returned to the main control computer to control it.
Soon, lines of information appeared on the main control screen.
“Found it.”
[Hint: You have obtained a time anchor point through the large-scale space tearing device.]
[Hint: You can try other ways to obtain more hidden time anchors.]
[Hint: You have obtained the time anchors of Servers 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7 of the Zombie Apocalypse. You can use the large-scale space tearing device to teleport.]
[Hint: Using the teleport function to teleport between servers, you will not cancel the server world that you are bound to. Each teleport will cost 1000 survival points.]

Victor continued to explain, “Fang Heng, it is different from the normal spatial rift that we are currently in. Currently, we cannot open a passage for a long time. We can only carry out a very limited amount of teleportation.”
“That is to say, it is limited to single-person teleportation.”
“In theory, you can stay in another parallel world at the anchor point for a maximum of 48 hours. After 48 hours, you will be forcefully pulled back due to the influence of the spatial strength.”
“If you want to stay longer, or if you want to send more people into the parallel world at the same time, then we still need to continue upgrading the teleportation device’s ability.”
“Also, after the teleportation, you cannot actively return to our world from the parallel world of the anchor point.”
“In theory, we can only wait until the 48 hours are over, or we can forcefully intervene through our side’s main control platform and directly pull you back to our world.”
Fang Heng tried to understand what Victor was saying.
He frowned and asked, “You can only send me there at one time? What about the item? So I can’t take the item with me? You can only send the item through the spatial rift for 48 hours?”
“No, that’s not the case. All items will not be affected by the 48 hours.”

Victor continued to explain, “However, in theory, you can only carry relatively small items. Try to grab some small items and bring them into the spatial rift. If you can’t hold a large item, it’s very likely that you’ll lose it in the spatial turbulence.”
“With the ability of the current Tier 3 space tearing device, we’re still unable to maintain the passage for a long time.”
“Perhaps after the next level up of the spatial rift, we can open a short-term item passage, allowing a series of items to pass through.”
Fang Heng nodded and a game hint flashed across the lower right corner of his retina.
[Hint: Without a special explanation, all items in the player’s backpack cannot be transported through the space tearing device.]
[Hint: Player has received a special reward-jump backpack slot*1.]

[Upgrade: You have received an additional warp backpack slot. The item placed in the warp backpack slot can be brought into or out of any game world/space-time at the same time by the player.] [After the large-scale space tearing device has been upgraded to Tier 4, you will receive an additional 2 warp backpack slots.]
[Hint: After entering another game world/space-time, you can still use the item in the warp backpack slot.]
[ [Hint: The cooldown time for a single warp backpack slot is 20 minutes.]
“Warp backpack slot...”
Fang Heng carefully read the hint and muttered to himself.
He understood now. If he wanted to bring more things to other worlds, he still had to continue upgrading the space tearing device...
This setting was like a game.
“Victor, can you level up the space tearing device to Tier 4?”
“Yes.”
Victor nodded and said, “The upgrade to Tier 4 space tearing device is a performance modification.”

“It’s not like the all-round modification from Tier 2 to Tier 3. Instead, we have to find a way to stimulate the full potential of the current device. So, we don’t really need rare ores and various special materials. We only need high energy evolution crystals.”
Another game hint appeared on Fang Heng’s retina.
[Hint: You have obtained information regarding the Tier 4 space tearing device.]

[Hint: After upgrading the large-scale space tearing device to Tier 4, you will receive an additional amount of teleportation. You will receive additional teleportation time. You will unlock the short-term teleportation passage (item passage) function. You will receive an additional 2 warp backpack slots.]
[Hint: Upgrading to Tier 4 space tearing device requires 500,000 survival points, 1500 King of Gods’ points and high energy evolution crystal*20.]

chapters.title: Chapter 337 - District 7
paragraphs: Fang Heng roughly looked at the requirements for Tier 4.
Fortunately, Tier 4 did not require any random rare metals or materials. Other than points, it only required 20 high energy evolution crystals.
What a headache!
He lacked King of Gods’ points and high energy evolution crystals!
Although he had previously exchanged points for a large amount of sulfuric acid and could think of ways to farm a wave of crystallized worms, 20 high energy evolution crystals were too much.
The amount of sulfuric acid was definitely not enough.
Sigh!
Fang Heng sighed silently in his heart.
Forget it!
He felt that he was not in a hurry to level up to Tier 4 now. He had to think of a way to complete the main storyline mission and obtain the ownership of the world first.
“Alright, can we set off now?”
Victor continued to turn his head and control the main console.

“The anchors have been successfully located. We can set off at any time. I think these anchors are very similar to the parallel world of our world. There is a high probability that there are first-generation meteorites in them.”
Good!
Fang Heng patted his cheek and braced himself.
First, he would focus on obtaining the first-generation meteorite. Then, he would slowly tinker with it and slowly spend time thinking of ways to modify and upgrade the spatial rift.
Then, the question came. which server should he start from?
Previously, Fang Heng had searched for some information offline.
Because it was related to the main storyline mission, he could not find any information on the internet.
As for Mo Jiawei, the North River Heavy Industry did not have much contact with the Zombie Apocalypse, so they could not find any valuable clues.
Fang Heng carefully recalled the memories of this body.
District 7 was the newest server apart from District 8, so he had a better understanding of that place.
Moreover, the ownership of the world of District 7 had not been determined yet.
In addition, according to the Federation, recently, the anti-federation forces had been causing a ruckus in the various old servers, but there had been no activity in District 7.
For safety reasons, it would be better to go to Server 7 to test the waters first.

Fang Heng thought for a moment, then nodded and said, “Head to the time anchor point No. 7 (28.33.37.21.82) to take a look. If I need to come back earlier, I’ll inform Mo Jiawei to relay the message to you.”
“Alright, confirm the time anchor point (28.33.37.21.82).”
Victor’s expression was serious. Together with the many researchers, he controlled the main console and tried to open the teleportation passage.
“Teleportation preparations, start constructing the time passage...”
Fang Heng walked to the teleportation passage to make final preparations.
He only had one warp backpack slot and could only carry one item with him.
“Which equipment should I bring...”
Fang Heng muttered softly and looked through his backpack.
After thinking for a while, Fang Heng took out a bottle of T-virus antidote and stuffed it into his backpack.
Right now, his body’s various attributes far surpassed that of an ordinary player. He wasn’t afraid of anything else, but he was most afraid of accidentally being infected by the zombie virus.
For safety reasons, Fang Heng controlled another 50 vine zombies and 20 Lickers to commit suicide on the spot.
“Passage opened successfully.”
The green passage’s door opened. Fang Heng nodded at everyone and strode into the passage.
[Hint: Player has entered Zombie Apocalypse District 7 through a special method.]
[Hint: Player can still share apocalyptic points and Dark Knights’ points in Zombie Apocalypse District 7, but do not inherit any friendship or Dark Knights’ merit points.]
A ray of light flashed.
Fang Heng realized that he had appeared on a small hill.
Hahaha! He really did it!
Fang Heng was filled with excitement.
Different from the transfer server of other players, that method will clear all points and equipment on the player, and even their levels and skills would be reduced!
The teleportation he was using now did not have any penalty restrictions!
Fang Heng took a deep breath to calm himself down.
After going around in circles and expending so much effort, he had finally returned to the original Server 7!
Finally, he could inherit the legacy that this body had accumulated in the game for more than half a year!
Fang Heng was not in a hurry. Instead, he opened his character’s attribute panel to confirm.
Other than a bottle of T-virus antidote in the warp backpack slot, all the items on his body had been emptied.
All his skills were still there, and his character’s attribute was no different from District 8.
The more troublesome thing was that Fang Heng couldn’t control the zombie clones in Server 8 to achieve remote control.
In this aspect, it was similar to when he was offline.
In the past, when he was offline, the zombie clones in District 8 would continue to carry out the command he received last time, faithfully carrying out the hack operation.
“It’s a bit troublesome.”
Fang Heng muttered softly.
This way, he wouldn’t be able to control the zombie clones to commit suicide remotely as well.
He wouldn’t be able to command it from a long-range even if it was in danger.
Shaking his head, Fang Heng continued to focus on what was in front of him.
This time, he came to District 7 only for the initial exploration, to think of a way to obtain information about the first-generation meteorite in District 7.
Fang Heng thought that it was better to keep a low profile as much as possible.
He already had a preliminary plan.
He would start with the Dark Knights!
From the main storyline mission in District 8, he learned that the first-generation meteorites were part of the main storyline mission. The main storyline mission was triggered by the Dark Knights.
Therefore, the Dark Knights would definitely know the location of the first-generation meteorites.
Then how would he find the Dark Knights?
Fang Heng scratched his head.
In short, he should return to the shelter and inherit the legacy of his previous owner.
Fang Heng remembered clearly that he had built a small shelter in Server 7.
The shelter was very small, only enough for him to live in, but it was better to be hidden and safe.
The previous owner of the body had also placed a lot of survival materials in the shelter, including all kinds of rare weapons.
Guns, knives, grenades, flashbangs and so on.
He was very lucky. The shelter was not far from here.
Opening the map, Fang Heng roughly identified the direction and walked toward the shelter in his memory.
Along the way, he gathered some materials. Fang Heng made a wooden gun and killed a few ordinary zombies.
Soon, Fang Heng came to the edge of a river.
Fang Heng walked along the edge of the river and quickly found an entrance covered by miscellaneous items.
He entered the entrance and walked along the narrow passage for a while. Then, a staircase appeared in front of him.
[Hint: Identity authentication successful. You have returned to your shelter.]
Apart from identity verification, he also needed to open the lock of the room.
Fang Heng tried to push the door open.
The iron door at the entrance was locked.
Fang Heng took out the barbed wire he picked up on the way.
[Hint: You have used a skill-lock picking. You are in the process of picking the lock...]
[[Hint: The current skill has failed.]
“Tch!”
Fang Heng cursed his bad luck and continued to lower his head to pick the lock.
He failed more than ten times in a row.
Just when Fang Heng’s patience was almost exhausted, there was a crisp click.
The door lock was unlocked.
Fang Heng pushed open the metal door.
When he opened the room, Fang Heng felt a familiar feeling that he had not felt in a long time.
This was the shelter that this body had spent one to two years in the game to build.
The location was very hidden, and no one knew about it except him!
“Fortunately, the things are still here.”
Looking around and seeing the room full of inheritance, Fang Heng felt a strange sense of security.

chapters.title: Chapter 338 - Camp
paragraphs: This way, it was much easier. He didn’t need to use the world to find food and find a safe house, saving a lot of trouble.
Fang Heng wandered around the shelter, casually taking some basic tools, a steel dagger, a few bullets, and a few flashbang bullets. He also put some food in his backpack.
After a short rest, Fang Heng set off again, heading to the nearest apocalypse merchant camp.
Unlike District 8, District 7 had been in service for a long time.
Most of the apocalypse merchant camps in the game had been monopolized by various large gaming companies or unions.
In the past, Fang Heng would sneak in whenever the players from the various large guilds were not paying attention.
Just like before, Fang Heng fumbled his way to the periphery of the apocalypse merchant camp, hiding in the bushes to observe.
There were still two players from the Dragon Country Game Company standing at the entrance of the apocalypse camp.
The Dragon Country Game Company was a medium-sized gaming company.
Fang Heng did not have any good impression of them.
He remembered that once, his shelter had been forcefully raided by them.
That time, Fang Heng’s months of hard work had gone down the drain.
The law of the jungle was very normal in the game, but when Fang Heng thought about it, he instinctively felt a little displeased.
Players from the Dragon Country Game Company were currently transporting materials to obtain the mission.
A small truck stopped at the entrance of the camp.
Eh?
There was a small truck?
District 7 seemed to be quite rich. Even normal medium-sized guilds could use a small truck every day...
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes slightly and took out a rag from his backpack. He made it into a face towel and put it on his face as he strode forward.
Two players from the Dragon Country Company did not realize that danger was approaching. They were standing in front of the apocalypse camp and casually chatting and laughing.
One of the players saw a player approaching from afar and felt that it was strange, so he shouted at Fang Heng.
“You! Stop! What are you doing here! This is Dragon Country’s game territory! If you know what’s good for you, get lost!”
Fang Heng continued to approach the two of them unhurriedly.
“Are you deaf? I f*cking told you to stop!”
Chen Hu realized that something was not right. He pulled out the pistol in his hand and pointed it at Fang Heng. “This is the last warning. Don’t come any closer! Otherwise, I’ll shoot!”
Fang Heng stopped in his tracks. He raised his hands high to show that he had no ill intentions.
“I know! I’m a player of Crimson Technology! I have no ill intentions!”
Crimson Technology?
Chen Hu and Ye Jun looked at each other and felt that it was very strange.
Since when did Crimson Technology develop in the vicinity?
They had never heard of it!
Crimson Technology was a large gaming company. Chen Hu was a little hesitant and did not dare to offend them.
“Take the mask off your face!”
Fang Heng raised his hands and pretended not to hear him, continuing to approach.
“What did you say? Oh right! A large group of zombies are coming this way! I’m here to warn you.”
While the two of them were suspicious, Fang Heng took a few more steps forward.
“Hey! I told you not to move!”
However, it was already too late. Fang Heng’s hidden flashbang suddenly slid down.
“Buzz — !”
Along with the ear-piercing sound wave, a dazzling light bloomed.
Chen Hu and Ye Jun could not help but lower their heads to avoid the light.
“Swoosh!”
A sound of air being torn rang in their ears.
Opening his eyes again, Chen Hu saw a flash of blade light in front of his eyes.
“Chi!”
In the next second, a red bloody scar appeared on Chen Hu’s neck.
[Hint: You have dealt critical damage to the player and killed the enemy player. Your skill-guillotine experience points +3.]
Skill! Bullet time!
Under the buff of the skill bullet time, Chen Hu and Ye Jun’s movements seemed to have slowed down by more than ten times in Fang Heng’s eyes!
“Chi!”
The steel dagger waved in the air again, drawing a white light and cutting Ye Jun’s throat.
After exiting bullet time, Fang Heng swept his gaze over the two corpses, put away the dagger and walked to the front of the truck.

[Hint: Detected that you have a special skill. Current truck damage: 3% (can be repaired, the truck is in good condition and can run). It doesn’t belong to you, but you can use the lock-picking skill to gain control of the truck. You can dismantle the truck.]
“Hey! Chen Hu! Ye Jun! The two of you, come and help!”
Fang Heng heard the shouts from inside the apocalypse camp.
He immediately activated his skill to conceal his aura and hid to the side.
“F*ck! Where are those two idiots?”
“They only know how to slack off, Ye Jun! Ye Jun!”
The two players were cursing and swearing as they each laboriously carried a box of materials out of the apocalypse camp.
Fang Heng silently appeared behind one of them.
“Chi!”
Skill! Bullet time!
The flow of time in the surroundings instantly slowed down.
Fang Heng brandished his dagger and once again slashed across the necks of the two players at an extremely fast speed.
“Easy.”
Under normal circumstances, the ordinary player would not be able to pose a threat to him.
Fang Heng was too lazy to waste time, so it was most convenient for him to directly act.
Moreover, they already had a grudge to begin with.
Fang Heng took off his face cloth, wiped the dagger that was stained with blood and strode into the apocalypse merchant camp.
“What a rare guest, Fang Heng. I haven’t seen you for a long time. I thought you had already gone somewhere else.”
The boss of the apocalypse camp was called Hawk. He had some impression of Fang Heng.
“How have you been recently? I can smell the blood on your body.”
Fang Heng placed a bag of drunkard peanuts on the counter and pushed it towards Hawk.
He could see that most of the apocalypse merchants liked to drink.
“Hawk, I need your help. I want to get the contact information of the Dark Knights.”
Hawk took the drunkard peanuts, tore open the packaging and examined Fang Heng from top to bottom.
“That won’t be easy. Fang Heng, the Dark Knights aren’t willing to meet some ordinary people. You know what I mean.”
“I know you have a way. I have something very important to find them, and I’m in a hurry.”
“The rules aren’t like that, Fang Heng. It’s not that easy to join the Dark Knights...”
“Tell them that I come from another parallel world.” Fang Heng looked at Hawk. “I came through the Tier 3 space tearing device for the first-generation meteorite.”
“I don’t really know.”
Hawk shrugged and poured a few drunkard peanuts into his mouth, indicating that he was powerless.
“Help me pass this message to them. They will meet me.”
“Okay, I can help you pass this message. It’s a total of 30,000 survival points. What do you think?”
“Deal.”
[Hint: You have deducted 30,000 survival points.]
Hawk was shocked. He did not expect Fang Heng to take out 30,000 survival points so easily. He did not even blink.
“It seems that you have earned a lot recently.”
Hawk put away the surprise on his face and nodded seriously. “I will take the points, but I cannot guarantee that the Dark Knights will be willing to meet you.”
“Come back to my place at dusk today. If they are willing to meet you, they will appear.”
“Thank you.”
Fang Heng checked the list of exchangeable items in Hawk’s shop.
It was almost empty.
All the valuable materials had been exchanged.
This was the old district. Resources had been allocated by the big guilds.
Fang Heng did not feel disappointed. He shook his head and left the apocalypse merchant camp.
Fang Heng turned on the truck and returned to the shelter.

chapters.title: Chapter 339 - Accompany Reading
paragraphs: When he returned to the shelter, he saw that there was still some time left. Fang Heng left a simple bed and went offline.
After exiting the game, Fang Heng continued to think.
It would be best if he could find the first-generation meteorite in District 7. If he still couldn’t find it, then he would be in trouble.
Should he ask Chen Yu about the situation?
The Federation undoubtedly knew the situation of the other servers the best. They had a high probability of knowing the situation of the first-generation meteorite.
However, Fang Heng also had some concerns.
He didn’t want too many people to know that he had successfully established the Tier 3 space tearing device.
This included the Federation.
Asking too many questions might arouse the suspicion of the Federation.
Let’s think about it again...
Fang Heng opened the game cabin and crawled out.
Just as he was about to move his body, his eyelids suddenly twitched.
“Eh?”
What’s going on?
Fang Heng’s heart pounded wildly.
He stretched out his hand and looked at the back of his right hand.
The mark on the back of his hand was faintly discernible.
A line of small words immediately appeared in his vision.
[Hint: Player has unlocked the warp backpack slot*1.]
What was going on!
Through the mark on his right hand, Fang Heng found that he could see the backpack in the game!
There was nothing in the backpack except for a slot!
A bottle of T-virus antidote was lying quietly in that slot.
“The warp backpack slot can be used in this world as well?”
Fang Heng was very surprised.
He took a deep breath and tried to give the order to take out the item.
With a slight twist of his wrist, the T-virus antidote appeared in his hand.
The item in the game had been brought into the real world!?
Or in this way?
Fang Heng sat down on the ground and tried to control his somewhat chaotic mind to continue thinking.
That’s right, this should be one of the settings of the game.
Mo Yunxiao had said before that the item in the game could be brought out of the game!
Recently, he had been reading the Occult Guide, which was originally a product of the game!
So... perhaps the Occult Guide itself was brought out of the game through the way of the warp backpack slot?
Eh?
Wait!
Fang Heng was suddenly startled and had a flash of inspiration.
Since the in-game item could be brought out of the game through the warp backpack slot, then the same principle could be applied...
The slot could also bring the item back into the game?
Yes! That’s right!
Weapons? Materials?
Fang Heng’s heart raced wildly. His eyes quickly searched the room, looking for an item that could be brought into the game.
Phone!
Fang Heng picked up the phone on the table and tried to put it into the backpack slot.
[Hint: This item can be stored in the backpack slot. Please try to store this item again after the cooldown time of the backpack slot has ended.]
[Hint: Some items may be damaged after warping.]
Damaged?
Fang Heng frowned as he thought about the meaning behind these two hint messages.
Not all items could be directly put into the backpack.
Even if it could be put into the backpack, there was a possibility that it would be damaged due to the special restrictions of the game.
In addition, the warp backpack had a 20-minute cooldown time after each use.
Mobile phones were probably not usable after being brought into the Zombie Apocalypse, so there was no need to test them.
Fang Heng put down his phone and looked around the guest room.
Calligraphy, painting, remote control, wooden decorations, thermos bottles...
Fang Heng tried to put the items in the room into his backpack one by one, then rushed to the yard to try out a bigger stone.
After the initial test, Fang Heng had a rough idea.
Large electrical appliances such as televisions could not be stuffed directly into the backpack.
Other smaller items, or a single item, such as a bucket of water, a large stone, or a cell phone, could mostly be put into the backpack slot.
Fang Heng lowered his head and began to think.
He was thinking about how he could use this slot to make a fortune in the game.
There didn’t seem to be anything in the real world that could be brought back to the game world.

More useful items, such as weapons or precious materials, were strictly controlled in the Eastern region of the Federation where he was from. It was very difficult for ordinary people to obtain large amounts of them.
“I’m such an idiot!”
Fang Heng suddenly slapped his forehead.
Who would want materials and weapons!
Wasn’t there an item in front of him that was most suitable to be brought into the game!
Fang Heng went straight to the study room in the back garden and barged into the study room under the surprised gaze of the villa’s assistant.
‘Occult Guide’!
This was it!
Fang Heng took the book on the low table in his hand.
[Hint: You have obtained the book-Occult Guide (Current reading progress: 18.82%).]
During this period, Fang Heng spent a lot of effort on reading almost every day.
The process of reading was particularly uncomfortable, like being in prison.
Even so, his reading progress was only less than 20% despite his daily efforts in prison!
If he could bring the book into the game...
There was a large zombie team in the game that could help him read!
Fang Heng was excited.
He tried to put the book into his backpack.
With a thought, the imprint on the back of his hand immediately showed a weak light.
In the next moment, the light flashed, and the book disappeared from Fang Heng’s hand.
It was done!
The Occult Guide was lying quietly in the slot of the game backpack.
Turning around, Fang Heng hurried to the guest room, opened the game cabin and entered the game.
Seven hours later.
In the game shelter, the zombie clone that had just been reborn wobbled over under Fang Heng’s control.
It took the Occult Guide from Fang Heng.
Fang Heng immediately gave it the command to use the skill ‘efficient reading’.
The zombie clone picked up the book and began to read it seriously.
A minute later, a game hint flashed across Fang Heng’s retina.
[Hint: Your zombie has read. Your reading progress has increased by 0.1%.]
Hahahaha!
It has increased! It has increased!
Even though his reading progress had only increased by 0.1%, Fang Heng was still extremely excited!
He finally found the feeling of hacking!
So the large-scale space tearing device had such a powerful hidden effect!
During this time, other than meditating, he was also reading books when he was offline.
He was already tortured by reading books.
He finally found a cheat!
In this way, he could have a zombie clone read books 24 hours a day in the game to increase his reading progress.
It was that simple to become a top student!
The only pity was that there was only one book, the Occult Guide, so he couldn’t have multiple zombies read it together.
Otherwise, the progress would be faster.
Fang Heng continued to ponder.
He had to bear with it for now. After he finished reading the book and mastered the skills related to the occult, he would take some time to bring in a few more books from outside.
At that time, he could read one book per zombie, which would greatly increase his reading efficiency!
Seeing that it was almost dusk, Fang Heng left his zombie clone in the shelter to read and brought the Lickers back to the apocalypse merchant camp.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - The Scavenger Army
paragraphs: Dusk.
In the bushes, several players from the Dragon Country Guild were trying to search for the traces left behind by Fang Heng.
Captain Han Bo reminded them, “Everyone, be careful! The president said that that person might come back again!”
“The other party is very strong and has some powerful close combat skills. You must be careful!”
“Work in groups of three. Don’t get too far apart. If you encounter any dangerous characters, shoot them!”
“Understood, Captain!”
After learning that four of their players had been attacked and killed by an unknown source, the Dragon Country Game Company immediately sent people to search the nearby area.
After asking in detail about the players who were killed, the Dragon Country Game Company first suspected Crimson Technology.
However, they quickly ruled it out.
Crimson Technology had recently gotten into quite a lot of trouble in Server 8. Now that they could no longer protect themselves, the probability of them coming over to cause trouble was very small.
“Who? Who’s there!”
While searching, Han Bo was alert and noticed something.
He stopped and raised his guns to aim at the bushes.
“Chi Chi Chi!”
Squinting his eyes, he looked over.
Suddenly, several red shadows flashed through the forest!
“Not good! It’s the Lickers!”
Seeing the appearance of the red shadows clearly, Han Bo was shocked!
The group of Lickers quickly flew towards him.
Han Bo hurriedly raised his submachine gun and aimed at the charging Lickers and pulled the trigger.
“Bang Bang! Bang Bang Bang Bang!”
The sound of gunshots rang out!
When the other players heard Han Bo’s shout, they also raised their guns and fired at the front.
The average character level of the player team led by Han Bo was around Level 7. They had not reached the basic attribute of fully controlling the submachine gun.
Coupled with nervousness, their aims with the submachine guns were bad.
Han Bo quickly emptied a magazine, but less than one-tenth of the bullets hit the Lickers accurately.
The Lickers braved the barrage of bullets and instantly rushed in front of Han Bo!
“Whoosh!!”
The sharp claws slashed in front of his eyes, leaving a piercing sound.
What?!
Han Bo’s eyes reflected an indescribable fear!
Why were guns ineffective against the Lickers?!
At the moment of death, Han Bo’s mind went blank.
This was definitely not an ordinary Licker!
He really could not understand why the strength of the Licker was so much stronger than he had expected. Even the bullets from the submachine gun could not stop them!
Dozens of Lickers rushed into the player team, waving their sharp claws and killing crazily.
The gunshots stopped, and a faint sizzling sound came from the forest.
The Lickers lay on the ground, eating the players’ corpses.
Ever since they had learned the talent of vampires, the Lickers had developed the ‘bad habit’ of gnawing on the corpse’s blood.
They devoured the blood to increase their HP’s recovery speed.
Fang Heng walked out from the side, his gaze sweeping over the players from the Dragon Country Guild on the ground.
On the sentry tower on the second floor of the apocalypse merchant camp, seeing Fang Heng, Ai Lei slowly put down the sniper rifle in his hand.
His eyes revealed a hint of surprise.
A human who could control a Licker?
How did he do it?
Could it be that the information he said about the parallel world was true?
Fang Heng frowned. His sharp perception told him that someone was watching him in the dark.
He suddenly raised his head. His gaze pierced through the layers of obstacles and looked toward Ai Lei’s position.
“Such strong intuition.”
Ai Lei noticed that Fang Heng had discovered him, and his heart skipped a beat.
He put away the sniper rifle in his hand, and raised his right hand towards Fang Heng.
Fang Heng nodded at Ai Lei, and stepped into the apocalypse merchant camp.
“Fang Heng, I am a member of the Dark Knights, Ai Lei.”
Ai Lei was very young. He wore a pair of black-rimmed glasses, and he held a toothpick in his mouth. He looked very casual and undependable.
“I’m very interested in the parallel world theory you mentioned. Why don’t you tell me again? This one is on me!”
As Ai Lei spoke, he pushed a glass of fruit juice towards Fang Heng.
Fang Heng did not touch the fruit juice and roughly described the trouble he had encountered in District 8.
“Simply put, the first-generation meteorite in our parallel world was damaged. I want to find the first-generation meteorite here.”
Hearing Fang Heng’s words, Ai Lei showed an interested expression.
“It’s an interesting story, Fang Heng. But unfortunately, I can’t do anything about it.”
“Why?”
“Because there’s something wrong with the first-generation meteorite in our world.”

Ai Lei spread his hands and explained, “A few years ago, we already realized that the first-generation meteorite might be related to the outbreak of the zombie virus, so we tried to find the first-generation meteorite.”
“At first, we did get the first-generation meteorite successfully, but unfortunately, due to an accident, there was some trouble with the first-generation meteorite.”
“What trouble?”
“It’s a secret.”
Ai Lei winked at Fang Heng and said, “I don’t trust you very much. What if you deceived me? I’m a professional, so I won’t reveal secrets related to the Dark Knights to the public.”
Fang Heng was surprised and looked at Ai Lei. “Then why did you come to see me?”
“After all, I happened to be passing by, so I thought I’d come to listen to your bragging. It’s like casual talk after dinner, you know what I mean?”
Ai Lei didn’t feel embarrassed at all.

Fang Heng said in a deep voice, “My space tearing device is from your Dark Knights. You can verify this with the Dark Knights to determine if the space tearing device has the ability to teleport to a parallel world.”

“I’ll ask around when I go back, but I can’t guarantee that everything you said is true. What if you plan to do something bad in your parallel world? There are too many swindlers these days. I have to be more careful.”
“I don’t have time to stay here for too long. How do you want me to prove my identity?”
“Hmm...” Ai Lei stroked his chin. “From what you said, you’re also a member of the Dark Knights in your server and have reached the rank of Colonel?”
“Yes.”
Fang Heng nodded.
“So you are very powerful?”
Ai Lei also had a lot of question marks in his head. He asked a series of questions.

“I saw what you did outside just now. Where did you get your ability to control the Lickers? Did you get it through the special plan of our Dark Knights? Or from the Meteorite Company? In your parallel world, to what extent can the Dark Knights control zombies?”
“It’s a secret.” Fang Heng looked at Ai Lei. “If you want to know the answer, you can exchange it with the information about the first-generation meteorite.”
Ai Lei was stunned for a moment, then he burst into laughter.
“Hahahaha, Fang Heng, I suddenly have a good idea.”
“You’ve heard of the Scavenger Army, right? Those guys who only want chaos.”
“Yeah, I know a little.”
Fang Heng had a deep impression of the Scavenger Army.
It was a villainous NPC organization that appeared in the middle of the Zombie Apocalypse game.
