chapters.title: Chapter 341 - Divine Potion
paragraphs: The Scavenger Army appeared very suddenly.
Under the guidance of the organization’s leader, the Scavenger Army began to occupy the dilapidated cities and towns, attacking the player’s shelter and other NPC camps for no reason.
They burned, killed, looted and focused on destruction. They believed in the concept of being above powerlessness.
In addition, the Scavenger Army also had a special ability. Most of their bodies had undergone a special mutation and had evolved. Most of them had powerful close combat abilities.
There were also rumours that they were immune to the threat of the zombie virus.
The Scavenger Army even recruited players.
It was also worth noting that for some reason, the Federation had issued a ban, banning all players from joining the Scavenger Army. If they were found out, they would be punished by law.
This was especially strange. The bill had once caused a heated discussion around the world.
Killing people in the game was not against the law. On the contrary, joining a game organization would be against the law.
Fang Heng had previously heard that there were players who had secretly joined the Scavenger Army. After that, they were wanted by the Federation.
“In the parallel world that I’m in, the Scavenger Army has never appeared. Why?”
The corner of Ai Lei’s mouth twitched. He whispered, “Perhaps they will never appear.”
Fang Heng frowned. “What do you mean?”
“Nothing. Our Dark Knights have always wanted to send someone to scout the Scavenger Army. What do you think? Are you interested?”
“Why me?”
“They have the internal information of our Dark Knights. Our people can’t get in, so we have to hire new people.”

“And that group of people’s recruitment criteria is very barbaric. I need some ruthless people who can kill without blinking an eye.” Ai Lei looked at Fang Heng with a satisfied expression. “Well, just like you.”
“Hehe.” Fang Heng chuckled. “Then you’ve found the right person. What’s the goal of the mission?”

“I want you to sneak into the Scavenger Army and help me get something called the divine potion from them. Give it to me, and in exchange, I’ll tell you everything about the first-generation meteorite.”

“You have to think carefully. This mission is very difficult. If you are not careful, you will lose your life. The whereabouts of the two people I sent previously are unknown. The situation is not good.”
[Hint: You have obtained a special mission-divine potion.]
Mission name: Divine potion.

Mission description: You have learned from Ai Lei that the Scavenger Army is recruiting new members recently. Please try to join the Scavenger Army, obtain the divine potion and bring it back to Ai Lei.
Mission reward: First-generation meteorite related information, survival points.
Fang Heng quickly skimmed through the mission hint.
“Deal.”
“Cool! Fang Heng, I’m starting to like you. The Scavenger Army is now located 20 kilometres away from here in Edge Creek Town. I wish you good luck!”
“I won’t take long. I’ll be back soon.”
Fang Heng felt that this mission was not difficult.
Join the Scavenger Army, get the divine potion and get the first-generation meteorite.
If he was fast, he could complete the mission line and return to District 8 within 36 hours.
Leaving the apocalypse merchant camp, Fang Heng directly drove the white pickup truck to the town occupied by the Scavenger Army.
At night, a pickup truck drove into Edge Creek Town.
As soon as they entered the town, several searchlights shone on the truck.
A few survivors of the Scavenger Army surrounded the truck with weapons in their hands and blocked the front of the truck.
They all looked fierce.
“D*mn it! Come out now!”
A young man who looked like a gangster, who reeked of alcohol, walked to the side of the truck with a bottle in his hand and slapped the window hard.
Fang Heng opened the car door and walked out.
“Don’t dawdle!”
A fierce look flashed across the hooligan’s eyes. He lifted the bottle and wanted to hit Fang Heng.
“Hu!”
However, the next second, he realized that his wrist was tightly grabbed by Fang Heng.
Then, an unprecedented pain came from his lower abdomen!
“Bang!”
The hooligan was sent flying by Fang Heng’s kick. He clutched his lower abdomen and struggled to stand up. He trembled and could not speak.
Fang Heng was slightly surprised.
The strength of this kick was extremely strong. With just one kick, that hooligan could stand up so quickly?
“Kid, where did you come from?”
The one who spoke was a bald man. There was a dragon tattoo on the left side of his head. His exposed skin revealed a hint of green.
“I’m Fang Heng. I heard that your Scavenger Army needs manpower.” Fang Heng stood where he was and looked around at the players. “I’ll be straightforward. I admire your philosophy. I want to join.”
“You want to join?”
Bald Roche turned to look at the truck behind Fang Heng and chuckled. “Interesting. Did you come alone? You have some guts.”
“I’m the only one who wants to join. Naturally, I’ll come alone.”
“Hahahaha, good! I admire your confidence! But you have to prove that you’re different from the trash outside.”
“What do you mean?”
“When you came, you should have noticed the nearby shelter, right? I think those people are an eyesore. Go there and make some random destruction to prove your strength.”
“Remember, come back before dawn. You only have one chance.”
[Hint: You have triggered a special mission-Scavenger Army.]
Mission name: Scavenger Army.
Mission description: Pass Roche’s test and obtain the recognition of the Scavenger Army.

Mission requirements: Obtain 500 reputation points of the Scavenger Army (killing survivors, destroying things, looting survivors’ materials and other acts can obtain the Scavenger Army honor points).
“As expected of the villain force, the missions are all so villainous.”
Fang Heng muttered in his heart.
Was this the reason why the Federation issued a ban on players joining the Scavenger Army?
“I’ll be back soon.”
Fang Heng said as he returned to the driver’s seat.
He already had some plans in his heart.
The Dragon Country Game Guild.
It’s you, guys!
Fang Heng opened the map and randomly found a nearby shelter belonging to the Dragon Country Game Guild. He drove the truck quickly.
“What? The entire team was wiped out?!”
“Is it still the same attacker from before?”
“It’s not him. It’s a group attack by the Lickers.”
The president of the Dragon Country Game Guild, Niu Xia, hung up the phone.
He felt more and more uneasy.
Was it done by an enemy company?
Was it Crimson Technology? Or was it a mercenary group that was hired?
It didn’t seem like it.
Such a way of doing things was too weird.
“Spread the word. From now on, cancel all non-essential activities in the game and reduce the range of activities. Temporarily abandon the apocalypse merchant camp and don’t go any closer.”
After thinking for a short while, Niu Xia immediately gave the order. “Also, issue another announcement. Send out the news that we have received an unknown group of high-intensity Lickers.”
“Okay, president, I will do it right away.”
The subordinate nodded. Just as he turned around to leave, he hesitated again.

chapters.title: Chapter 342 - Join the Gang
paragraphs: Niu Xia saw the other party’s hesitation and asked, “Is there anything else?”
“President, do you think it’s Fang Heng?”
Fang Heng?
This name made a few high-level players in the office think of something, and they couldn’t help but shiver.
Recently, District 8’s Fang Heng’s Prison Army had become too popular.
The continuous popularity had also made their District 7 hear about it.
Fang Heng’s background had been completely exposed on the forums.
This included his dark history when he was a professional player, and the matter of him being cleaned up by the Dragon Country Guild in Server 7.
Only then did president Niu Xia and the guild’s high-level players realize that they had dealt with Fang Heng in the past.
On the surface, Niu Xia didn’t say it, but in his heart, he was very regretful.
A nobody. Who would have thought that he would turn the tables so quickly? In an instant, he had become a popular character in the game.
He could not afford to provoke him!
If he had known, he would not have offended him no matter what he said.
“President, Fang Heng can control Lickers to fight in Server 8. This time, we were also attacked by Lickers. Do you think he had come to Server 7 to seek revenge on us...”
“Don’t think too much. He has developed so well in Server 8. Why would he come back to Server 7?”

President Niu Xia shook his head and said, “Go and check if there is any movement from the opposing legions. Also, report what happened today to the Federation. Say that they suspect that it is related to the anti-federation forces and use the Federation’s strength to investigate.”

“Yes! There’s one more thing, president. Recently, the Scavenger Army has been acting aggressively. A few large guilds that have developed nearby have sent us an invitation to cooperate. They have invited you to participate in tomorrow’s video conference to discuss how to deal with the Scavenger Army. How should we reply?”
“Promise them that I will attend on time.”
“President! This is bad!”
A player hurriedly pushed open the door and entered.
Niu Xia’s heart sank. “Speak!”
“President, our Warehouse No. 7 in the game was burned down, and our shelter was destroyed.”
“What’s going on!”
“It’s a zombie team. Warehouse No. 7 was ambushed by a zombie team... that group of Lickers is unstoppable...”
“Hahaha, well done! Well done! You didn’t disappoint me!”
Bald Roche was very satisfied with Fang Heng’s performance.
“Do you see that man over there? He’s Yatu. He’s in charge of the logistics of our Scavenger Army. If you want to change your equipment, go find him.”
“Recently, Boss asked us to clean up the area around Edge Creek Town. This town is our temporary stronghold. You can find a place to stay. I’ll inform you when we move out.”
“In addition, if you are interested, I have a lot of individual missions to release to the public.”
Roche briefly introduced the current situation of the Scavenger Army, then left Fang Heng to the side and continued to drink with the survivors of the Scavenger Army.
A series of hints quickly flashed in front of Fang Heng.
[Hint: You have joined the Scavenger Army.]
[Hint: You have become a low-level member of the Scavenger Army. Due to your outstanding performance, you have gained an additional 1500 Scavenger Army reputation points.]
[Hint: Increase your member level. You can receive higher-level missions and exchange them for higher-level item from the Scavenger Army.]
Fang Heng looked around the square.
The burning bonfire lit up the entire town square. Many NPC survivors gathered in twos and threes to chat and drink.
Fang Heng felt even more strange.
It was already early in the morning, but these survivors had no intention of sleeping or resting. They were all excited.
Fang Heng shook his head and walked to the middle-aged NPC named Yatu in the corner.
Yatu was different from the group of revelers. He looked very calm. He had always been sitting in the corner, with two burning metal barrels beside him.
“Newcomer, I like your mask.”
“Thank you.”
“Everyone is talking about you. I heard that you destroyed a survivor camp’s warehouse by yourself? I can only say that you did a good job. You might be very suitable for this place.”
“Maybe. I want to see what I can exchange for here.”
“It’s all here. You can choose whatever you want. Also, this is your reward.”
Yatu handed Fang Heng a steel dagger and showed Fang Heng the exchange list.
Fang Heng immediately opened the list to check.
The items on the list were all relatively ordinary food and weapons.
Fang Heng flipped through the list and lost interest.
“I heard that there’s a potion here that can strengthen one’s physique?”
“Heh, I guessed it long ago. You really came for that thing.”
“You have it?”
“That’s something only core members can have. You’re not qualified to exchange for it.”
Yatu raised his hand and pointed at Roche, who was celebrating in the middle of the square.
“Go find him. He still has a lot of missions that he’s looking for someone to handle. When you gather enough reputation and get promoted, you can naturally exchange for the divine potion from me.”
Fang Heng suddenly realized something. He turned his head and looked at the excited survivors of the Scavenger Army in the square.
“What effect does the divine potion have?”
“Hahaha, haven’t you already seen it with your own eyes?” Yatu laughed. “They have all taken the potion. Once you anger them, they can just wring your head off with their hands.”
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes and thought of the hooligans he had kicked previously.
If it was an ordinary person, this kick could make him lie on the ground for an entire day.
Fang Heng judged that the divine potion should be able to improve the player’s physique and strength, but it most likely also had some negative effects.
The Scavenger Army was in high spirits in the middle of the night. Under their exposed skin, there was a hint of deathly green.
No matter how one looked at it, it didn’t feel right.
“What about you? Why didn’t you use the divine potion? You should have met the requirements long ago, right?”
“Hehe, this thing has a bit of a negative effect. They will make ‘this’ uncontrollable.”
Yatu pointed at his own head.

“Your emotions will be released and difficult to control. I don’t want to become like that, unless one day I’m really infected with the zombie virus and am about to die. This potion can improve the body’s resistance, even against the zombie virus. Do you understand what I mean?”
“I understand. Thank you, Yatu.”
Fang Heng nodded.

There was still very little information about the divine potion. In short, it was better to complete the mission quickly along with the mission line. After becoming an elite member, one could obtain the divine potion.
If possible, he had to exchange more. He had to think of a way to bring it back to the shelter and let Qiu Yaokang study it. He might even be able to develop a potion with no negative effects.
Fang Heng stood up.
He was about to go talk to Roche when he suddenly realized that someone was secretly watching him.
Fang Heng suddenly turned his head and looked at the other corner of the square.
A girl with delicate features quickly looked away from Fang Heng.

chapters.title: Chapter 343 - Untitled
paragraphs: She sat alone on a wooden chair, pretending that nothing had happened.
Fang Heng knew very well that she was secretly watching him!
This was the effect of his high perception attribute.
Fang Heng walked straight toward her.
“You’re a player too?”
Cheng Ya didn’t expect Fang Heng to come up to her. She knew that she had been discovered, so she could only look at Fang Heng. “You’d better leave this place immediately. It’s very dangerous here.”
“Oh? Since it’s very dangerous, why did you stay here?”
“The divine potion is very dangerous.”
Cheng Ya turned her head away as she spoke, no longer paying attention to Fang Heng.
She had seen a lot of people get lost in the strength brought by the divine potion and had tragic ends.
She felt that Fang Heng was the same as those people.

“Is that so? I want to try. You seem to know a lot about this place? Shall we form a team?” Fang Heng leaned over and whispered into Cheng Ya’s ear. “I’m quite strong. Do you want to make money together?”
Cheng Ya had never been so close to a member of the opposite sex before. She was shocked and shrank back. She frowned and said, “I don’t know you.”
“So cold? Forget it.”
Fang Heng stood up and walked toward Roche in the crowd.
“Hi, Roche. I want to accept the mission.”
“Haha! Fang Heng, I admire your enthusiasm! We just won a battle and got a lot of good things, but this is far from enough.”
“We plan to start clearing out the surrounding shelters from tomorrow. Before that, we still need some preparation work, and we are short of manpower.”
“The missions are all here. You can pick anyone you want. Just tell me, and I will help you!”
Roche was in high spirits and his voice was very loud.
Fang Heng opened the mission list and saw more than ten pages of missions.
There were many kinds of missions, including collecting, scouting, sourcing for materials and so on.
Probably because of the Federation’s ban and the high-difficulty pre-missions, the number of players who joined the Scavenger Army was very few, and the competition was also very low.
In that case, taking the efficiency of completing the mission into consideration...
Fang Heng quickly looked for the most suitable mission in each mission panel.
Soon, his gaze focused on one of the missions.
Collecting weapons!
This was the fastest!
For missions of the same level, collecting weapons gave the highest reward points!
“I choose this mission, Roche.”
“Hahaha! Good! We are currently lacking a large number of weapons. Can you get us some back? The more the better! Buddy!”
Roche was excited. He reached out and patted Fang Heng’s shoulder, his voice shaking the sky.
“I know you can do it! We will wait for you to come back! Come on, buddy!”
[Hint: You have received mission-acquire weapons.]
Mission name: Acquire weapons.

Mission description: Weapons are needed for burning, killing and looting. The recent bloody battle had consumed a large number of weapons from the Scavenger Army. To prepare for the new battle, the Scavenger Army need to replenish a large number of weapons.
Mission requirements: Obtain weapons and submit them to the Scavenger Arm (Points will be calculated according to the number and quality of weapons submitted by the player).
Roche’s loud voice attracted the attention of many people.
“Go for it, buddy!”
Many people raised the beer bottles in their hands and signalled Fang Heng to go for it.
Fang Heng realized that these people’s emotions had always been in an extremely high state.
It was very abnormal.
This kind of abnormality was most likely related to the divine potion.
Fang Heng secretly suppressed the doubts in his heart and focused on the current mission.
If he wanted to obtain weapons, the fastest way was of course to directly snatch them.
Fang Heng’s first reaction was the Dragon Country Game Guilds.
They were quite good and had always been very helpful in the mission.
The corner of Fang Heng’s mouth twitched slightly.
Cheng Ya heard that Fang Heng had accepted the mission to collect weapons. She looked in the direction where Fang Heng had left and frowned.
Early in the morning, outside the shelter of the Dragon Country Guild.
Fang Heng revealed himself under a pine tree.
“It’s already been attacked twice during the day. Why is the shelter’s defense still so weak?”
Looking at the slightly weak shelter in front of him, Fang Heng could not help but mutter to himself.
“Then don’t blame me.”
Fang Heng laughed coldly in his heart and waved his hand in the direction of the shelter.
Behind him, the zombie team hidden in the shadows revealed themselves and approached the swaying shelter.
Soon, the Dragon Country Guild player on the sentry tower noticed the zombies gathering in the periphery.
“Attention! There are zombies!”
Sporadic gunshots broke the silence of the night.
“So many!?”
“Why aren’t they hit? Why are these zombies so hard?”
The player guards from the Dgraon Country Guild on the sentry tower were all very nervous.
This group of zombies was too strange!
All the bullets from the pistol were emptied, but not a single zombie fell?
Not long ago, the shelter had just received news from the headquarters that the Dragon Country Guild had been attacked by an unknown source, so they had to stay alert.

The supervisor of the shelter, Qi Yu, had already made preparations. He had sent people to reinforce the defense line at the periphery of the shelter, and he had even sent an emergency team to stay on duty at night.
But all of this was useless!
Guns and bullets rained down on the zombie team, but the damage they could do was minimal.
In the blink of an eye, the zombie team had already approached the periphery of the shelter and started attacking the outermost defense building.
“No, Boss, we can’t hold on like this!”
“Boss Qi!”
The commander of the shelter, Qi Yu, didn’t answer for a long time. He just looked at the forest not far away.
His forehead was covered in a cold sweat.
A few players looked in Qi Yu’s direction and their hearts sank.
What was lurking in the forest?
Licker?!
At the Dragon Country Guild.
“What? Shelter No. 7 has been attacked again?”
In the lounge, Niu Xia had just closed his eyes to rest for a while when he was awakened by a knock on the door.
He hurriedly put on a coat and rushed back to the meeting room to gather everyone for an emergency discussion.
“The other companies haven’t been attacked by the zombies?”
His subordinate flipped through the information on hand and lowered his head to answer, “We haven’t received any similar reports yet.”
Niu Xia frowned.
He knew that the company was in big trouble this time!
In one day, their shelter had been attacked three times consecutively by the high-intensity zombie team!
Only their company had been attacked!
It was obviously targeted!
There must be someone secretly controlling this group of zombies!
Who could it be?

“President, the shelter that was attacked this time has already made preparations in advance. It can still hold on for a while. A few elite players of the nearby shelter have already come online urgently. They can provide support at any time.”
Should they provide support?
The risk of operating at night was too great.

Niu Xia became a professional player at the age of 15. He became the captain at the age of 22. When he was 25, he founded the Dragon Country Gaming Company. He had made hundreds of decisions, big and small.
But he had never been so hesitant as he was today.
“Go provide support.”
Niu Xia took a deep breath and made a decision.
If he did not even dare to fight, then Dragon Country Guild would lose completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 344 - Returning with a Full Load
paragraphs: “Bring all the equipment! Rocket launcher, focused flamethrower and revolving machine gun too! We must defend the shelter!”
The subordinate quivered and nodded, “Yes!”
Dragon Country Gaming Company was not without a fighting chance.
They still had a few weapons such as the rocket launchers in their warehouse.
These weapons had taken the company more than ten years of effort to obtain.
They were one of the trump cards of the Dragon Country Guild!
Originally, these weapons were used to intimidate the enemy guild and to deal with the Scavenger Army.
Niu Xia did not expect to use them so quickly.
He had to win this battle. If he lost...
Niu Xia did not dare to think about it.
“Eh?”
In the bushes, Fang Heng made a slight sound of confusion.
A small player team appeared on the road in the distance.
They were heading toward the shelter at high speed.
Was it the support of the Dragon Country Company?
Fang Heng was surprised.
He didn’t expect the Dragon Country Company to be brave enough to come to support them at night.
Good! Then he might as well kill them all at once!
Fang Heng immediately controlled the zombie team to stop attacking the shelter and rushed toward the support team that was coming from behind.
The backup team from the Dragon Country Company was all elites.
When they saw the zombie team changing their target, they immediately got out of the car and set up a temporary wooden fence to form a simple defensive line.
Suddenly, gunshots were heard!
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
There was even a revolving machine gun?!
The elite player from the Dragon Country Guild set up two large revolving machine guns at the back of the line.
Dense tongues of fire spat out, forming a powerful fire net!
The firepower of the revolving machine gun was powerful, and it also had a high stun effect.
The zombie team in the distance was threatened, and they were unable to get close to it for a time!
“Not bad..”
Fang Heng sneered in his heart and controlled the Lickers to attack from the side, trying to destroy the defensive line.
“Be careful!”
“It’s the Lickers!!”
In the team, a player shouted and threw a flashbang in the direction of the Lickers.
“Swish!!”
“Buzz...!”
The flashbang instantly lit up the surroundings.
Affected by the high-frequency sound wave of the flashbang, the Lickers in the air fell to the ground one by one.
“Boom! Boom Boom! ”
Grenades, Molotov cocktails, flashbangs...
The Dragon Country Guild’s one-time-use weapons were thrown at the Lickers as if they were free.
The focused flamethrower spat flames in the night, causing more damage.
Fang Heng hid in the dark, frowning.
He thought to himself, good guy.
So the Dragon Country Guild is so rich?
Can money be wasted in such a manner?
If these high-level weapons were used to complete missions, how many points could they be exchanged?
Fang Heng’s heart ached a little.
He couldn’t let them waste any more weapons!
He controlled a few Lickers with low HP to spread out and circle to the side of the team.
The players from the Dragon Country Guild used their powerful firepower to suppress the zombie team.
However, before they could get excited, two Lickers suddenly darted out from the darkness on the side.
“Be careful!”
“Don’t let them get close!”
“Flashbang!”
Seeing the approaching Lickers, a player prepared to throw another flashbang just like before.
But he didn’t notice that the two Lickers’ skin was suffused with an extremely strange red colour!
He was one step too late.
In the next moment, a huge explosion resounded through the entire forest!
Fang Heng also felt a slight tremor beneath his feet!
“Boom!!”
Two Lickers in mid-air exploded with a loud bang.
The blood that splattered around caused great damage to the surrounding area!
The skin of a few players closest to him was splashed by the blood that was produced from the explosion. They immediately felt a burning pain on their skin.
When they looked down carefully, their skin could be seen bleeding rapidly. The HP of their characters had also dropped drastically.
What the hell!
In the panic, the player had no mood to continue attacking. He hurriedly took out a medical spray from his backpack and sprayed it on the wound.
Following that, the zombie team took advantage of the chaos and immediately pounced on the players!
“Heh, the self-destruct skill is really useful.”
Fang Heng chuckled.
“Boom!!”
“Boom Boom!!”
Taking advantage of the chaos, two more Lickers approached the player’s defensive line and self-destructed one after another!
Instantly, the entire Dragon Country Guild’s elite group fell into greater chaos!
Amid the chaos, there was no one to even control the revolving machine gun.
“Don’t panic! They’re coming over! Quick, stop them!”
A player shouted.
Was this f*cking something that could be stopped just because they wanted to?
The players who were splashed by the blood from the self-destructed Lickers were already cursing in their hearts.
Fortunately, the blood did not contain the zombie virus. After spraying the healing spray, their HP started to recover gradually.
However, by the time the players regained their senses, it was already too late to control the situation.
Under the cover of the night, the Lickers’ speed was so fast that even the naked eye could not detect them!
Unless they used high-intensity weapons to hit it head-on or used flashbangs to slow it down!
The successive explosions created a huge gap in the player’s defensive line.
“Quick! Retreat quickly!”
The vice president of the Dragon Country Guild, who was in charge of commanding, was completely panicking.
If this continued, all of their guild members would die here!
“You want to run now?”
Fang Heng didn’t give them a chance to escape.
The two zombie clones took advantage of the chaos to stagger to the car they were driving.
Boom!
Boom! Boom!
Inside the shelter, the players on the sentry tower were dead silent.
Half a minute ago, the players were still preparing for battle, trying to cooperate with the elite team to wipe out this wave of zombies.
They didn’t expect the reversal to happen so quickly!
Before they had the time to reassemble, their teammates outside had already been beaten up by the zombies and fled in all directions.
“Captain, the team is ready, we...”
The player’s mouth was full of bitterness, “Are we still going to support them?”
Support my a*s!
Qi Yu’s face was ashen.
Even the elite team couldn’t defeat them and had already escaped, and they still need to go out and support them?
Wasn’t this courting death?
Now, they could only retreat immediately and try their best to ensure their survival!
“Retreat! Everyone retreat!”
Fang Heng couldn’t leave everyone behind. He focused most of his energy on the few trucks that came, preventing the players from leaving with the trucks,
As for the players who ran on their own, Fang Heng couldn’t stop them. He was too lazy to chase them, so he simply let them off.
[Hint: Your zombie team has destroyed the player’s shelter. You have gained an additional 5,000 Scavenger Army points.]
Half an hour later, the forest returned to its peaceful state.
The zombie team had also destroyed the shelter.
The zombie clones began to clean up the battlefield and collect the materials left behind in the shelter.
They threw the weapons they had collected one by one in front of Fang Heng.
Flashbangs, damaged focused flamethrowers, submachine guns...
“The Dragon Country Guild is quite rich...”
Fang Heng curled his lips and separated the weapons collected by the zombie clones and loaded them into a small van.
After more than half an hour, Fang Heng returned with a van full of weapons.

sentences.text: “Bring all the equipment!
Rocket launcher, focused flamethrower and revolving machine gun too!
We must defend the shelter!”
The subordinate quivered and nodded, “Yes!”
Dragon Country Gaming Company was not without a fighting chance.
They still had a few weapons such as the rocket launchers in their warehouse.
These weapons had taken the company more than ten years of effort to obtain.
They were one of the trump cards of the Dragon Country Guild!
Originally, these weapons were used to intimidate the enemy guild and to deal with the Scavenger Army.
Niu Xia did not expect to use them so quickly.
He had to win this battle.
If he lost...
Niu Xia did not dare to think about it.
“Eh?”
In the bushes, Fang Heng made a slight sound of confusion.
A small player team appeared on the road in the distance.
They were heading toward the shelter at high speed.
Was it the support of the Dragon Country Company?
Fang Heng was surprised.
He didn’t expect the Dragon Country Company to be brave enough to come to support them at night.
Good!
Then he might as well kill them all at once!
Fang Heng immediately controlled the zombie team to stop attacking the shelter and rushed toward the support team that was coming from behind.
The backup team from the Dragon Country Company was all elites.
When they saw the zombie team changing their target, they immediately got out of the car and set up a temporary wooden fence to form a simple defensive line.
Suddenly, gunshots were heard!
Fang Heng raised his eyebrows.
There was even a revolving machine gun?!
The elite player from the Dragon Country Guild set up two large revolving machine guns at the back of the line.
Dense tongues of fire spat out, forming a powerful fire net!
The firepower of the revolving machine gun was powerful, and it also had a high stun effect.
The zombie team in the distance was threatened, and they were unable to get close to it for a time!
“Not bad..”
Fang Heng sneered in his heart and controlled the Lickers to attack from the side, trying to destroy the defensive line.
“Be careful!”
“It’s the Lickers!!”
In the team, a player shouted and threw a flashbang in the direction of the Lickers.
“Swish!!”
“Buzz...!”
The flashbang instantly lit up the surroundings.
Affected by the high-frequency sound wave of the flashbang, the Lickers in the air fell to the ground one by one.
“Boom!
Boom Boom! ”
Grenades, Molotov cocktails, flashbangs...
The Dragon Country Guild’s one-time-use weapons were thrown at the Lickers as if they were free.
The focused flamethrower spat flames in the night, causing more damage.
Fang Heng hid in the dark, frowning.
He thought to himself, good guy.
So the Dragon Country Guild is so rich?
Can money be wasted in such a manner?
If these high-level weapons were used to complete missions, how many points could they be exchanged?
Fang Heng’s heart ached a little.
He couldn’t let them waste any more weapons!
He controlled a few Lickers with low HP to spread out and circle to the side of the team.
The players from the Dragon Country Guild used their powerful firepower to suppress the zombie team.
However, before they could get excited, two Lickers suddenly darted out from the darkness on the side.
“Be careful!”
“Don’t let them get close!”
“Flashbang!”
Seeing the approaching Lickers, a player prepared to throw another flashbang just like before.
But he didn’t notice that the two Lickers’ skin was suffused with an extremely strange red colour!
He was one step too late.
In the next moment, a huge explosion resounded through the entire forest!
Fang Heng also felt a slight tremor beneath his feet!
“Boom!!”
Two Lickers in mid-air exploded with a loud bang.
The blood that splattered around caused great damage to the surrounding area!
The skin of a few players closest to him was splashed by the blood that was produced from the explosion.
They immediately felt a burning pain on their skin.
When they looked down carefully, their skin could be seen bleeding rapidly.
The HP of their characters had also dropped drastically.
What the hell!
In the panic, the player had no mood to continue attacking.
He hurriedly took out a medical spray from his backpack and sprayed it on the wound.
Following that, the zombie team took advantage of the chaos and immediately pounced on the players!
“Heh, the self-destruct skill is really useful.”
Fang Heng chuckled.
“Boom!!”
“Boom Boom!!”
Taking advantage of the chaos, two more Lickers approached the player’s defensive line and self-destructed one after another!
Instantly, the entire Dragon Country Guild’s elite group fell into greater chaos!
Amid the chaos, there was no one to even control the revolving machine gun.
“Don’t panic!
They’re coming over!
Quick, stop them!”
A player shouted.
Was this f*cking something that could be stopped just because they wanted to?
The players who were splashed by the blood from the self-destructed Lickers were already cursing in their hearts.
Fortunately, the blood did not contain the zombie virus.
After spraying the healing spray, their HP started to recover gradually.
However, by the time the players regained their senses, it was already too late to control the situation.
Under the cover of the night, the Lickers’ speed was so fast that even the naked eye could not detect them!
Unless they used high-intensity weapons to hit it head-on or used flashbangs to slow it down!
The successive explosions created a huge gap in the player’s defensive line.

Retreat quickly!”

chapters.title: Chapter 345 - Raid
paragraphs: Returning to Edge Creek Town, Fang Heng received cheers like the return of a hero.
The Scavenger Army’s NPCs were abnormally excited. One by one, they surrounded the truck and counted the weapons and materials Fang Heng had collected.
“Hahaha! Fang Heng! I knew you could do it!”
Roche praised Fang Heng. He patted Fang Heng’s shoulder, “These weapons and equipment would be of great help to me. With them, our attack can be brought forward.”

“Have a good rest, Fang Heng. If everything goes well, we will launch an attack tomorrow afternoon. When that time comes, I will assign you a combat team. We will attack separately and catch them off guard!”

[Hint: You have completed the mission-acquire weapons. Based on the value of the weapons submitted, you have received 7700 survival points and 59,000 points. Your level in the Scavenger Army has been upgraded to Level 4 (Tier 1 elite member).]
[Hint: Roche’s favorability rating for you has increased significantly.]
[Hint: Roche has invited you to participate in the raid of the regional shelter tomorrow afternoon. Refusing to participate in the mission will result in a decrease in your friendship with Roche.]
Fang Heng glanced at the game hint.
To exchange for the divine potion, his level in the Scavenger Army needed to reach Level 6.
He was still lacking 2 levels.
If everything went smoothly, he would probably complete the regional raid mission tomorrow afternoon.
Anyway, the Dragon Country Guild still had a few shelters nearby. If it was not enough, he could just go there and farm for a while more.
It would not be a problem to complete the mission within 24 hours.
Fang Heng looked up at Roche and said, “Of course, let’s crush them together.”
“Hahahaha! You’re right, crush them, Fang Heng!”
Roche’s eyes flashed with a hint of viciousness.
Fang Heng was in a good mood and yawned.
After staying up all night, he felt a little tired.
As his eyes swept through the square, Fang Heng found a space and threw down the makeshift bed. He went offline to rest for a while.
“How did he do it?”
On the other side of the square, Cheng Ya was in disbelief as she looked at the NPCs distributing the materials.
In just two hours, this mysterious man had obtained half a truck’s worth of weapons and resources!
Who was he?
How did he do it!
Cheng Ya was an elite member of the Investigation Team 3 of the Federation’s District 7.
She had received orders from the Federation and spent a lot of effort joining the Scavenger Army to investigate.
At first, Cheng Ya thought that Fang Heng was a bold player who had secretly violated the Federation’s ban to join the Scavenger Army.
But now, Cheng Ya confirmed that Fang Heng’s identity was not ordinary!
She had to report this to her superiors immediately!
Seeing that Fang Heng had left the game, Cheng Ya also found an opportunity to quickly go offline.
At dawn the next day, Cheng Ya reported the situation to the person in charge of the Federation’s District 7 operation, Kou Huai.
After listening to Cheng Ya’s account, Kou Huai fell into deep thought.
“Leader, just who is he? It’s simply unrealistic to obtain so many weapons in one night. Unless he has the support of a large guild, do you think he’s related to the anti-federation forces?”
Kou Huai fell silent for a moment before passing a file to Cheng Ya.
“Take a look at this first.”
Cheng Ya took the file and quickly flipped through it.
“Ah? How?”
Cheng Ya couldn’t help but exclaim.
That night, two shelters of the Dragon Country Guild were attacked by a zombie team from an unknown source.
They suffered heavy losses.
After the shelters were destroyed, the attackers took a lot of weapons with them.
The time point was not long before Fang Heng collected the materials.
All of them matched!
Could it be that he did it?
Cheng Ya was confused.
“Leader, do you think the attack on the Dragon Country Guild is related to him?”
“Yes, the possibility is very high. Continue to observe and try to find out his identity.”
Kou Huai’s face was serious, and he repeatedly reminded her, “You must be careful. This person is very dangerous. We can’t rule out that he is related to the anti-federation forces.”
Cheng Ya’s expression turned solemn. She knew very well in her heart that the background and identity of that mysterious person were not ordinary!
“Yes! I promise to complete the mission!”
Cheng Ya did not bother to rest and immediately returned to the game.
She would monitor that mysterious person 24 hours a day, trying to figure out his true identity.
“Ha!”
After waking up naturally, Fang Heng got up and stretched his body.
The feeling of not having to read books to study was too f*cking good!
Fang Heng let out a heartfelt sigh!
He had stayed up all night in the game last night, and it was already noon after he slept.
Fang Heng felt refreshed.
After meditating on the spot for a moment, Fang Heng went to look for some food. He went back to the study room and casually took out a book related to occultism and stuffed it into his backpack.
It was almost afternoon when he went online again.
There were less than 24 hours left until the end of the parallel world teleportation.
“Fang Heng, are you ready? We will set off in half an hour.”
Noticing that Fang Heng had gone online, Roche walked over.
He showed Fang Heng the latest battle map.
“These areas are all the possible attack directions for this raid. We will randomly choose the shelter within the area to attack. The objective of the mission is to raid and destroy.”
Fang Heng received a hint from the game.
[Hint: Player has triggered a mission-claim sovereignty.]
Mission name: Claim sovereignty.

Mission description: Received an order from superiors. The Scavenger Army needs to claim sovereignty over the area near Edge Creek Town within 10 days, during this period, Roche will lead a team to attack all the player’s shelters within the area.
Mission requirements: Assist Roche to destroy the player’s shelter in the area near Edge Creek Town.
Mission reward: Scavenger Army points, survival points (the reward will be calculated based on the player’s contribution in the battle).
Fang Heng roughly flipped through the mission description.
“Fang Heng, I can give you a small team to lead. Later we will split up and operate on our own. Or you can choose to follow me. We’ll first attack the largest shelter together...”
Fang Heng?!
This was the first time Cheng Ya heard Roche call Fang Heng by this name. Her pupils constricted.
He was Fang Heng?!
Fang Heng from District 8?
Recently, news about the Prison Army in District 8 had spread all over the internet, and Cheng Ya had also heard about it.
How was this possible?
Why would Fang Heng appear here?
But if it was him, then everything made sense.
Fang Heng could indeed control a large number of zombies to fight!
Yesterday, the Dragon Country Guild was also attacked by a large number of zombies.
For a moment, Cheng Ya looked at Fang Heng, her heart in a mess.
“I’ll lead a small team.”
Fang Heng quickly calculated that he could get more points by leading the team.
“Okay, there are 23 survivor shelters in the nearby area. I’ll choose to attack the largest one. The other three shelters are closer to each other. You choose one?”
Fang Heng raised his head and said, “No need to choose. I will take care of these three.”.
Hearing Fang Heng’s words, Roche was stunned for a moment, and then he laughed.

chapters.title: Chapter 346 - Leading a Team
paragraphs: “Hahaha! Fang Heng! You suit my taste!”
“That’s right. That group of trash doesn’t have any fighting ability. It’s a waste of time to clean them up one by one. We might as well finish off all three shelters in a row.”
“He’s Rudra,” Roche called out to a fierce-looking young man and introduce him to introduce Fang Heng.
“He is the vice-captain of Team 3. The former captain died in the battle last time. He will help you lead the team to attack the shelter.”
Rudra looked at Fang Heng coldly and expressionlessly. It seemed that he was not convinced of Fang Heng’s ability.
Fang Heng did not care about Rudra’s attitude. He smiled and nodded. “He looks very energetic.”
“Hahahahaha! I’ll leave this team to you. Fang Heng, we’re going to set off now and come back to celebrate!”
“Definitely.”
Fang Heng was full of confidence.
Cheng Ya listened to their conversation from the side and had mixed feelings in her heart.
Hearing Fang Heng’s contemptuous conversation, she was angry at first.
Did they think that the players guarding the shelter were all idiots?
The players had already received the news that the Scavenger Army had entered Edge Creek Town, and were prepared to deal with it.
However, if he was Fang Heng from District 8...
Cheng Ya was a little scared.
[Hint: You have triggered a mission-fight together. Please choose the team you want to join.]
A hint of a game mission flashed through Cheng Ya’s vision.
She hesitated for a moment, gritted her teeth, and chose to join Fang Heng’s team.
She needed to find a way to get close to Fang Heng, and take this opportunity to find out if this person was Fang Heng!
The simplest way was to confirm whether he could control the zombies!
Taking advantage of the preparation work before the team set off, Cheng Ya secretly left the town square.
She wanted to secretly go offline and pass on the information about Fang Heng and the next target and time of the Scavenger Army’s attack to the Federation’s superiors.
At that time, the Federation’s superiors would immediately pass on the information to the various player guilds so that they would be prepared to resist the Scavenger Army.
However, Cheng Ya had just walked to an empty corner and was about to go offline through the bunk bed when a deep voice sounded in his ear.
“Why are you in such a hurry to go offline? Are you preparing to leak our attack target to the outside world?”
Cheng Ya’s heart trembled as she turned her head.
It was Fang Heng!
Fang Heng smiled as he looked at Cheng Ya.
He had no choice. It was not good to have a high perception attribute.
Fang Heng had been sensing Cheng Ya’s gaze.
He guessed that Cheng Ya might be a player from a large guild who had sneaked into the Scavenger Army to steal information.
Seeing that Cheng Ya did not answer, Fang Heng shrugged. “Whatever. Tell them to retreat as soon as possible. Don’t make unnecessary resistance and give up their lives for nothing.”
“And, stop staring at me.”
After saying that, Fang Heng turned and left without waiting for Cheng Ya’s response.
With the help of the zombie team, Fang Heng was confident that he could complete the mission.
So what if the players in the shelter were prepared?
He could already crush them in terms of strength.
Soon, the NPC team of the Scavenger Army arrived at the nearest player’s shelter on a motorcycle.
The players in the shelter had already received the news in advance and were ready to face the enemy.
“Kill!”
“Brothers! Follow me!”
Facing the defensive line of the shelter, Rudra’s eyes turned red. With a loud shout, he led the Scavenger Army’s NPCs on motorcycles and rushed toward the shelter.
Fang Heng was dumbfounded.
Were these NPCs so strong? Were they all so direct and reckless?
Moreover, shouldn’t he be the commander?
In the next second, the game hint quickly refreshed on his retina.
[Hint: Second-in-command, Rudra, leads the Scavenger Army team to launch an attack on the shelter. Player, please assist the team in breaking through the shelter.]

[Hint: As the leader of the team, once the team loses members, you will be deducted the corresponding points, reducing the reputation value in the Scavenger Army, and reducing the friendship of the team’s NPCs.]
There were consequences?
Fang Heng had a headache. He felt that being the captain of the team did not bring him any benefits. Instead, there were all kinds of negative punishments.
The players on the sentry tower saw the crazy Scavenger Army’s NPCs and immediately felt like they were facing a great enemy.
Arrows mixed with bullets rained on the Scavenger Army’s NPCs from the sentry tower.
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes.
So strange!
The bullets entered the bodies of the Scavenger Army survivors, but there was very little blood oozing out of the wounds.
Their skin and bones looked more like dried corpses.
Unless they were hit in the head, the bullets would cause very little damage to them!
“Is this also the special ability of the divine potion?”
Fang Heng was secretly shocked.
The Scavenger Army had small immunity to bullets.
What was more frightening was that the fighting spirit of the Scavenger Army survivors was extremely high.
The pain of being hit by bullets not only did not make them retreat but also made them even more excited.
The Scavenger Army survivors, one by one, fearlessly pounced on the periphery defense facilities.
They were blocked by the periphery defense traps and high walls.
The players standing on top of the sentry tower took this opportunity to attack and deal damage.
Under the concentrated fire, the survivors of the Scavenger Army began to fall one by one. Fang Heng’s vision began to refresh.
[Hint: Members of the Scavenger Army have died. Your Scavenger Army points -70. Your reputation in the Scavenger Army has decreased...]
“This bunch of boors...”
“As expected, they are unreliable.”
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes. He knew it was his turn to act.
If this continued, his points would be depleted.
Cheng Ya was very nervous as she followed behind the team.
Her gaze had been focused on Fang Heng, observing his every move.
She saw that Fang Heng did not join the battlefield. Instead, he was hiding behind at the back. He slowly took out a gun from his backpack.
It was a sniper rifle!
Cheng Ya’s pupils constricted.
Was Fang Heng the firepower output point of the team?
Since the start of Server 7, there were not many players who could fully control the long-range sniper rifle.
In the Zombie Apocalypse game, every outstanding long-range player was the target of recruitment by the big guilds. Their annual salary was at least several million!
Fang Heng held his breath and focused, aiming at the player on the sentry tower.
Cheng Ya’s heart skipped a beat.
She recognized Fang Heng’s posture.
“C.A.R” tactical shooting action!
The exclusive gun-type skill of the Dark Knights!
Was he a member of the Dark Knights?
That’s not right!
The Dark Knights and the Scavenger Army were on opposing sides. A player could not join two different sides at the same time!
“Bang!”
A gunshot interrupted Cheng Ya’s thoughts.
Tactical shooting action, gun mastery and guillotine were triggered at the same time!
Together with Fang Heng’s high perception and strength attribute, the player on the sentry tower was shot in the head.
[Hint: You have killed a player from the opposite camp. You have received 50 Scavenger Army points.]

sentences.text: “Hahaha!
Fang Heng!
You suit my taste!”
“That’s right.
That group of trash doesn’t have any fighting ability.
It’s a waste of time to clean them up one by one.
We might as well finish off all three shelters in a row.”
“He’s Rudra,” Roche called out to a fierce-looking young man and introduce him to introduce Fang Heng.
“He is the vice-captain of Team 3.
The former captain died in the battle last time.
He will help you lead the team to attack the shelter.”
Rudra looked at Fang Heng coldly and expressionlessly.
It seemed that he was not convinced of Fang Heng’s ability.
Fang Heng did not care about Rudra’s attitude.
He smiled and nodded.
“He looks very energetic.”
“Hahahahaha!
I’ll leave this team to you.
Fang Heng, we’re going to set off now and come back to celebrate!”
“Definitely.”
Fang Heng was full of confidence.
Cheng Ya listened to their conversation from the side and had mixed feelings in her heart.
Hearing Fang Heng’s contemptuous conversation, she was angry at first.
Did they think that the players guarding the shelter were all idiots?
The players had already received the news that the Scavenger Army had entered Edge Creek Town, and were prepared to deal with it.
However, if he was Fang Heng from District 8...
Cheng Ya was a little scared.
[Hint: You have triggered a mission-fight together.
Please choose the team you want to join.]
A hint of a game mission flashed through Cheng Ya’s vision.
She hesitated for a moment, gritted her teeth, and chose to join Fang Heng’s team.
She needed to find a way to get close to Fang Heng, and take this opportunity to find out if this person was Fang Heng!
The simplest way was to confirm whether he could control the zombies!
Taking advantage of the preparation work before the team set off, Cheng Ya secretly left the town square.
She wanted to secretly go offline and pass on the information about Fang Heng and the next target and time of the Scavenger Army’s attack to the Federation’s superiors.
At that time, the Federation’s superiors would immediately pass on the information to the various player guilds so that they would be prepared to resist the Scavenger Army.
However, Cheng Ya had just walked to an empty corner and was about to go offline through the bunk bed when a deep voice sounded in his ear.
“Why are you in such a hurry to go offline?
Are you preparing to leak our attack target to the outside world?”
Cheng Ya’s heart trembled as she turned her head.
It was Fang Heng!
Fang Heng smiled as he looked at Cheng Ya.
He had no choice.
It was not good to have a high perception attribute.
Fang Heng had been sensing Cheng Ya’s gaze.
He guessed that Cheng Ya might be a player from a large guild who had sneaked into the Scavenger Army to steal information.
Seeing that Cheng Ya did not answer, Fang Heng shrugged.
“Whatever.
Tell them to retreat as soon as possible.
Don’t make unnecessary resistance and give up their lives for nothing.”
“And, stop staring at me.”
After saying that, Fang Heng turned and left without waiting for Cheng Ya’s response.
With the help of the zombie team, Fang Heng was confident that he could complete the mission.
So what if the players in the shelter were prepared?
He could already crush them in terms of strength.
Soon, the NPC team of the Scavenger Army arrived at the nearest player’s shelter on a motorcycle.
The players in the shelter had already received the news in advance and were ready to face the enemy.
“Kill!”
“Brothers!
Follow me!”
Facing the defensive line of the shelter, Rudra’s eyes turned red.
With a loud shout, he led the Scavenger Army’s NPCs on motorcycles and rushed toward the shelter.
Fang Heng was dumbfounded.
Were these NPCs so strong?
Were they all so direct and reckless?
Moreover, shouldn’t he be the commander?
In the next second, the game hint quickly refreshed on his retina.
[Hint: Second-in-command, Rudra, leads the Scavenger Army team to launch an attack on the shelter.
Player, please assist the team in breaking through the shelter.]

[Hint: As the leader of the team, once the team loses members, you will be deducted the corresponding points, reducing the reputation value in the Scavenger Army, and reducing the friendship of the team’s NPCs.]
There were consequences?
Fang Heng had a headache.
He felt that being the captain of the team did not bring him any benefits.
Instead, there were all kinds of negative punishments.
The players on the sentry tower saw the crazy Scavenger Army’s NPCs and immediately felt like they were facing a great enemy.
Arrows mixed with bullets rained on the Scavenger Army’s NPCs from the sentry tower.
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes.
So strange!
The bullets entered the bodies of the Scavenger Army survivors, but there was very little blood oozing out of the wounds.
Their skin and bones looked more like dried corpses.
Unless they were hit in the head, the bullets would cause very little damage to them!
“Is this also the special ability of the divine potion?”
Fang Heng was secretly shocked.
The Scavenger Army had small immunity to bullets.
What was more frightening was that the fighting spirit of the Scavenger Army survivors was extremely high.
The pain of being hit by bullets not only did not make them retreat but also made them even more excited.
The Scavenger Army survivors, one by one, fearlessly pounced on the periphery defense facilities.
They were blocked by the periphery defense traps and high walls.
The players standing on top of the sentry tower took this opportunity to attack and deal damage.
Under the concentrated fire, the survivors of the Scavenger Army began to fall one by one.
Fang Heng’s vision began to refresh.
[Hint: Members of the Scavenger Army have died.
Your Scavenger Army points -70.
Your reputation in the Scavenger Army has decreased...]
“This bunch of boors...”
“As expected, they are unreliable.”
Fang Heng narrowed his eyes.
He knew it was his turn to act.
If this continued, his points would be depleted.
Cheng Ya was very nervous as she followed behind the team.
Her gaze had been focused on Fang Heng, observing his every move.
She saw that Fang Heng did not join the battlefield.
Instead, he was hiding behind at the back.
He slowly took out a gun from his backpack.
It was a sniper rifle!
Cheng Ya’s pupils constricted.
Was Fang Heng the firepower output point of the team?
Since the start of Server 7, there were not many players who could fully control the long-range sniper rifle.
In the Zombie Apocalypse game, every outstanding long-range player was the target of recruitment by the big guilds.
Their annual salary was at least several million!
Fang Heng held his breath and focused, aiming at the player on the sentry tower.
Cheng Ya’s heart skipped a beat.
She recognized Fang Heng’s posture.
“C.A.R” tactical shooting action!
The exclusive gun-type skill of the Dark Knights!
Was he a member of the Dark Knights?
That’s not right!
The Dark Knights and the Scavenger Army were on opposing sides.
A player could not join two different sides at the same time!
“Bang!”
A gunshot interrupted Cheng Ya’s thoughts.
Tactical shooting action, gun mastery and guillotine were triggered at the same time!
Together with Fang Heng’s high perception and strength attribute, the player on the sentry tower was shot in the head.
[Hint: You have killed a player from the opposite camp.
You have received 50 Scavenger Army points.]

chapters.title: Chapter 347 - Crushed
paragraphs: Fang Heng expressionlessly reloaded his bullets and looked for the next target.
Aim and pull the trigger.
Kill!
Fang Heng hid in the distance and pulled the trigger every 10 seconds.
Every gunshot could take the life of a player.
Cheng Ya moved her lips.
It was too terrifying! A 100% hit rate and fatality rate!
He was a top long-range shooter!
In a battle between faction players, a sniper-like character like Fang Heng on the battlefield was a terrifying existence!
Cheng Ya was sweating for the shelter.
Could they hold on?
Because of Fang Heng’s participation, the players on the sentry tower fell one by one.
The players went crazy.
Every time a gunshot sounded, a teammate would fall.
They had spent a lot of effort to determine the sniper’s position, but they could not effectively counter it!
Most of the players in the shelter used guns to deal damage, but because most of the guns had limited range, they could not hit Fang Heng in the distance.
The only two long-ranged shooters, who did not have a high hit rate, tried shooting at Fang Heng’s position twice and were instantly killed.
They had no choice. They could only fight with their lives!
The pressure on the players was immense! They took the risk of dying at any time and stepped onto the tower. They aimed at the Scavenger Army that was destroying the outer layer of the building.
The Scavenger Army which was originally at a disadvantage began to gain the upper hand.
During the chaotic battle, the players from the shelter did not notice that a few zombies came out of nowhere and swayed from the side to approach the high wall of the shelter’s periphery.
The players were busy dealing with the enemy and did not realize the threat of these zombies.
Until the zombies ran to the bottom of the wall of the shelter’s periphery.
“Boom!”
There was a loud explosion.
Cheng Ya was shocked and looked in the direction of the sound.
What?
She found that there was an explosion on the right side of the shelter.
Who did it?
“Boom! Boom! Boom!”
Before Cheng Ya could see clearly, there were a few more explosions under the high wall on the right side!
The durability of the periphery wall fell by a large chunk. After a few explosions, its HP fell to zero.
“Boom!”
There was another loud sound, and the entire periphery wall collapsed.
Cheng Ya’s face turned pale.
She finally saw clearly.
There were zombies.
Zombies that self-detonated.
More than ten zombies gathered at the corner of the wall. By self-detonating, they forcefully collapsed the wall, creating a huge hole!
It was him!
Fang Heng!
He was the one who secretly controlled the zombies to self-destruct!
There was no one else but him!
Cheng Ya turned around and looked at Fang Heng, who was expressionlessly aiming with the sniper rifle.
She felt that Fang Heng looked particularly terrifying at this moment.
“Bang!”
Fang Heng pulled the trigger and took the life of a player.
Another game hint floated across his vision.
[Hint: You have broken through the high wall of the shelter’s periphery. You have received 1500 Scavenger Army points. Your reputation in the Scavenger Army has increased significantly!]
“Hahaha! They can’t hold on any longer! Brothers! Follow me! Let’s kill our way in together!”
A hint of madness flashed in Rudra’s eyes. He waved the machete in his hand and shouted.
“Kill them all!”
“Roar! Kill them all! Burn them all!”
The Scavenger Army players shouted in response and followed Rudra into the shelter.
[Hint: Rudra uses a special skill to encourage the members of the Scavenger Army to have an additional 10% increase in each attribute.]
This was bad!
Cheng Ya’s heart was beating wildly.
The defense of the periphery was instantly destroyed and the Scavenger Army quickly broke into the shelter! If they fought at close range, the player side would be at a huge disadvantage!
The collapse of the shelter was faster than Cheng Ya had expected!
Once the Scavenger Army with extraordinary physical fitness charged into the shelter’s range, they would start a frenzied slaughter!
The players could not win!
“We can’t win.”
“Run, what’s the point of fighting!”
“F*ck, run!”
The players’ morale was greatly reduced and they began to retreat, each running for their lives.
Seeing the shelter in chaos, Cheng Ya’s heart sank.
The failure of the shelter was a foregone conclusion.
He was behind all of this!
It was him! Fang Heng!
Was he Fang Heng from District 7?
Cheng Ya stared at Fang Heng.
She could not confirm this.
Not good!
Cheng Ya suddenly shivered.
She realized that Fang Heng’s raid had only just begun!
The most important thing now was to inform the remaining two shelters and persuade them to take their materials and leave the shelter as soon as possible.
Seeing that the players on the sentry tower had started to retreat, Fang Heng was too lazy to chase after them. He put down the sniper rifle in his hand.
“Easy... easy...”
Fang Heng muttered to himself and looked at the game log again.
[Hint: The branch team you led has successfully destroyed the player’s shelter. Based on your contribution rating on this battlefield, you have obtained the highest level, the S-level evaluation.]

[Hint: Due to your outstanding performance, your favorability rating with Rudra has increased slightly. You have received partial recognition from the Scavenger Army’s branch team. Your reputation in the Scavenger Army has increased significantly. Your control over the team has increased.]

[Hint: You can choose to complete this raid and immediately enter the clearing state. You can also choose to continue to raid the next shelter as a target. The rewards for the next stage of the raid will accumulate and stack in the final clearing state.]
Of course, continue!
Fang Heng reached out his hand and tapped on continue.
Since he was already here, he had to get another score!
The NPCs who had taken the divine potion were shockingly strong.
These were the effects of the divine potion!
It would be great if the negative effects of the divine potion could be eliminated.

Fang Heng was thinking in his heart. He wanted to earn more points so that he could exchange for a few more bottles of divine potion. Other than giving them to the Dark Knights in exchange for the first-generation meteorite, he would bring the rest back to Qiu Yaokang for research.
After destroying the shelter, Rudra led his team to light a fire in the shelter and burn it down.
Soon, the entire shelter was engulfed in a sea of fire.
The Scavenger Army’s NPCs laughed wildly and destroyed the shelter wantonly to vent their inner brutality.
“Such a waste...”
Looking at the raging fire ahead, Fang Heng curled his lips and thought that these people’s brains were most likely damaged by the potions.
If he were to let his zombie clones search the shelter’s remains carefully, they would be able to collect a lot of weapons and equipment.
These were all things that could be exchanged for points!
Fang Heng shook his head.
He walked into the midst of the NPC survivors who were venting their anger and partying.
The team control effect of the mission was quite obvious. When the NPCs saw Fang Heng, they calmed down a little and stopped partying.
“Guys! It’s not time to party yet!”
“It’s just the beginning. There are still two shelters waiting for us to raid!”
Fang Heng waved his hand.
“Let’s go! The next shelter is our target!”

chapters.title: Chapter 348 - Powerful Potion
paragraphs: Hearing what Fang Heng said, the high-spirited Scavenger Army’s NPCs roared again.
“Roar!”
“Next! Next!”
“Crush them!”
The Scavenger Army’s NPCs got on their motorcycles again and followed Fang Heng’s minivan, ready to attack the next target shelter with Fang Heng.
Fang Heng had just gotten on the minivan, and before he could set off, Cheng Ya pushed open the door on the other side and sat in the passenger seat.
“Fang Heng, we need to talk.”
“Let’s talk along the way. I’m in a hurry.”
Cheng Ya gritted her teeth and said, “We’ll set off in 10 minutes! I’ve contacted the upper management of the remaining two player’s shelter. They need 15 minutes to evacuate.”
“When the time comes, we can directly attack the unguarded shelter and easily complete the mission. There won’t be any casualties.”
“Oh?”
Fang Heng raised an eyebrow.
“You’re from the Federation?”
Cheng Ya nodded and admitted her identity.
She could not hide it.
Only the Federation had the ability and willingness to persuade the two guilds to evacuate in such a short time.
“Alright, we’ll give them 10 minutes.”
Cheng Ya heaved a sigh of relief.
It did not take much effort to convince these guilds to give up on the shelter.
The Federation directly transmitted the video that Cheng Ya had just recorded to the higher-ups of the two shelter companies.
The higher-ups of the companies immediately expressed that they would retreat immediately.
They would let go when they should.
It would be really stupid to forcefully stay there and die with the shelter!
Cheng Ya took a deep breath. She turned to Fang Heng and asked, “Fang Heng, are you from District 8? Fang Heng from the prison?”
Fang Heng also looked at Cheng Ya.
He knew that the Federation had gotten a lot of information about him from various sources.
Because he did not want to expose his identity, Fang Heng still wore a mask.
Fang Heng spread his hands and said, “If you think so, then I am.”
Cheng Ya didn’t expect to get such an affirmative answer from Fang Heng.
In an instant, she instinctively didn’t believe what Fang Heng said.
“Impossible! Aren’t you in District 8? Why are you here?”
“If you don’t believe me, then forget it.”
“Show me your true face.”
“I refuse.”
“You were fine in District 8, why did you come to District 7?”
Fang Heng knew very well that openly admitting his identity would only make the other party suspicious. He was just about to say something when the sound of a game hint suddenly rang in his ears.
[Hint: Current book-Occult Guide reading progress has reached 100% . You have completed the reading.]
[Hint: You have mastered a skill-basic occult.]
Damn! So fast?
He has finished reading ‘Occult Guide’?
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat. He didn’t have time to talk nonsense with Cheng Ya anymore. He opened the game log to observe.
With the enhancement of the skill ‘efficient reading’, the reading speed would be greatly increased.
In addition, the zombie clone didn’t have the limit of vitality, so it was crazily reading 24 hours a day.
The progress of reading books was just like opening cheats!
Awesome!
Fang Heng was in a great mood, so he immediately opened the skill familiarization.
Skill-Basic occult (Level 1).
Skill description: Basic occult is the foundation of all occult skills. After mastering a skill, you will gain will +1, perception +1, and you can learn a branch of occult skills.
Skill description: Through this skill, you can obtain additional game hints (The information obtained is related to the skill level).
Skill description: The skill can be upgraded to Level 20 and cannot exceed the current player’s level. Player can find other ways to upgrade this skill.
It seemed that this skill was just a simple basic prerequisite skill.
He probably needed to read more related books to learn related skills.
Fang Heng pondered for a moment.
He wasn’t afraid.
There were at least dozens of books related to occultism in Mo Yunxiao’s study. If he read all of them, he would probably get a few related skills.

Anyway, he had a lot of zombie clones. When the time came, he would think of a way to bring them into the game. Each of them would read one book and he estimated that he would finish reading them very quickly!
An hour later, Fang Heng and the Scavenger Army took over the two empty shelters and burned them to the ground.
After completing the mission, Fang Heng led the team back to Edge Creek town.
[Hint: Mission statistics in progress...]

[Hint: You have completed the mission-claim sovereignty. Based on your performance, you have obtained 12,000 survival points and 95,000 Scavenger Army points. Your level in the Scavenger Army has increased to Level 6 (Tier 3 elite member).]
[Hint: Your reputation in the Scavenger Army has increased significantly.]
After pocketing a large number of points, Fang Heng came to Yatu’s side at the side of the square.
“Yatu, I need to exchange for the divine potion.”
Yatu raised his head to look at Fang Heng and the shock in his eyes disappeared.
“Fang Heng, I have never seen anyone get promoted as quickly as you. You have surprised me.”
Yatu praised him from the bottom of his heart.
Then, a row of item exchange lists immediately appeared in front of Fang Heng.
After advancing to a Tier 3 elite member, there were finally a few more items in the exchange list.
Divine potion (Tier 1).
Exchanging a bottle of Tier 1 potion required a total of 40,000 Scavenger Army points.
So expensive!
The current points could only buy four bottles.
Fang Heng raised his head and asked, “There are still Tier 2 potions?”
“Of course, you need to increase your level to get higher-level potions. Believe me, they are definitely worth it.”
Fang Heng shook his head.
The agreement between him and Ai lei did not specify the potion level.
“I need to buy four bottles of Tier 1 potions.”
“These are your potions. Take it well.”
[Hint: You have spent 160,000 Scavenger Army points to exchange for the divine potion (Tier 1)*4.]
“The potion can improve your body’s function. As you take it more often, your body’s strength will gradually increase. You will like that state.”
“However, before you take the potion, I want to remind you that you need to take a bottle of Tier 1 potion every 10 days.”
“Hehe.” Yatu laughed sinisterly, “You must remember to take the potion on time, or else you will die a horrible death.”
A horrible death?
Fang Heng was suspicious as he took the divine potion from Yatu.
Item: Divine potion (Tier 1).

Description 1: After using the potion for the first time, you will gain immunity to the T-virus and gain a permanent special state-muscle stiffness (Level 1). Under this state, the player’s basic strength will be increased by +10 and basic strength will be increased by +5, all physical damage received will be reduced by 30% and all damage received will be reduced by 30 points.
Description 2: After continuously taking the potion, your muscle stiffness state will be increased.
Description 3: After taking this potion, if you do not continue to take the divine potion of any tier for 10 consecutive days, the player will enter a near-death state.
Description 4 (obtained when the basic perception attribute is over 20 points): You can sense that the potion in your hand is very dangerous.
[Hint (obtained from elementary difficulty): This potion may have special side effects that cannot be removed by using points. Please use it with caution.]
