Fang Heng raised an eyebrow.
“You’re from the Federation?”
Cheng Ya nodded and admitted her identity.
She could not hide it.
Only the Federation had the ability and willingness to persuade the two guilds to evacuate in such a short time.
“Alright, we’ll give them 10 minutes.”
Cheng Ya heaved a sigh of relief.
It did not take much effort to convince these guilds to give up on the shelter.
The Federation directly transmitted the video that Cheng Ya had just recorded to the higher-ups of the two shelter companies.
The higher-ups of the companies immediately expressed that they would retreat immediately.
They would let go when they should.
It would be really stupid to forcefully stay there and die with the shelter!
Cheng Ya took a deep breath.
She turned to Fang Heng and asked, “Fang Heng, are you from District 8?
Fang Heng from the prison?”
Fang Heng also looked at Cheng Ya.
He knew that the Federation had gotten a lot of information about him from various sources.
Because he did not want to expose his identity, Fang Heng still wore a mask.
Fang Heng spread his hands and said, “If you think so, then I am.”
Cheng Ya didn’t expect to get such an affirmative answer from Fang Heng.
In an instant, she instinctively didn’t believe what Fang Heng said.
“Impossible!
Aren’t you in District 8?
Why are you here?”
“If you don’t believe me, then forget it.”
“Show me your true face.”
“I refuse.”
“You were fine in District 8, why did you come to District 7?”
Fang Heng knew very well that openly admitting his identity would only make the other party suspicious.
He was just about to say something when the sound of a game hint suddenly rang in his ears.
[Hint: Current book-Occult Guide reading progress has reached 100% .
You have completed the reading.]
[Hint: You have mastered a skill-basic occult.]
Damn!
So fast?
He has finished reading ‘Occult Guide’?
Fang Heng’s heart skipped a beat.
He didn’t have time to talk nonsense with Cheng Ya anymore.
He opened the game log to observe.
With the enhancement of the skill ‘efficient reading’, the reading speed would be greatly increased.
In addition, the zombie clone didn’t have the limit of vitality, so it was crazily reading 24 hours a day.
The progress of reading books was just like opening cheats!
Awesome!
Fang Heng was in a great mood, so he immediately opened the skill familiarization.
Skill-Basic occult (Level 1).
Skill description: Basic occult is the foundation of all occult skills.
After mastering a skill, you will gain will +1, perception +1, and you can learn a branch of occult skills.
Skill description: Through this skill, you can obtain additional game hints (The information obtained is related to the skill level).
Skill description: The skill can be upgraded to Level 20 and cannot exceed the current player’s level.
Player can find other ways to upgrade this skill.
It seemed that this skill was just a simple basic prerequisite skill.
He probably needed to read more related books to learn related skills.
Fang Heng pondered for a moment.
He wasn’t afraid.
There were at least dozens of books related to occultism in Mo Yunxiao’s study.
If he read all of them, he would probably get a few related skills.
Anyway, he had a lot of zombie clones.
When the time came, he would think of a way to bring them into the game.
Each of them would read one book and he estimated that he would finish reading them very quickly!
An hour later, Fang Heng and the Scavenger Army took over the two empty shelters and burned them to the ground.
After completing the mission, Fang Heng led the team back to Edge Creek town.
[Hint: Mission statistics in progress...]
[Hint: You have completed the mission-claim sovereignty.
Based on your performance, you have obtained 12,000 survival points and 95,000 Scavenger Army points.
Your level in the Scavenger Army has increased to Level 6 (Tier 3 elite member).]
[Hint: Your reputation in the Scavenger Army has increased significantly.]
After pocketing a large number of points, Fang Heng came to Yatu’s side at the side of the square.
“Yatu, I need to exchange for the divine potion.”
Yatu raised his head to look at Fang Heng and the shock in his eyes disappeared.
“Fang Heng, I have never seen anyone get promoted as quickly as you.
You have surprised me.”
Yatu praised him from the bottom of his heart.
Then, a row of item exchange lists immediately appeared in front of Fang Heng.
After advancing to a Tier 3 elite member, there were finally a few more items in the exchange list.
Divine potion (Tier 1).
Exchanging a bottle of Tier 1 potion required a total of 40,000 Scavenger Army points.
So expensive!
The current points could only buy four bottles.
Fang Heng raised his head and asked, “There are still Tier 2 potions?”
“Of course, you need to increase your level to get higher-level potions.
Believe me, they are definitely worth it.”
Fang Heng shook his head.
The agreement between him and Ai lei did not specify the potion level.
“I need to buy four bottles of Tier 1 potions.”
“These are your potions.
Take it well.”
[Hint: You have spent 160,000 Scavenger Army points to exchange for the divine potion (Tier 1)*4.]
“The potion can improve your body’s function.
As you take it more often, your body’s strength will gradually increase.
You will like that state.”
“However, before you take the potion, I want to remind you that you need to take a bottle of Tier 1 potion every 10 days.”
“Hehe.” Yatu laughed sinisterly, “You must remember to take the potion on time, or else you will die a horrible death.”
A horrible death?
Fang Heng was suspicious as he took the divine potion from Yatu.
Item: Divine potion (Tier 1).
Description 1: After using the potion for the first time, you will gain immunity to the T-virus and gain a permanent special state-muscle stiffness (Level 1).

Under this state, the player’s basic strength will be increased by +10 and basic strength will be increased by +5, all physical damage received will be reduced by 30% and all damage received will be reduced by 30 points.
Description 2: After continuously taking the potion, your muscle stiffness state will be increased.
Description 3: After taking this potion, if you do not continue to take the divine potion of any tier for 10 consecutive days, the player will enter a near-death state.
Description 4 (obtained when the basic perception attribute is over 20 points): You can sense that the potion in your hand is very dangerous.
[Hint (obtained from elementary difficulty): This potion may have special side effects that cannot be removed by using points.
Please use it with caution.]

chapters.title: Chapter 349 - Worm
paragraphs: What a powerful effect!
Looking at the attribute of the potion, Fang Heng was secretly shocked.
Not only was it immune to the normal zombie virus, but it could also permanently increase a player’s basic attribute!
In the Zombie Apocalypse game, the zombie virus had always been a nightmare for players.
Apart from that, the bonus of being immune to 30% physical damage was even more terrifying!
From the hint from Yatu, the muscle stiffness state could still be improved by continuing to take the potion to obtain a higher attribute.
It could even exceed the 30% number.
Wasn’t it a little too strong!
It was so strong that it made people feel uneasy.
Another very troublesome point was persistence.
After taking the divine potion for the first time, one had to continuously use it. Once you stopped taking the potion, it would directly lead to death.
This was equivalent to putting his life in the hands of the Scavenger Army.
“Fang Heng.”
Cheng Ya had been following Fang Heng the whole time, trying to find out Fang Heng’s identity along the way.
Unfortunately, until now, Cheng Ya was still unable to determine whether he was Fang Heng from District 8.
At this time, seeing that Fang Heng had exchanged for several bottles of divine potion, Cheng Ya couldn’t help but frown and remind him.
“Huh?”
“Fang Heng, don’t use it.”
“Why?”
Fang Heng glanced at Cheng Ya.
“This divine potion has a lot of side effects. After taking the potion, the player’s spirit will continue to be extremely excited and irritable, showing a very strong destructive tendency.”
Cheng Ya’s expression was solemn as she explained to Fang Heng, “This kind of situation will not only appear in the game but also outside of the game.”

“When the divine potion first appeared, the Federation discovered that many criminals in the real world were extremely excited and irritable. After investigation, it was discovered that most of them had taken the divine potion.”
“After that, to prevent social chaos, the Federation immediately issued a ban, forbidding any player from joining the Scavenger Army, and forbidding any player from taking the divine potion.”
No wonder!
Fang Heng suddenly understood.
The negative effects of the divine potion could affect the real world.
No wonder the Federation forbade players from joining the Scavenger Army.
However, Fang Heng was not prepared to use this potion, which had a huge side effect.
If he was not careful, his brain would be damaged and he would become as crazy as the NPCs of the Scavenger Army.
The loss outweighed the gain.
Just as Fang Heng was about to put the bottle of potion back into his backpack, a game hint suddenly appeared in Fang Heng’s vision.
[Hint: Due to your skill-basic occult, you can perform a preliminary occult analysis of the potion.]
[Hint: You can spend 100 survival points to analyze the divine potion (Tier 1). Do you want to analyze it?]
“Eh?”
Fang Heng was surprised.
Occult skills could analyze potions?
And it was very cheap. Only 100 survival points?
Let’s try!
Fang Heng muttered in his heart, “Analyze!”
The next second, a bottle of potion in his hand was pulled by a special strength and slowly floated in the air.
Buzz...
The bottle started to spin uncontrollably in the air.
The mark on the back of Fang Heng’s hand appeared faintly.
Cheng Ya’s eyes widened in shock at the scene in front of her.
What was that!?
She stared at the bottle of potion and began to doubt Fang Heng’s real identity.
After a short rotation, the bottle of potion began to shake violently.
“Bang!!!”
The bottle of potion exploded!
The pale purple liquid floated in the air.
“Chi Chi Chi Chi Chi!!!”
The pale purple liquid boiled violently in mid-air, emitting a cloud of mist.
The entire bottle of potion was almost completely evaporated in an instant!
Fang Heng opened his mouth.
What the hell?
It’s gone?
It’s actually gone?!
The potion that he spent 40,000 points to exchange for exploded in front of his eyes?
Fang Heng felt that he had been cheated.
“Fang, Fang Heng...”
Cheng Ya’s voice could not help but tremble a little.
“What did you do to the potion?”
Fang Heng turned his head.
He noticed that Cheng Ya’s face was slightly pale.
He looked in the direction where Cheng Ya was looking.
Fang Heng’s heart moved.
Eh? What was that situation?
Fang Heng’s pupils constricted slightly.
The divine potion had not completely evaporated. It had left behind something.
In the air, four to five extremely tiny lilac worms were floating in the air. They were constantly twisting and struggling violently.
Because they were too tiny, it was impossible to see them clearly without careful observation.
Before Fang Heng could take a closer look, the tiny worms quickly lost their activity.
After leaving the solution environment, they stopped struggling and turned into specks of dust in the air.
[Hint: Through basic occult (Level 1), you have tested the unknown potion. The potion has no spiritual energy and mental energy, but there is weak creature energy fluctuation.]
[Hint: You have found a special unknown creature in the potion.]
[Hint: You cannot modify the potion with your current occult level. You cannot get more information about the creature.]
[Hint: Increase your occult level. Try to obtain more information.]
[Hint: You have obtained 128 basic occult skill experience points. Your skill-basic occult level has been increased to Level 2.]
Unknown creature?
Was it the worm that he had just seen?
Fang Heng frowned.
The hint was vague and he did not quite understand it.
But one thing was clear to Fang Heng, this bottle of potion was gone.
He had suffered a huge loss!
Fang Heng was ready to seek an explanation from Yatu.
“What is this? A worm? Yatu? Why is there a worm in the medicine?”
“What? What worm did you say?”
Yatu didn’t notice the extremely tiny worm. He looked baffled and thought for a moment that Fang Heng was here to cause trouble.
“Fang Heng, once the potion is sold, it will not be returned.”
Fang Heng turned to look at Cheng Ya.
Cheng Ya also shook her head in the face of Fang Heng’s probing gaze.
The divine potion was related to the main storyline and the relevant information was hidden. Her understanding of the potion was limited to this.
“Fang Heng, I...”
“I have something to do. I’ll leave first.”
Fang Heng put away the remaining three bottles of potion and turned to leave.
There must be a problem with the divine potion!
If he went back and asked Qiu Yaokang to study it, he would most likely be able to get an answer.
This mission was originally just to obtain the divine potion. He had to submit the mission first and exchange it for the first-generation meteorite!
Fang Heng didn’t want to waste any more time.
“Wait! Fang Heng!”
Cheng Ya took a step forward and caught up.
“I represent the Federation to purchase the divine potion from you.”
“300 King of Gods’ points.”
“I refuse.”
“500 points! Fang Heng! This is the highest price I can offer.”
“I refuse.”
Fang Heng closed the car door as he spoke, driving the minivan towards the apocalypse camp at high speed.
Cheng Ya’s heart became increasingly uneasy.
She was extremely suspicious of Fang Heng’s identity.
The way he tested the potion just now was a strength that only existed in high-level games!
It was very likely that Fang Heng had used some special method to move from a high-level game to a low-level game.
He must have a deeper purpose!

chapters.title: Chapter 350 - The Whole Story
paragraphs: Apocalypse camp.
Ai Lei was playing with the divine potion that he had just obtained from Fang Heng.
His eyes were filled with admiration and joy.
There was also a hint of excitement.
“Oh ho! Amazing! Fang Heng! You’re amazing! I’m starting to believe in the parallel world that you’re talking about.”
“Then can you give me the first-generation meteorite? I only need a small part of it for research.”
Ai Lei put away the divine potion and said seriously, “Fang Heng, actually, I also want to give you the first-generation meteorite, but unfortunately, I can’t.”
“What do you mean?”
“According to our agreement, I will tell you all the information about the first-generation meteorite.”
“I’d like to hear the details.”
Ai Lei took a deep breath and said, “Unfortunately, the first-generation meteorite was destroyed.”
“What? Who did it?”
Fang Heng was very surprised.
Could it be that the anti-federal organization also made a move against District 7?
“To be more precise, it was due to an accident.”
“After obtaining the first-generation meteorite, we immediately began to research the first-generation meteorite.”
“During the research process, a few researchers experienced mild dizziness, nausea and other symptoms.”
“We immediately carried out a full body check on the researchers, but there was no anomaly, so we temporarily isolated them.”
“A few days later, we noticed that the research report submitted by Cook Barn, the research director of the first-generation meteorite research experiment, had a lot of problems.”
“After further investigation, we realized that Cook Barn’s mental state was abnormal and unstable.”
“To be more precise, he went crazy.”
“Just as we were about to temporarily control him, an explosion was triggered in Cook Barn’s laboratory.”
“The first-generation meteorite was destroyed in the explosion. Many researchers were killed in the explosion as well.”
“The accident had a great impact on us.”
“Five surviving researchers who had participated in the first-generation meteorite research also died within half a month after the explosion.”
“After they died, we dissected the corpses. Guess what we found?”
Ai Lei kept Fang Heng in suspense as he looked at the latter.
“What is it?”
“It’s a worm.”
Ai Lei was also filled with doubt and confusion.
“We found an extremely tiny red worm in the researcher’s body. Since the worm had already died, we are unable to do any further research.”
“We can only make a judgment that this worm has affected their brains, causing them to develop a pathological change.”
Worm!?
Fang Heng immediately thought of the game hint that he had just received through the elementary-level occult skill.
He also saw worms in the divine potion!
Fang Heng suddenly realized something.
“Could it be that the first-generation meteorite is related to the divine potion?!”
“Yes! Fang Heng!”
“It’s him! Cook Barn! We thought he was dead for a while.”
“We didn’t expect to hear his name again two years later.”
“It’s him who researched and created the divine potion, and also founded the Scavenger Army.”
“I think everything that happened to the Scavenger Army is related to the meteorite.”
“But unfortunately, the meteorite was destroyed. We, the Dark Knights, are also responsible for what happened.”
Fang Heng’s heart sank when he heard that.
It seemed that this was the progress of the follow-up main storyline mission in District 7.
He had unconsciously obtained the information of the later main storyline mission.
These clues were worth thousands of gold.
Knowing this news, he could even think of ways to prevent the establishment of the Scavenger Army in District 8.
The prerequisite was that he had to first find the first-generation meteorite.
Fang Heng lowered his head and pondered.
According to the mission line of District 7, after the Dark Knights obtained the first-generation meteorite, an accident occurred during the research process of the first-generation meteorite.
Then, the Scavenger Army appeared.
All of this was related to the mysterious worm and the key NPC, Cook Barn.
The biggest problem was that District 7 could not find the first-generation meteorite, and the mission line of District 8 was cut off.
“So, Fang Heng, I can’t help you with the first-generation meteorite.”
“But since you have mastered the technology of parallel space, I’m afraid you’ll never find that kind of worn in your world.”
“But that’s good. You won’t have an organization like the Scavenger Army. They’re far more brutal than zombies.”
Ai Lei’s tone was a little relieved.
He took a deep breath and looked at Fang Heng again.
“Fang Heng, if possible, I need your help. Let’s work together to stop the Scavenger Army.”
Ai Lei’s tone became excited.
He already had a preliminary plan.
“How about you help me find Cook Barn? With your ability and my cooperation, you can quickly become a high-ranking member of the Scavenger Army.”
“If we can find Cook Barn, we should be able to get more information from him, find out the truth behind it, and then eliminate the entire Scavenger Army!”
Fang Heng listened to Ai Lei and lowered his head to ponder.
This might also be a way.
What if he could get other information from Cook Barn and bypass the first-generation meteorite.
But it would take too long.
And the success rate was not high.
Even if the final truth was out, without the first-generation meteorite, the chances of the District 8 mission being stuck were still high.
It was better to bring the divine potion back to the shelter to study it.
What if there was a low chance that the divine potion could trigger a follow-up mission?
After making up his mind, Fang Heng was about to refuse when a game hint suddenly appeared on his retina.

[Hint: Player has submitted the divine potion to the Dark Knights. You have received 50 King of Gods’ points. You have received 5000 survival points. Favorability rating with Ai Lei has increased significantly.]

[Hint: Checking... confirming that District 7 is in a competitive state... confirming that the player is an elementary player. Confirming that the player has the right to compete for District 7’s main storyline mission.]
[Hint: Unifying the information...]
[Hint: Player has obtained 2500 main storyline mission contribution points (District 7). Player has triggered the next main storyline mission (District 7) Ai Lei’s plan.]
[Hint: Player’s main storyline mission contribution points in each game world will be calculated separately.]
[Hint: The current main storyline mission progress of Zombie Apocalypse (District 7) world has reached 76.78%. The contribution ranking has been opened.]
[Hint: Current player’s main storyline mission contribution points: 2500. Current District 7 contribution ranking: 39.]

[Hint: Player can check the District 7 main storyline mission contribution rank. After completing all the main storyline missions, the player with the highest contribution will receive the current world.]
[Hint: Player who is not in the top 10 can choose to hide the name on the leaderboard.]
[Hint: Player, do you want to hide your name?]
District 7’s main storyline mission?!
He can participate in the competition of Server 7 at the same time?
Fang Heng was stunned.
He immediately opened the leaderboard to check.
The player ranked first only had 98,000 contribution points.
Maybe...
Not maybe, but there was a chance to get it!
Fang Heng was a little tempted.
Belonging was a good thing. If there was a chance, it would also be good to get the ownership of Server 7?
It’s never too much to obtain the ultimate ownership of the game!
